publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Mod isn't currently working... It will be fixed in the future when possible, thank you for understanding![/h1]

————————————————————————
[h1]PLEASE NOTE:[/h1]
-> If you use this mod with other mods that add new equip slots (Extra Equip Slots, Apothecary Medicamento, ...) you should also install my 7+ Equip Slots Fix mod to prevent bugs when reaching more than 7 Equip Slots at the same time!

-> If you use my mod with "Extra Equipslot" everything will work fine, but the inventory bar will be a bit small. This is just a small visual bug & I will try to see what I can do about it when I have time. Meanwhile you can use the
Scale Inventory mod by Deja Vu! It allows you to rescale your inventory then you can make your inventory hud bigger, or you can use the EES API Edition mod by MystPhysX which offer support only for backpack, neck & 1 extra slot.

• The Apothecary Medicamento mod by MystPhysX will allow you to increase your arrow/bolt accuracy & lessen its effect of breaking by using Vitamin R!
• The Mining Machine mod I made with MystPhysX will allow to craft a musket out of iron ore!
• This mod contains full controller support!

————————————————————————
-= [Credits] =-
[b]ZupaleX:[/b] Made everything else
[b]Vyuri:[/b] Made new artwork
[b]revive:[/b] Made a new animation for firing the bow

————————————————————————
[h1]-= [Info] =-[/h1]
This mod focuses on bringing more ranged weapons to Don't Starve Together! It also features custom sound & animation!

Currently these are the item this mod adds into Don't Starve Together:
• [b]Arrow Carver[/b]: This is used to craft arrows, it can be crafted at a Science Machine!

• [b]Bow[/b]: This is used to shoot arrows at creatures, it can be crafted at a Science Machine!

• [b]Musket[/b]: The Musket's similar to the crossbow being powerful & slower than a bow, it can be crafted at a Science Machine! It requires bullets as ammunition!

• [b]Magic Bow[/b]: A magical bow which can shoot magical arrows at creatures depending on what you fuel it with, it does not require a Quiver to be fired! The type of fuels you can charge the Magic Bow with is...
  • Nightmare Fuel: Fires Nightmare Arrows which will deal less damage against Nightmare Creatures & attacking them lowers your Sanity.
  • Fireflies Ball: Fires Divine Arrows which will deal more damage against Nightmare Creatures & attacking them increases your Sanity, you will lose Sanity if you attack a passive creature with this arrow though!
  • Blue Goop: Fires Healing Arrows which will not deal any damage against creatures, but instead heals their Health!

• [b]Quiver[/b]: This is what's used to put your arrows in then you can fire them, it can be crafted at a Science Machine!

• [b]Crossbow[/b]: This is used to shoot bolts at creatures, it can be crafted at a Science Machine! Also, currently it only has 3 bolts. Though, more bolts will be added in the future & the crafting will more akin to arrows!
  • Crossbows need to be recharged between attacks! To do this place your bolts in your equipped quiver then right click on your equipped crossbow!

————————————————————————
[h1]-= [Arrow carver] =-[/h1]
Once you've crafted an Arrow Carver to craft yourself arrows (& bolts in the future),
You will want to equip it then right click on it! That will bring up a special hud which will give you three slots to place items in!
In the first slot place a bird feather of any kind, in the second slot place a material for the shaft, & in the third slot place something for the tip of the arrow!

[h1]-= [Craft arrows] =-[/h1]

publishedfiledetails.title: [한글] 굶지마 다함께 한글화 [클라이언트]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
2024/10/25: 번역 페이지 링크가 변경되었습니다

굶지마 다함께 한글화 팀 제공

굶지마 다함께 한글화 팩의 클라이언트 모드입니다.

안내: 최근 워크샵 API 관련 버그로 고통받는 분들이 많이 계십니다. 이 문제는 최신 워크샵 API를 사용하는 굶지마 모드 전반에서 발생하는 것으로 보입니다. [url=https://support.klei.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029882051-My-mods-are-corrupted-workshop-xxxxxxx-and-I-can-t-remove-them]여기[/url]에 따라 1. 스팀을 관리자 권한으로 실행 2. Don't Starve Together를 관리자 권한으로 실행하면 대부분 문제가 해결됩니다. 자세한 사항은 링크를 참조해 주세요.

* 이 모드를 설치하고 서버 한글모드를 활성화하지 않으면 클레이가 기본으로 넣어둔 파일이 불러와집니다. 혼동에 주의하세요!

[h1] 설명 [/h1]

클라이언트의 UI에 한국어 번역을 적용시킬 수 있습니다. 기본 폰트를 사용합니다.

서버가 Dedicated 모드(동굴이 있는 경우 포함)일 때는 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2391292843]서버 모드[/url]를 적용시켜야 캐릭터 대사 등이 한국어로 출력됩니다.

특정 캐릭터 전용 폰트는 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2391197502]여기[/url]서 설치할 수 있습니다.

[h1] 설치방법 [/h1]

[olist]
   [*]Steam 창작마당에서 모드를 구독해 주세요.

   [*]다음과 같이 설정되어 있는지 확인해 주세요

   [list]
       [*][b]위그프리드의 움라우트[/b](Wigfrid's Umlauts) : 활성화 - 유니코드 문자를 사용하려면 필수입니다.

       [*][b]저용량 텍스처[/b](Small Texture) : 비활성화 - 굶지마 투게더에는 유니코드 문자용 저용량 텍스쳐가 없습니다.
   [/list]

   [*]모드 메뉴에서 이 모드를 활성화해 주세요.
[/olist]

[h1] 프로젝트 진행율 [/h1]
번역: 100%
검수: 100%
최신 지원 콘텐츠 업데이트: 두 면의 심연 (Depth of Duplicity)

[h1] 번역 팀에 참여하세요! [/h1]
저희는 매 콘텐츠 업데이트 때마다 번역을 진행합니다. 관심 있으신 분들은 저희 스팀 그룹에 참여하여 공지와 안내사항을 읽고 번역에 참여해 보세요. 번역에 대한 건의 등은 저희 디스코드 서버나 토론 페이지에서 하실 수 있습니다. 혹은 [url=https://app.transifex.com/DSTKoreanTeam/DSKR]이곳[/url]에서 직접 번역에 참여하실 수도 있습니다. 언제든지 참여하실 수 있으니 많은 참여 부탁드립니다. 기술적 문제에 대한 것 역시 아래 토론 페이지에서 건의하고 의논해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.

THIS MOD NOT NEED MORE COMPLEMENTS AND THIS MOD IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH OTHERS MODS.

The Tropical Experience mod adds content from every DLC ever released on Don't Starve to Don't Starve Together, as well as adding event content and creating your own content. The screenshots below try to summarize what the mod would be like in a standard generation world. When the world is created you start on the Together continent, and you can sail across the ocean in search of new continents, including Lunar Island, Pig City, Tropical Islands, Frozen Island and more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6jFAaBn.png[/img]

but the new content doesn't only affect the surface of the game, the mod also adds new zones inside the caves, like the frozen cave that can be accessed by an entrance on the frozen island, adds the Hamlet caves that can be accessed by any entrance on the island where the cities of the pigs are located, there is also the interior of the volcano, which has a portal that takes you to the forge arena, and in addition to these additions, all the contents of the don't starve together are kept.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/98KRrOV.png[/img]

and the mod doesn't stop there, because with its integration with the Creeps in the Deeps mod, a new zone can be explored under the sea, that's right, prepare an oxygen mask to explore the depths of the ocean.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qqUIVAS.png[/img]

publishedfiledetails.title: Deluxe Campfires 2.14 (Hamlet compatible)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
---------------- DESCRIPTION ----------------

Mod has been updated by KreygasmTR to work with the Hamlet DLC, plus some small tweaks and bug fixes.

Original Mod (for Don't Starve) can be found at - http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=269073510

Are you tired of only having a basic firepit in your lovely base camp, or do you constantly worry about having to add fuel to it for fear of the darkness or cold. The new and improved Deluxe Firepit, Deluxe Endothermic Firepit and the two new "Stars" add a new aesthetic to your base camp, not to mention providing more heat and light.

--------------------------

View the v2.0 explanation video at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NVoWl8ZyNVs, it explains everything for you :)
Version 2 Discussion - http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/269073510/617319460764628025/
Mod page - http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=269073510
Deluxe Firepit and Heat Star are both RoG and Vanilla compatible.
Endothermic/cold fires are only available in RoG, hence the Ice Star is only for RoG.

HITBOX IS MASSIVE. CAN'T FIX. ROTATE CAMERA TO ACCESS ITEMS BEHIND FIRES.


---------------- DELUXE FIREPIT and DELUXE ENDOTHERMIC FIREPIT ----------------

The Deluxe Firepits burn for a longer time than the standard firepit (Options are configurable for 25%, 50% and 75% extra burn time).
The firepits have custom speech dialog for all of the main characters (thanks @Gotheran).

The fires will drop loot when it extinguishes itself - firepit will drop a selection of charcoal and ash, endorhermic firepit will drop ice.
(Please note: Sometimes the loot may drop behind the firepit causing it to be hidden from view, rotate the view to check for drops if you can't find them. If you hold spacebar near the fire, all objects, both in-front and behind should be collected.)


---------------- DELUXE ENDOTHERMIC (COLD) FIREPIT ----------------

The Deluxe Endothermic Firepit is an additional fire which is larger than the standard Endothermic Firepit. Similarly to the Deluxe Firepit it burns longer and drops loot (options configurable).

The fire will drop Ice as it reduces in size, a by-product of the Endothermic reaction.
When it extinguishes it will also drop a small amount of nitre and ash, along with more ice.


---------------- HEAT AND ICE STARS ----------------

In version 2.0 two new firepits in the form of 2 stars have been added - The "Star of Anchiale" (heat star) and The "Star of Boreas" (ice star).

The stars work like camp fires providing heat, plus cooking (Anchiale) and cooling (Boreas).
When you fuel the star from nothing you will awaken the spirit within. This spirit has dialogue which will speak to player to inform them of its current state, and also begin threatening the player if they let the Star go out.

Each star drops loot when it extinguishes, with the Heat star dropping a Red Gem (only if star reaches max size) and Nightmare Fuel. Whilst the Ice star drops a Blue Gem (only if star reaches max size) and ice. The stars do not want to go out, so will threaten the player as the star shrinks. If you do let the stars go out then the spirit will release fire or ice hounds. (PLEASE NOTE: if loot is set to "no" for each of the stars then no loot and no hounds will be generated)

Each star has a maximum amount of fuel that they can take to reach their maximum size, once this has been reached no more fuel can be added until the size of the star has been reduced. This stops the spirit from becoming too unstable as it burns, and stops a massive explosion from wiping out the planet.

The Stars also have custom speech dialog for all of the main characters.

The default burn rate for the Stars is 3/4 of a day, but this can be changed in the mod options.


---------------- HOW DO I PLACE THEM IN MY BASE CAMP? ----------------
The Deluxe Firepit, Star of Anchiale, and Star of Boreas can be found in the LIGHT tab (towards the bottom).


---------------- HOW MUCH DO THEY COST TO CRAFT ----------------
FIREPIT - The default costs 14 x cut stone, 3 x gold nuggets, and 6 x logs to build.
ICE STAR - 2 x electrical dodads, 30 x cut stone, and 1 x blue gem
HEAT STAR - 2 x gears, 30 x cut stone, and 1 x red gem
Recipe costs are configuration through the "Mods" section.


---------------- WHATS CONFIGURABLE? ----------------
This mod has a lot of configurable options (found in the "Mods" section within the game)

Burn Rate - adjust the rate at which all 3 fires burn.
Recipe Cost - 3 options for global recipe cost - beginner (an easier recipe), standard (for regular players) and advanced (for hardcore players).
Drop loot? - option to select whether the loot is dropped when the flame extinguishes or not for all 3 fires.

[*]After built, the wall is in its tallest condition. Players can use hammer to shorten it. Hammer will not lose durability when hammering it.

[*]Super wall fast build tool (can be found in tools tab) is added. You can build a set of walls and doors with one click! (You must have corresponding wall items.) When holding the tool in your mouse, you can use [b][i]Middle Mouse Button[/i][/b] or [b][i]F5[/i][/b] to rotate the preset, [b][i]Scroll Up[/i][/b] / [b][i]Scroll Down[/i][/b] or [b][i]F1[/i][/b] / [b][i]F2[/i][/b] to change to previous/next preset. Press [b][i]F3[/i][/b] / [b][i]F4[/i][/b] to decrease/increase height of the preset. You can hold [b][i]ALT[/i][/b] to quickly switch to a wall destroyer brush, and release to switch back. If you want to add your custom "recipe" to the fast build tool, you can use [b][u][url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/104913-tool-super-wall-maker-v18-is-released-a-tool-for-the-mod-super-wall/]Super Wall Maker[/url][/u][/b] to do it.

publishedfiledetails.title: Status Announcements
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]How it works[/b][/h1]
ALT(+SHIFT)+click parts of the HUD to announce their status ("I'm wounded!", "I have 2 twigs.", "We need more drying racks."). For controllers, the announce buttons show up on the HUD when in Inventory or Crafting mode. (SHIFT is needed for inventory items, because ALT+click already examines them). 

Holding CTRL in addition will cause it to whisper (or if you have it set to whisper by default, it will announce it globally). For controllers, hold Menu Misc 3, which by default is left-stick-click.

Each character has their own quotes, and custom characters can define their own quotes (see below).

Also available on [url=https://github.com/rezecib/Status-Announcements/releases]GitHub[/url].

If you find this mod super annoying, there's also an option ("Hide Announcements") to mute all uses of it (you won't see announcements from yourself or anyone else).

[h1][b]Configuration Options[/b][/h1]
Whisper by default: If toggled on, then you will whisper unless you hold ctrl.
Show current/max: If toggled on, then you will announce your current/max health, sanity, and hunger.
Custom X Quotes: If toggled off, X (one of the characters) will use default quotes instead of the custom ones written in their voice.


[h1][b]List of things you can announce[/b][/h1]
[list][*] [b]Current hunger/health/sanity/wetness/log/temperature[/b] status. Alt+clicking your health badge will announce "I'm in perfect health!" if your health is full, or "I'm mortally wounded!" if it's very low. Sanity and hunger have different announcements specific to them ("AAAH! Stay back, beasts of darkness!"). Announcing temperature requires [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url].
[*] [b]Craftable items[/b] in the craft tabs. If you know how to build it and you have the supplies, it will announce that you'll make one. If you don't know how to build it, it will ask if someone can make you one (e.g. you have a Wickerbottom and no science machine yet, and you want her to make you a backpack). If you know how to make one, but don't have the supplies for it, it will say "We need more [craftable]s". You can also announce item skins you have.
[*] [b]Ingredients[/b] for crafted items. Let's say night is falling and you have two twigs and one grass. Alt+clicking the grass in the torch recipe will announce "I need 1 more cut grass for a torch.".
[*] [b]Items in your inventory and backpack[/b]. Since alt+click already does something for these, you'll have to hold down shift as well. This will announce that you have the item, and how many: "I have 10 dragonpies."
[*] [b]Items in chests or other containers[/b]. This works the same way as inventory ones, but will announce something like "We have 8 dragonpies here in this icebox".[/list]

[h1][b]Custom Announcements for Character Mods[/b][/h1]
Character mods can add their own quotes if they want. You don't need to worry about mod load order, just add the quotes to GLOBAL.STRINGS._STATUS_ANNOUNCEMENTS (make sure to check if it exists first, and if not, make it an empty table before adding your strings). See announcestrings.lua in the files for this mod on the format of the announcement strings. If you want to see an example of how to do this, look at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=645436044]Elec Man[/url]. In addition, it's now possible to add announcements for stats that only your character has. There's a small guide inside the modmain, I recommend looking at that; you may need to refer to some other code there.

[h1][b]Translations[/b][/h1]
I have support for translations. However, I don't know all languages so if you're willing to translate the mod, then here's how to do it. If you're subscribed to the mod, then go to the game in Steam, click Properties, then the Local Files tab, then Browse Local files. Navigate to mods/workshop-343753877. Make a copy of announcestrings_english.lua and open it in a text editor (Notepad, Notepad++, Sublime, whatever). Translate all the strings and update the format and article parts at the top. Feel free to contact me to ask how those work if you need help writing it into the code there. Send me the translated file (for example, by uploading to pastebin.com and sending me the link), and I'll add in support for it-- I look at mods on the workshop that translate into that language, and then have this mod detect them and switch to the provided translations.

Currently supported languages:
[list][*] English (default)
[*] Brazilian Portuguese (thanks to Vinicius Araújo for translating!)
[*] Chinese (thanks to GoforDream and Shang for translating!)
[*] Spanish (thanks to Gum and oPt for translating)
[*] Russian, incomplete (thanks to deshkas and Shiro for translating)
[*] German (thanks to Redhead for translating)
[/list]

Requested languages:
[list][*] Let me know if you want one or want to help provide one.
[*] French; if you know French and would like to write lines in keeping with the characters, please reach out to me :)
[/list]

[h1][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/h1]
Thanks for SilentDarkness, SuperPsiPower, OSMRhodey, AceMurdock, and Lying Cake for help writing the character-specific strings.

[h1][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Because mods can't directly have their own keybindings, I'm using some of the game bindings to allow you to rebind ALT/SHIFT/CTRL. So if you've rebound any of the following, use those instead:
[list][*] "Force Inspect (mod)" (default ALT) the main announcement key
[*] "Force Container (mod)" (default SHIFT) press this as well to announce inventory items
[*] "Force Attack (mod)" (default CTRL) press this as well to toggle whispering
[/list]
[*] Sometimes alt gets stuck when alt-tabbing. Pressing alt again should fix it.
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
2024/10/25: 번역 페이지 링크가 변경되었습니다

굶지마 다함께 한글화 팀 제공

굶지마 다함께 한글화 팩의 서버 모드입니다.

안내: 최근 워크샵 API 관련 버그로 고통받는 분들이 많이 계십니다. 이 문제는 최신 워크샵 API를 사용하는 굶지마 모드 전반에서 발생하는 것으로 보입니다. [url=https://support.klei.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029882051-My-mods-are-corrupted-workshop-xxxxxxx-and-I-can-t-remove-them]여기[/url]에 따라 1. 스팀을 관리자 권한으로 실행 2. Don't Starve Together를 관리자 권한으로 실행하면 대부분 문제가 해결됩니다. 자세한 사항은 링크를 참조해 주세요.

[h1] 설명 [/h1]

서버용 버전입니다. Dedicated 모드의 서버 (서버 구동기, 혹은 동굴 포함된 호스트) 에서 캐릭터 대사 등에 한글을 적용할 수 있는 모듈입니다. 

UI에 한국어를 적용하시려면 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2391246365]클라이언트 모드[/url]를 적용시켜야 합니다.

특정 캐릭터 전용 폰트는 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2391197502]여기[/url]서 설치할 수 있습니다.

[h1] 설치방법 [/h1]

[olist]
   [*]Steam 창작마당에서 모드를 구독해 주세요.

   [*]다음과 같이 설정되어 있는지 확인해 주세요

   [list]
       [*][b]위그프리드의 움라우트[/b](Wigfrid's Umlauts) : 활성화 - 유니코드 문자를 사용하려면 필수입니다.

       [*][b]저용량 텍스처[/b](Small Texture) : 비활성화 - 굶지마 투게더에는 유니코드 문자용 저용량 텍스쳐가 없습니다.
   [/list]

   [*]모드 메뉴에서 이 모드를 활성화해 주세요.
[/olist]

[h1] 프로젝트 진행율 [/h1]
번역: 100%
검수: 100%
최신 지원 콘텐츠 업데이트: 윌로우 & 위그프리드 스킬트리 업데이트

[h1] 번역 팀에 참여하세요! [/h1]
저희는 매 콘텐츠 업데이트 때마다 번역을 진행합니다. 관심 있으신 분들은 저희 디스코드에 참여하여 공지와 안내사항을 읽고 번역에 참여해 보세요. 혹은 [url=https://app.transifex.com/DSTKoreanTeam/DSKR/]이곳[/url]에서 직접 번역에 참여하실 수도 있습니다. 직접 기여하실 기회는 언제나 열려 있으니 많은 참여 부탁드립니다. 번역에 대한 건의 등은 저희 그룹이나 토론 페이지에서 하실 수 있습니다. 기술적 문제에 대해서도 아래 토론 페이지에서 건의하고 의논해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.

publishedfiledetails.title: Fire resurrection
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Should be compatiable with various item ownership mods so you can only rez at your own fires if you use them. Allows you to ressurect yourself as a ghost when you haunt the various fires
Works in modes where you can rez at the portal. Also adds a board worth of fuel to the fire, which lights firepits, so you can rez at night and not die instantly.
Works on:
Campfire
Firepit
Endothermic Fire
Endothermic Fire Pit
Delux Campfires mod

Has options to set hunger/health/sanity/max health penalty on res if the admin wishes. Lighting strike on rez can also be removed if you don't like it. Also has options to enable/disable rez at all supported fire types. Defaults are all previous behavior.
Also has an option to NOT spawn a skeleton on death per user requests.

publishedfiledetails.title: Zoro
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Update 7/24/15 - 

- Shusui's attack only takes 4 hunger instead of 6.
- Sandai now has a teleport strike attack that does 45 dmg. 
- Art has been slightly changed 
- Now has 200 hunger
- Wado Ichimonji now gives 50% absorb
[/h1]

The greatest swordsman is now in the Don't Starve Universe!

publishedfiledetails.title: Traducción al Español de Don't Starve Together
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Traducción al Español de Don't Starve Together. La traducción incluye el 100% de los diálogos disponibles para su traducción de Don't Starve Together Beta. Ten en cuenta que algunas líneas del menú para crear servidores y otros diálogos seguirán apareciendo en inglés hasta que sea posible traducir esas líneas a partir de los archivos originales del juego.

Cuando te suscribas a este traducción, automáticamente se te descargarán las actualizaciones disponibles. La actualizaré conforme sean añadidas más líneas de diálogo oficiales. 

Puedes ver las notas sobre los cambios haciendo [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/356494979]clic aquí[/url][/b].

Esta traducción intenta utilizar un Español "Neutral" para que pueda ser utilizada tanto por Latinoamericanos como por Europeos Hispanohablantes y siempre evitando perder el gran sentido del humor de este Juego. (Sin embargo, puede ser considerada como una traducción en Español predominantemente Latinoamericano)
[b]____________________________________________________________________________[/b]

[h1][b]¿Cómo instalo la traducción?[/b][/h1]
1. Da clic en el botón "Suscribirse".
2. Abre Don't Starve.
3. En el menú principal del juego da clic en el botón "Mods".
4. En la lista de mods busca la traducción llamada "Traducción al Español".
5. Dale un clic para activarla.
6. Presiona el botón "OK" localizado a la derecha. ¡Listo! Tu juego estará traducido.
[b]____________________________________________________________________________[/b]

[h1][b]Nota:[/b][/h1]
- Si ves alguna irregularidad en el mod, siéntete libre de hacérmelo saber y lo solucionaré.
- Este mod traduce únicamente las líneas de diálogo añadidas oficialmente por Klei Entertainment. No traducirá los diálogos pertenecientes a cualquier otro mod.

publishedfiledetails.title: Beefalo Status Bar
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Beefalo Status Bar[/h1]
It shows up when you mount a beefalo, goes away when you dismount. You can also toggle it on or off (when mounted) if you feel like it's getting in your way.
Note that toggling will override the "Show Automatically" setting for the current shard session (going in and out of the caves or reloading will reset it to whatever it was originally set to).


[h1]Information[/h1]
Most everything should be pretty straight forward, except maybe the tendency and the hunger badge, so let me explain.

[h1]Domestication and Tendency:[/h1]
The color of the domestication badge will reflect the current tendency of your beefalo. This is configurable, but by default it goes like this:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/bHMl3Sb.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/877HBr0.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/Mk7X39h.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/LtxSAfE.png ]

There are 13 colors (8 unique and 5 variations) to choose from.

Note: Last I checked, the only time the game tries to make your beefalo domesticated is when you feed it. This means that when you reach 100% domestication your beefalo won't become domesticated until you feed it something.

[h1]Ride Timer:[/h1]
This badge shows how much time you have left riding your beefalo before it bucks you off. Hovering over it will show you how many uses your saddle has left.
[b]Note[/b]: Your saddle will [b]NOT[/b] lose durability when the timer runs out. The only time this happens is when the beefalo shakes it off it's back.

[h1]Hunger Badge:[/h1]
Your beefalo needs to have at least 15 hunger (configurable) at mount time to activate the hunger badge. Once activated, when the beefalo's hunger reaches 0 it will deactivate itself again.
This should be low enough to easily trigger it while still in the process of domestication, but high enough to almost never see it once your beefalo is fully domesticated.


[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[b]I don't see the numbers below the badges, why?[/b]
- They are a feature of another mod called [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url][/b]. In order to see them you will need to download/subscribe to it (and enable it). [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Click here[/url] to do just that.

[b]Can you make this a client only mod?[/b]
- No. Unfortunately, the beefalo information is not available on the client, so a client only version is not possible.

[b]I'm using a HUD reskin mod, how do I make this mod use the reskinned badges?[/b]
- Set the "Theme" option to "Default Theme".


[h1]Latest Changelog:[/h1]
[h1]v1.4.0[/h1]
[h1]General[/h1]
- Added support for resetting the ride timer by raising obedience when mounted.
- Added Beige color (or close to it) as a color choice for all badges.
- Changed the default domestication badge color for "Default" beefalo from White to Beige.
- Increased the default hunger badge threshold from 10 to 15.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue causing the Status Bar to move up a little bit each time the player changes characters when using The Forge theme without Combined Status.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
- A small backend change for future-proofing that will hopefully not cause any trouble.

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
- In the upcoming game update, beefalo can be fed while mounted. This will increase their obedience (unless already maxed out), which will reset the ride timer. In case other scenarios where obedience is raised while riding are to be added in the future (like brushing for example), they should be properly accounted for as well.
- Due to how mod configurations work in the game, if you already have a saved configuration the new defaults may not be properly reflected until you reset or change them manually.

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Stack and Pick Up
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod gives you MANY settings for automatically stacking or picking up newly spawned and manually dropped stackable items. By 'automatically stacking' I mean that if an item is spawned (e.g., loot from monsters or workables, like trees) or it is manually dropped on the ground by the player, it looks for other stacks on the ground to merge with. All features can be enabled individually.

You can also individually enable that if the player is within range, they will automatically pick up ANY stackable item spawned near them. You can also set whether the player MUST have one of the item in their inventory already for the auto pickup to happen. Useful in order to avoid cluttering your inventory with useless things!

The mod can coincidentally [b]improve FPS[/b] (or rather, performance) because it reduces the amount of separate items on the map. You can toggle whether everything spawned on the ground during world generation / load should be auto stacked with similar things close by, which should improve FPS for everyone on your server.

[b]Credit:[/b] This mod was inspired by the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1216718131]AntiStun[/url] for DST, but was rewritten to add more features and options.

[h1][b]Settings Information[/b][/h1]
[i][u]PLEASE NOTE: Many settings are TURNED OFF BY DEFAULT.[/u][/i]
---== [b]General Settings[/b] ==---
[b]Puff On Stack[/b]: Toggle whether auto stacking is visualized by playing a smoke puff effect.

---== [b]World Spawn Settings[/b] ==---
[b]World Drop Auto Stack[/b]: Enable/disable automatically stacking items dropped by the world.
[b]World Gen Auto Stack[/b]: Controls whether items being spawned / placed while generating or loading a world should auto stack. Turn this off to keep the aesthetics generated by the world generation algorithm, e.g., a random skeleton might have more than one stack of the same item among the items spread out around it.
[b]World Auto Stack Range[/b]: The radius within which a newly spawned item will look for stacks to add itself to.
[b]World Auto Stack In[/b]: Setting this to 'Existing' means that new drops are added to surrounding stacks. 'Newest' means surrounding stacks are added to the newest stack.
[b]World Auto Stack Ash[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned ash?
[b]World Auto Stack Poop[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned poop?
[b]World Auto Stack Seeds[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned seeds?

---== [b]Manual Drop Settings[/b] ==---
[b]Manual Drop Auto Stack[/b]: Enable/disable automatically stacking items dropped by players.
[b]Manual Auto Stack Range[/b]: The range within which a manually dropped item looks for a stack to join. You can still have separate stacks on the ground close to each other, if you set this to a low value (e.g., 2 to 5).
[b]Manual Auto Stack In[/b]: Setting this to 'Existing' means that manually dropped items are added to surrounding stacks. Setting it to 'Newest' means surrounding stacks are added to the manually dropped stack.
[b]Manual Auto Stack Ash[/b]: Also auto stack manually dropped ash?
[b]Manual Auto Stack Poop[/b]: Also auto stack manually dropped poop?
[b]Manual Auto Stack Seeds[/b]: Also auto stack manually dropped seeds?

---== [b]Auto Pickup Settings[/b] ==---
[b]Auto Pickup Items[/b]: Enable/disable automatically picking up stackable items dropped by the world.
[b]Auto Pickup Range[/b]: The range within which a dropped item looks for a player to get picked up by.
[b]Require Existing Stack?[/b]: Whether the player must already have one of that item in their inventory or backpack, in order to automatically pick up an item. Reduces inventory clutter!
[b]Manual Auto Stack Ash[/b]: Also auto pick up newly spawned ash?
[b]Manual Auto Stack Poop[/b]: Also auto pick up newly spawned poop?
[b]Manual Auto Stack Seeds[/b]: Also auto pick up newly spawned seeds?

[h1][b]Usage notes[/b][/h1]
a. Ignores small livestock and small creatures, like bees, moles, rabbits, spiders, etc., because they start living when dropped.
b. Ignores heavy, carryable objects, like glass/sand-spikes and -castles.
c. This is a server mod.
d. Does NOT require you to make a new world before working. Enabling/disabling this mod should NOT require a server restart.

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1803281169]Link to DS / RoG / SW / Hamlet version[/url][/b]

[h1][b]Change log[/b][/h1]
See the Change Log tab.

[h1][b]Links to my other DST mods (Steam pages)[/b][/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1726886550]Blow Darts Any Feather
[/url] - Allows you to add extra recipes for any blowdart, so you can use any feather to craft them.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436761544]Fishing Buddy[/url] - Allows you to edit all settings pertaining to fishing.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1503825995]Long-range Containers[/url] - Allows you to change the distance you can move away from containers before they automatically close.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436763648]Long-range Research[/url] - Lets you set the range from which you can use the research machines, and access recipes from more than one machine at a time!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436764979]Metabolizer[/url] - Allows you to set the base rate of hunger, from 400% of normal loss, and all the way to 200% gain.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1569662574]Monster Ash Drop Tuner[/url] - Allows you to set a chance for monsters, prey, animals and characters (not players), to NOT replace their loot with ash when they die burning and screaming.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1528148748]No Wet Items[/url] - Removes the possibility of inventory items being wet.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436769882]Resurrection Tuner[/url] - Tune the resurrection penalties, and starting stats after resurrection, plus crafting-cost of revival-items.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1561425565]RPG Items (global edition)[/url] - Any weapon, armor and helmet has a chance to be imbued with special modifiers when they are generated by the game (by world generation, crafting, drops etc).
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=443371186]Sanity Tuner[/url] - Allows you to tune the sanity gain and loss players receive from many things, including moisture and auras!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436772038]Sleepy Time[/url] - Allows you to set the amount of gain/loss of each stat for each sleep-tick, AND how often sleep-ticks occur, as well as # of uses for tents and siesta huts.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1570670279]Stat Regen And Degen[/url] - A customizable stat regen AND degen system for health, sanity and hunger.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=530901403]Temperature Tuner[/url] - Allows you to tune the rate at which the temperatures of the players rise and fall (separately) using percentages, and change the minimum and maximum temperature caps for the players as well.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=436774846]Time Your Own Boss[/url] - Allows you to set the number of day-cycles before bosses start to arrive.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:

能够把掉落物自动堆叠，同时定期清理服务器。改自workshop=1216718131
清理机制：以腐烂食物为例：假设整个世界有5组腐烂食物，他们各自的堆叠数量为(1,6,18,40,40)，清理过程会将5组腐烂食物清理至2组，至于删除哪3组，随机。
所以服务器会清理的东西如果想不被清理掉：
一定要放箱子里或者随手做个背包扔地上放背包里！！！
一定要放箱子里或者随手做个背包扔地上放背包里！！！
一定要放箱子里或者随手做个背包扔地上放背包里！！！

奴役熊大、巨鹿、森林狩猎者砍的树也趁早捡起来！！！
奴役熊大、巨鹿、森林狩猎者砍的树也趁早捡起来！！！
奴役熊大、巨鹿、森林狩猎者砍的树也趁早捡起来！！！

v2.3: 新增自定义修改萤火虫是否堆叠。
v2.2: 新增可自定义修改堆叠范围检测。
v2.1: 新增boss图纸清理、boss广告清理、新增测试模式。
v2.0: 新增！！：可自定义修改物品的最大清理阈值。
v1.0: 新增自定义修改清理天数周期(1~40天，默认15天)。
可在游戏内以公告的形式显示当次具体清理内容(默认开)
公告格式：(物品名称)(物品代码)(原有个数)(清理个数)(剩余个数)

下面总结了一些评论区的常用问题：
Q1：为啥以前的那个mod不见了，换成了这个？
A：不小心删除了以前的那个mod，现在这个和以前的那个功能都一样，数据有些不一样。
这次更新以后饥荒mod居然还分了两个地方，我更新这玩意之后发现从原本的路径
D:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Don't Starve Together\mods
跑到了D:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\322330

Q2：为啥网吧用户饥荒无法更新、下载该mod？
A：稍微改了一下mod上传，结果变成了V2类mod，这类mod是klei最近推出的并且貌似有个毛病就是网吧用户steam客户端被做过手脚，导致V2类型的mod均无法下载，因此提示显示旧模组，解决方法是去steam官网下载steam客户端重新安装steam和饥荒到电脑，注意安装位置，最好在一个隐秘的角落新建一个英文名字的文件夹安装steam，别和网吧原本的steam安装在一起了，图4~图6中最后给出了好友在网吧换了steam后游戏成功下载、成功进入本人的阿里云服务器截图。

Q3：怎么感觉这个mod把猪人房和蜘蛛巢也清理掉了。。。？
A：猪人房一定不会清理，猪人房不见了是不是被人砸了。。猪人、猪人房都不会被清理，如果被清理是直接从这个世界删除，不会留下任何东西，去猪村捡到猪皮这个应该是其他怪物把猪杀了。蜘蛛巢会清理，整个世界蜘蛛巢最大数量可以自定义设置。

Q4：洞穴也在清理范围吗？
A：一般情况下，每个世界都有一个单独的mod控制文件（modoverrides.lua）对这个世界进行设置，如果你那个独立服务器的mod控制文件里面有这个mod，那就会清理。你可以做个测试，比如说放10把斧头放在你有疑惑的洞穴里面，同时把这个mod的清理天数设置为1天，看看斧头会不会被清理掉。

Q5：这个mod巨大作物他会堆叠 但是敲出来是小作物？
A：图8~12亲测砸掉巨大作物种子和果实会堆叠，数量和不堆叠几乎一样。巨大作物本身不会堆叠，用锤子砸了之后会堆叠，其本质是：巨大作物打碎（假设是巨大火龙果，打碎后获得3个火龙果2个火龙果种子 ），5个物品掉在地上，地上因为物品变化开始调用堆叠程序 ，堆叠之后，地上残留1组火龙果（3个）+1组火龙果种子 （2个）。如果有2个巨型火龙果一起打碎，那么打碎之后地上残留1组火龙果（6个）+1组火龙果种子 （4个）。图8~图12的测试图，第一张是不开我这个mod的时候砸碎6个巨大火龙果，火龙果果实和种子散落一地（捡起来后就是图二背包里面的17个火龙果和13个种子），第二张是我开着这个mod之后砸碎6个巨大火龙果，火龙果果实和种子各自成一组（也就是你说的“一个巨大植物的种子和果实”），具体统计数据是（15个果实14个种子）。
所以最后的结论是，单独测试我这个mod，砸碎巨型果实掉落的果实数量和种子数量应该是和不开这个mod一样的。你的档里出现了只掉落一个种子和果实的情况我不知道你是不是因为他们堆叠了导致只看到了一个种子和果实还是真的只有一个种子和果实（比如说砸碎6个火龙果，最后得到6个果实+6个种子），如果是后面的情况，可能是什么mod和这个mod发生了冲突，你可以尝试挨个排查一下 。

Q6：能不能清理树桩和树种？
A：用控制台生成一个树桩用的是树桩 的代码，但是用控制台删除一个树桩却用的是常青树的代码，我尝试过在清理内容里面添加“常青树桩、桦树树桩”代码，清理的时候没用，却能通过清理常青树代码清理掉树桩，我自己也是郁闷的。因此结论是暂时没法用专门的代码清理掉树桩。

Q7：这个怎么修改清理的时间呢？
A：清理时间的修改在mod修改页修改，具体图片可以在上面第二张图里面“清理周期”作为参考。

Q8：我的狗牙都几十组了为啥不会自动清啊？狗牙陷阱是不是会清理啊？
A：狗牙几十组你放在哪里？放箱子里、背包里的都不会清理，放地上才会。狗牙陷阱不会被清理，你的狗牙陷阱少了说不定是耐久用完了……

Q9: 

Q10：可不可以清mod人物的专属武器呀？
A：暂时不可以清理mod人物的专属武器，因为mod人物众多，添加起来很费劲，同时不同的人玩不同的mod人物导致受众面太小。

Q11：想问一下常青树这种东西是怎么个清理法？
A：常青树清理包括：小常青树、中常青树、大常青树、枯萎常青树、常青树桩。清理是清理这些常青树类型所有之和相加≤你设定的树值。

publishedfiledetails.title: Wormhole icons
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Have bad memory? Don't use wormholes since you always forget which leads where? Like colorful map icons? Then this mod is for you.

[h1]What this mod does[/h1]
It adds minimap icons for linked wormholes. To change their icon from the default one you'll need to travel once through them. The icons are the base wormhole but with a neat color variation.

As of version 1.0, the wormholes will show up properly upon entering/re-entering a world.

[h1]Config options[/h1]
Display Numbers: Toggle between displaying numbers over wormholes or not.
Scale: Sets the wormholes map scale.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[b]This mod is purely client side[/b], this it not a port or variation of any existing mods. This mod will work on pure vanilla servers since it's client side.

With that being said, if you own a server and want this mod, get Wormhole Marks instead. This is meant for players joining unmodded servers.

This mod saves the wormhole info in a file called mod_wormholeicons, located at Documents/Klei/DoNotStarveTogether/client_save. If you want to reset your wormhole icons or want to fully remove all traces of this mod, delete that file.

[h1]Current issues[/h1]
[b]This mod doesn't works when lag compensation is enabled. I know why, but I have been unable to fix it since I have been unable to find another point to "hook up" my mod wormhole's jump event.[/b]

This mod only supports up to 10 pairs of wormholes.
Resizing the screen while in-game will mess up the wormhole positions. 



If you find a bug or have a suggestion, feel free to leave it in the comments.

[h1]Special thanks[/h1]
Blueberrys, for DataContainer (used to save/load the wormhole positions)
Nc5xb3, for the positioning logic on the map screen.


Also, if you like this mod, you might also like:

publishedfiledetails.title: Waypoint
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]This mod supports [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=756527854]Don't Starve[/url] and Don't Starve Together.
Also available on the [url=http://forums.kleientertainment.com/files/file/1580-waypoint/]Klei Forums[/url][/h1]

2023-09-09
- Fixed nil ground name error causing crash

2022-08-13
- Fixed issue with waypoints shared on online servers due to DST update (Thank you Dragon O' Chaos for pointing at the core issue in bug report)
- You can choose 'None' as a keybind option
- Keybind for toggle indicators and markers set to None, you can rebind it in config or otherwise you can now use [b]Shift[/b] + [b]X[/b] (keybind for toggle GUI) instead
- Additional config to disable auto travel
- Additional config to show player and waypoint coordinate information (by default set to false)
- Thanks to all who are still using the mod when I'm not active anymore :X

The ability to add a waypoint at your position and bring up a list of waypoints to travel towards.
- Can toggle GUI that displays a list of waypoints (default key is [b]X[/b])
- Can toggle waypoint indicators and markers (default key is [b]Shift[/b] + [b]X[/b])
- Waypoints are persistent and also separate for each world and caves
- Interactable waypoint markers are displayed on the map!

Partially supports controllers.
- Scoreboard screen & [b]Left Trigger[/b]: Toggle waypoint indicators
- Scoreboard screen & [b]Right Trigger[/b]: Add waypoint
- Scoreboard screen & [b]Right Shoulder[/b]: Remove nearest waypoint (must be next to waypoint)
- Unfortunately can not edit waypoints name/color with controllers

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
Q: Why does my character not travel to the waypoint correctly?
A: Waypoint mod uses the in-game's [i]move to[/i] function to travel to a destination. If the route is too complex, it will make your character travel simply move straight towards destination ignoring any obstacles.

Q: Can other players see my waypoints/markers?
A: No, this is a client-only mod which means only you will be able to see your waypoints and markers (therefore it is not shared in any way).

Q: How can I add a waypoint?
A: This mod is an interface and does not require you to craft anything to use it. The default key is [b]X[/b] to bring up the waypoint manager. To add a waypoint, click the flag on the upper right corner of the interface.

Q: How can I delete a waypoint?
A: To delete a waypoint you need to directly modify the waypoint by bringing up the dialog and you should see the trash icon at the top right corner. To be able to modify any waypoint, you need to toggle edit mode by clicking on the wrench icon on the interface.

publishedfiledetails.title: Global Positions (CompleteSync)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h2] Main feature [/h2]
Just like the original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positioning[/url], it allows players to share exploration maps and mark signals on the map. However when using original mod, the maps between players are not completely synchronized, for example:
1. The player just joined the game, and the other players on the map have explored many places, but the newly added player cannot see the places explored by other players before he joined.
2. Player A is on the ground, and player B goes to the cave to explore. When player A enters the cave, he cannot see the place explored by player B before he enters the cave.
3. The player read the message in the bottle of the Crabby Hermit, and other players will not update the map like player A.
This mod solves these problems and can achieve complete synchronization. See the videos for a demonstration.

[h2]Bugs fixed：[/h2]
1. Fix the far away point of interest bug in the original mod.
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144089786/684C53427208270FBCB431A1E0ED9042045348A4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
2. The bug in the original mod that caused the signal marker to possibly deviate from the mouse position has been fixed. (In the original mod, if you dragged the map to its extreme position and continued dragging, the map would no longer move with the mouse. After that, the signal marker would deviate from the mouse position.)
3. Fixed the longstanding issue of icon misalignment in modules related to global positioning. Sometimes, the icons on the map would misalign, resulting in "mirages" on the map. For example, users might find that the building icons of their base are copied to another location on the map, or they may encounter strange icons outside the map boundaries. In fact, I believe this is a bug within the game itself, and the Global Position-type mods simply make it more likely to trigger ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/a-long-standing-bug-in-the-maprevealer-which-causes-map-icons-to-be-misaligned-r46911/]Bug report[/url]).
(Update: Klei has claimed to have fixed the bug I reported. It's very likely that this issue has also been resolved in other global positioning mods.)
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144080073/2844A976983D26F443E1087CF68152156035589F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/43440899924063808/7F394F1C087EB999B30E6A27C28C488B30DFB27F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
4. Fixed the issue where the Beefalo icons would leave ghosting effects when their owner moving too quickly. In fact, this is a bug in the game itself, which I reported on the forum ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/domesticated-beefalo-still-produce-map-icon-trails-r46296/?tab=comments#comment-66665]link[/url]). This mod will display the beefalo_bell icon instead of the beefalo. You can disable this option in the settings under "Remove Ghost Icons".

[h2]Other functions:[/h2]
1. Now Walter can deliver items to teammates without using a compass. This feature can also be disabled in the options. Thanks to @Kerr for providing the coding idea.
2. Map areas revealed by the Zaptrocuter are now visible to all players, alongside a new option that allows the flying Portable Storage Unit's icon to be seen by everyone.
3. Added acceleration options to help reduce server CPU usage. All of these options are disabled by default. Among them, “Quick Map share” is expected to be quite effective and can be enabled if needed. Many thanks to @暮色黯然 and hisfriends for their enthusiastic testing.
There are also options for “Disable fogrevealer” and “Remove maprevealer tag,” which might help reduce CPU consumption, though I’m not certain. These two options can cause other side effects, so it is recommended to leave them disabled. Enabling “Disable fogrevealer” will remove the circular bright area around teammates' icons, and will also prevent Wortox from jumping directly onto a teammate’s boat. Enabling “Remove maprevealer tag” will cause map icon updates around players to no longer synchronize. For example, if Player A digs up a tuft of grass, this option may cause Player B’s map to still show the grass icon. If you're interested, feel free to help test whether these two options provide a significant performance improvement—your feedback would be greatly appreciated.


======================

Note:
1. The mod is implemented based on the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]. In the previous version, I also used the codes from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2902364746]Global Positions -Remapped[/url] to sync the map. Please subscribe to them as a gesture of support (of course, the normal functioning of my mod doesn't rely on other mods).
2. If there are bugs or other modification suggestions, please give feedback. I sincerely apologize for the recent bugs that have caused map loss. If you still lost the explored map in the newest version, please leave a comment.
3. Known issue: If you switch from the original global positioning to this mod in an old save file, and immediately change characters or save the game, it can cause the loss of map exploration progress in caves. A temporary workaround is to visit the caves once before switching characters or save the game for the first time. I'm still trying to fix this problem. For now, it's best to use this mod in a new save file. Additionally, disabling this mod mid-game may also lead to map loss. If you need to disable this mod for some purposes like resolving mod conflicts, please make sure to back up your save file or record the maps of the cave and the forest into a map scroll. Thank @󰀐超级麦旋风 and @Halo Lemon for testing.
4. You may check the codes in [url=https://github.com/hellohawaii2/Global-Position-CompleteSync]Github[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: Uncompromising Mode
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dlvB9Gp.png[/img]

[h1]Uncompromising Mode increases the risk and reward for Don't Starve Together.[/h1]
[b]Uncompromising Mode (often shortened to "Uncomp" or "UM") was created with the goal of revitalizing the difficulty of DST. The mod adds randomness, variety, and challenge to the game's core mechanics, without making the experience annoying and tedious. However, it isn't simply just "a harder experience". Uncompromising Mode houses a lot of new content such as new mechanics, items, mobs, biomes, and bosses.[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/g02TMF9Q/charlineup.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KLOQxQi.png[/img]
* Three new characters, and a total mechanical rework of Walter!
* Rebalances and tweaks to nearly everything in the game!
* Night Terrors! Something may be lurking in the dark.
* New Weather Events, such as Snow Storms.
* More Nightmare Creatures. Insanity is an actual threat now; Stay past the brink and you may never return.
* A new overworld biome called the Hooded Forest, which houses a lot of new content including a new boss.
* A bunch of new items and mobs, ranging from dangerous to helpful.
* Some mobs have new attacks, ranging from spiders to bosses.
* The Veteran's Curse, a special Difficulty mode that grants access to powerful items at the cost of your wellbeing.
* Character tweaks and reworks. The Big 3 have had their downsides more pronounced, Willow has more fire-related perks, Maxwell has access to his singleplayer shadow puppets, small animals don't drop souls for Wortox, etc.
* A custom OST, containing music composed by Adam Ogrodnik.
* And more!

[h3]Most features in Uncompromising Mode can be configured and/or disabled.[/h3]
[b]Now people of all skill levels can enjoy the new content. We highly recommend using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3317960157]Configs Extended[/url] to help navigate the massive config list![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A9VOlIv.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/UF7FKpn] [img]https://i.imgur.com/ATLSZ9o.png [/img] [/url] [url=https://uncompromisingmode.wiki.gg/] [img]https://i.imgur.com/MvQv2KN.png [/img] [/url]
    Anyone reading this can contribute their ideas and get them added to the mod by joining the discord. We have an entire system built for players to come up with and submit ideas! We also have a large, active community! Of course, the [url=https://github.com/Uncompromising-Survival/UncompromisingMode]Github[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/UF7FKpn]Discord[/url] is also the fastest way to get a bug fixed as well.
     [img=https://i.imgur.com/5BvM5MJ.pngpng]

[h3]Includes Modded Skins API Support![/h3]
Some items have custom skins!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812783478][img]https://i.postimg.cc/K80Zc8XT/ms-compatible-quarter.png[/img][/url]


[b]Legal Jargon:[/b]
[i]This item and any content contained in this workshop item is not authorized for posting on Steam, except under the steam accounts named "Scrimbles" and "CanisWTF". Any repostings of this item will be met with a warning followed by a DMCA takedown filed against it.[/i]

[b]Gameplay Warning:[/b]
Several things, most notably Wixie & Wathom, don't work properly with Lag Compensation enabled! And a few of those turn it [i]off.[/i] temporarily.

Mods like 'Dusk and Night Music' overwrite the game files with 8 year old outdated files, which removes a lot of vanilla content, and makes it incompatible with Uncompromising Mode. We do not recommend using those mods with Uncompromising Mode as it [b]disables our official soundtrack[/b] to prevent [i]crashing.[/i]

[b]Credits[/b]
Special thanks to: Hornet, Electroely, Monti, Fourthless, summerscorcher, CarlosBraw and everyone in our community!

[h3]Want to support the developers?[/h3]
Uncompromising Mode is a [i]non-profit passion project[/i], however, if you want to support the developers, you may do so at their personal donation sites. All proceeds go to the individual developer, [b]not[/b] the team:

publishedfiledetails.title: A Big Bag 大背包 1.5
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
---
title: A Big Bag (大背包) [DST]
author: Roomcar
version: 1.5.0
--

## A Big Bag (大背包) [DST]

`version: 1.5.0`

`game: Don't Starve Together `


### 简介


- 这是一个为游戏 饥荒（联机版）（Don't Starve Together）制作的 MOD。

- 为游戏添加一个8x8的大背包。

- 独立的贴图，独立的UI，不会影响原版背包。

- 可以随身携带，也可以同时携带多个。

- 与「堆叠999」等MOD可能有冲突。

- 多种可配置的特殊功能。

  - 自动堆满：让物品自动堆叠至最大。

  - 恢复新鲜：让物品和食物恢复新鲜。

  - 改变移速：改变行动速度。

  - 保命微光：发出微弱的光，在夜晚不至于暴毙。

  - 获得物品（[b]仅限服务器端[/b]）：建造缺少物品时自动获取。

- 在「精炼」中制造，可选择制造难度。

  - 最易：草x1。

  - 容易：猪皮x5 + 一本科技。

  - 正常：金矿x10 + 猪皮x10 + 二本科技。

  - 较难：金矿x20 + 猪皮x10 + 暗夜燃料x5 + 一本魔法。

  - 更难：金矿x40+ 猪皮x10 + 暗夜燃料x20 + 二本魔法。

  - 补充：如果同时开启了「自动堆满」和「恢复新鲜」，则额外需要紫宝石x1。





### Introduction



- This is a MOD for game *Don't Starve Together*.

- Adding a 8x8 big bag into the game.

- Standalone textures and UI.

- Can be putted into the inventory bar.

- May have conflicting BUGs with mod *stack 999* etc.

- Several configurable functions:

  - Full stack: Get full stack when reopen the bag.

  - ReFresh: ReFresh food and tools when reopen the bag.

  - Walk speed: Change walk speed while taking this bag.

  - Light: Let the bag give off light to survive in the night.

  - Give Items: Give Items Directly If Can't Build Something. [b]!!! SEVER ONLY !!![/b]

- Make it in REFINE menu. Configurable Recipe Options:

  - Very Cheap: cutgrass x1

  - Cheap: pigskin x5

  - Normal: goldnugget x10 + pigskin x10

  - Expensive: goldnugget x20 + pigskin x10 + nightmarefuel x5

  - More Expensive: goldnugget x40 + pigskin x10 + nightmarefuel x20

publishedfiledetails.title: Repair Combine
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
With this mod you can repair your equipment with the same equipment.

So you can combine a logsuit with 10% and a logsuit with 30% to a logsuit with 40%!

[u]This mod works for things with:[/u]
[b]finiteuses (like weapons), armor, fueled and perishable+equipable[/b].

Added in modsettings "bonus durability". By default it is off.
You can choose from +1% to +10% or even randomly. Also negative bonus is possible, if you prefer.
So when combining a 30% item and a 40% item, you may get an item with up to 80% if you wish so.

Also works correctly for stackables like Bull Kelp Stalk and mod items.


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198102311542/myworkshopfiles/?appid=322330] [h1][u]Also take a look at other mods I made, see my workshop ;)[/u][/h1] [/url]

DS version from another author:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1532277729


[u]Update 12.12.2019:[/u]
- Added option to disable/enable repair-combine for specific components. (all enabled by default)
So if you want to be able to repair-combine weapons/tools (finiteuses) but not anything fuelable or perishable, you can change the settings accordingly.

- Added option to also increase the max values! (disabled by default)
A spear usually has a max usage of 150. 
If this setting is enabled, and you combine 2 full spears, you will get one spear with 300 of 300 uses (will still show 100%). 
If you combine instead a spear with 100 uses left (66.6%) and a spear with 60 uses left (33.3%), you will get a spear with 160 of 160 uses left (100%).
For fueled items, like a lantern, this means after combinging eg. 10 full lanters, the new lantern can hold 10 times more fuel.
I highly recommend a mod like "Insight" to show you the current/max uses of an item, since the percentages will be confusing with these "overmax" settings enabled.


In case I get inactive and do not respond to bugfixes/feature requests, everyone is free to fork this or other of my mods to fix/expand them, but please link to the original. As long as I'm responding also feel free to write new/better code for it and I may upload it and add you as author if you want.

publishedfiledetails.title: Carney
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=950485476][Click here for the single-player version][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/yi5E6p3ZHlvGYAh.jpg[/img]

Traveling Carney Cat
Possesses agile combat skills
Upgrade by walking and eating fish, with no level cap!
Easy to obtain increased gathering and killing drop multipliers
Can craft convenient and practical hats, shortswords, and backpacks
——Even death can't stop me from leveling up by walking!!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Initial Attributes:[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/VNiFLMuI14KPtGQ.png[/img]
Each stat starts at 100, with a 25% movement speed bonus
Stats increase with level
Cold-sensitive - enters cold state earlier

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Infinite Leveling:[/h1]
Experience points (exp) to level up
Press J to view level and experience points

Gaining experience points gradually while walking
Gain experience points at a 1:1 ratio with monster's health when killing monsters
Eating fish dishes grants a large amount of experience points and additionally restores sanity

The experience cap increases with level
Leveling up increases stat caps, with each level granting +2 Hunger limit, +1 Sanity limit, and +1 Health limit
Also affects character skills and significantly restores health (20%)
No level cap

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Active Skills:[/h1]
[h3]——Dodge - Press R[/h3]
A small jump at the moment of pressing, entering an invincible state, negating all damage
A very short acceleration effect at the moment of pressing
Dodge has no cost
Character level affects the duration of the invincible state
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/4dvQWGoiqOBEyZr.gif[/img]

[h3]——Charge - Press Z[/h3]
Empower the equipped item
Enhance the next attack by a certain multiplier, consuming 5 hunger after the attack
The charged state also emits a small range of light
Character level affects the damage multiplier of charge
Cancel charge when switching or unequipping the item
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/q5FJ89pcGVahdHs.gif[/img]

[h3]——Ice Pillar/Blast - Press C[/h3]
Consume 15 hunger to create an ice pillar on the ground
Creatures within range will be slowed down and the temperature will drop sharply
Press C again to detonate at the location of the ice pillar
Causes damage to creatures within range, with more creatures leading to higher damage
Damage can be enhanced by the "Charge" skill
Character level affects the damage of the blast
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/JHsFeaxRSVy1Kbp.gif[/img]

[h1]Passive Skills:[/h1]
[h3]——Gathering[/h3]
The higher the character level, the easier it is to obtain more items when gathering
An additional item is gained every 35 levels
The higher the character level, the easier it is to obtain more drops when killing
The probability is level/100, and after level 100, it is fixed at double drops
[h3]——Pet Never Hungry[/h3]
Summoned pets will not be hungry, and you will never hear the pet's hungry howl

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Exclusive Crafting:[/h1]
[h3]——White Beret[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/tBzAmUDTHYgEr34.png[/img]
Born with one, brain recovery +3 per minute, warmth 120, durability is the same as the Walrus Hat

[h3]——Breeze Dagger[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/wkfY3s18eGJSrgq.png[/img]
Increases movement speed by 25%, base attack power 27
Has a faster attack speed
There is a 30% chance to deal double damage with a critical hit
Inserting a dog tooth will automatically consume one dog tooth to repair 100% durability when low on durability
At 0 durability, there is a 100% critical hit, but the downside is a stumble
Enhance with gold blocks, each 5 gold increases attack power by 1
——As long as I pay, I am the boss

[h3]——Nylon Backpack[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/y12GLDOYtf9SWpN.png[/img]
Capacity of 14 slots
Warmth equals that of a Horned Hat (240), rain resistance 20%

[hr][/hr]

[h1]V2.0.0 Major Update:[/h1]

[h3]New - Learning Device[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/30/u5TeCBwiR4KZQno.png[/img]
A versatile tool
Equip and right-click to open
Insert different tools to learn different functions and efficiencies
Currently supports learning functions: chop, chisel, dig, hammer, net, paddle, hoe, burn, fork, fresh water fishing, increase movement speed, teleport
Insert gold blocks to speed up work (100 blocks to max)
Removing the item cancels the corresponding function

[h3]New - HuHu minifan[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/yIDXixptmeAQgL2.png[/img]
Speed increase by 15%
Equipped allows walking on water，can extinguish fire
Slowly restores the freshness of surrounding items and adjusts the temperature of surrounding characters while running
Feeding any food adds durability based on the absolute value of hunger and health, and durability can exceed the limit
Feeding is in stacks, and the effects of the food will take effect after feeding, such as glowing berries

[h3]New - Fluffy Ear Hat[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/yhIG72Yg38F1Sf5.png[/img]
Made with a White Beret and a Walrus Hat
Warmth equals that of a Horned Hat (240), brain recovery 9 points per minute, durability equals that of a Walrus Hat
Additional 3 item slots, can be filled with fur items, enhancing warmth when inserted

[h3]New - Encyclopedia of Everything Cat Edition[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/PqNLZfApa9OXykt.png[/img]
Reading grants inspiration points, which can accumulate
With points, unlock Science Two, Magic Two, and Navigation Technology
Unlocking a new technology reduces points by 1
Compared to the Grandma Edition, the benefit is knowing which technology is not unlocked

[h3]New - Quiet Whistle[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/25/GqTyYCfenvkbaH7.png[/img]
Using it causes a small treasure house to emerge from the ground, a private cloud box, 15 slots
Different players see different items stored when opened
When closed, the items inside are preserved like they are packed with wrapping paper, permanently fresh
Switching worlds does not affect the items stored inside

[h3]New - Experience Retention[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/2sUwGqKNktxYRPC.png[/img]
After reselecting or turning into a monkey, a shadow is left on the spot, which can only be picked up by oneself at first, and can be given to others after being picked up by oneself
After picking up, only the Carney Cat character can use it, and using it adds the experience points in the shadow to the current Carney Cat character
The durability of the shadow represents the experience points and level

[h3]Change - Breeze Short Sword[/h3]
Can upgrade in stacks with gold
Separate upgrade and repair, equipped allows right-clicking to open and insert dog teeth, automatically consumes one dog tooth to repair 100% durability when low on durability
At 0 durability, there is a 100% critical hit, but the downside is a stumble
Upgrading with gold no longer changes the short sword's durability limit
Axe function removed

[h3]Change - Other[/h3]
Skill Ice Pillar/Blast: Ice Pillar's freshness restoration function removed.
White Beret: Upgrading with Walrus Hat function removed.
Effects: Optim
ized jump and level-up effects.

[h3]Optimization - BUG Fixes[/h3]
Fixed room crash.
Fixed crash when dismantling mushroom farms with a disintegration wand.
Fixed slow attack speed of Breeze Short Sword with delay compensation enabled.
Multiple times gathering supports Monkey Grass, Banana Bush, and Shadow Harvester.
Players can gain experience if they hit the monster within 5 seconds before it dies.

IJN Destroyer Hibiki, from Kantai Collection, or Kancolle.
(My mods are not skin compatible, aka they can't use alternate clothing besides gloves, pants/skirts, and shoes, because of the body proportions being different/taller from the default player proportions. It's not something I can fix.)

[Latest version: v1.5.0b]
(Please update to the latest version before giving feedback, thank you!)

[Stats (Classic Mode)]
Health: 200
Hunger: 150
Sanity: 100

[Traits/Perks]
General Winter: High cold resistance from being in the Russian Navy.
Survivor's Guilt: 10% more sanity loss when alone, gains sanity when near other players. 
Phoenix's Resilience: Starts with 200 health, takes 10% less damage.

[Trustworthy]
As of version 1.3.0, Hibiki now starts with lower stats, but each point of damage you take to your health and sanity contributes to an experience system. She can now level up up to 10 times. Each time you level up, Hibiki will usually say a different line depending on your current level and your base stats are increased by 5 (aside from sanity). If other perks are activated, they will also grow stronger as Hibiki levels up. Once Hibiki reaches level 10, she will transform into Verniy, with extra stats and powered-up versions of her own perks. There are two modes, Easy Mode (which is the default) and Hard Mode. In easy mode, if you die above level 5, Hibiki's level will be decreased by 1 when she gets revived, and her exp gets reset to 0. In hard mode, dying will reset your level to 0.

[Stats and Perks (Trustworthy Mode)]
Health: 150 >> 200
Hunger: 100 >> 150
Sanity: 100

General Winter: Medium cold resistance >> High cold resistance.
Survivor's Guilt: 15% more sanity loss when alone >> 5% more sanity loss when alone.
Phoenix's Resilience: Takes 10% less damage >> Takes 20% less damage.
Verniy: Gets a 25% attack boost and moves 1.1x faster.

If you prefer the old version, Trustworthy can be toggled off in the configurations, and she will play exactly like pre 1.3.0 Hibiki. Each of the perks can also be toggled on and off in the mod configurations.

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Actions - Full client mod
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod will automatically equip the tool fit for the task at hand, and more to come.

Also, this is a client mod, which means that only you, the actual player, not any server, needs it. You can join ANY server and it'll still be working.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A2HB41n.gif[/img]

A few examples of the mod's features:
- Hold space and get everything done without removing your finger.
- If any tools are needed for a task and you don't have it, the mod will automatically try to craft it for you.
- If enabled, you can re-fuel fires by right-clicking on the firepit.
- If you want a specific tool or weapon, mod or not, as your primary weapon, just equip it, hold down ctrl and press this mod's settings menu button, then you will automatically equip that tool or weapon when you attack something.
- Hovering your mouse over tasks which requires tools you don't have, will show a (Craft ****) option, which will craft the needed tool for you.
- If you have a nut from the same tree-type you are digging up a stump from, then it will replant the nut automatically.
- You can specify if you prefer normal or golden tools in the settings.
- Attack and enemy and it'll equip your best weapon.
- Attack a critter and it'll use a boomerang, if you have one. (Not on by default)
- Stand in the darkness and it'll equip a light-source, if one exists in your inventory, but it can also craft one for you automatically. (Not on by default)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zjzpXGL.gif[/img]

Do notice:
- If you assigned a tool or weapon as your primary and you disconnected, then you'll have to reassign it.
- Holding space won't dig up saplings, bushes and such, but can be overwritten by also holding down CTRL.
- You tool type(normal/golden) can be overwritten by holding the CTRL button and hovering over a task that needs a tool.
- It won't automatically crafting nor show the crafting option, if you don't have the required materials or knowledge(made a prototype).
- If you let go of space after having digged the stump up, then it'll reset and won't replant the tree.
- If you wish to attack with a specific weapon while the feature is on, just equip the desired weapon/tool before fighting.
- There's in-game settings for the weapon, critter, etc. features, should you not wish to use them.
- Many of these functions are turned off by default, so you'll have to click on Mods and configure the features as you want them.

List of mods automatically supported in the mod:
"[DST]-Scythes" - "Will equip a scythe to cut grass and such, if you have a scythe in your inventory."

If any bugs comes up or there's something you would like to get implemented, then leave a comment here and I'll take a look at it.
Or if you have any ideas for improvements or compatibility with other mods, then feel free to post it too and I'll see what I can do :)

This mod is based on Auto-Equip, made by noobler, but has been fully modified, expanded and made into a client-mod by Jespercal (Me).

[h1]~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/h1]
[i][b]If you like this mod, give it a rate or [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/jespercal/myworkshopfiles/]check out my other mods[/url]
If you like my mod(s) and want to support me, then you are welcome to buy me a coffee :)
[url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/jespercal][img]https://i.imgur.com/4dtQGnp.png[/img][/url][/b][/i]

publishedfiledetails.title: MyPet
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]Overall system[/b][/h1]
- Pets have Level and Mood system.
- Pets have common skills and unique skills.
- Pets have container.
- Your pet will help your work. (collect,woodcutting,mining)

[h1][b]Level[/b][/h1]
- Level : Max is 6 
- At levels up, slightly increases size. and pet's skills unlock by each levels up.
- Pet's basic damage increase 4 per level. (4-8-12-16-20-24)
- Pets get 'GP' by a food and If food is good or favorite, there is more chance. (random)
- Pets get 'GP' by kill a enemy with owner or theselves. (30% chance)

[h1][b]Mood[/b][/h1]
- Mood : keep change 0 ~ 100.
- Mood icon color : symbolizes the current mood.
- the mood will changes skills power or cooldown and can use it or not.
- The pets mood affect by these things : hungry, food value, working, skill, combat, sleep, etc.

[h1][b]Common skill[/b][/h1]
- Adds common skills per level.
[b]Level 1[/b]: Collecting work,Woodcuting,Mining.
[b]Level 2[/b]: Pleasant touch. (+1sanity, when you touch your pet.)
[b]Level 3[/b]: Sanity Aura (more sanity at level 6)
[b]Level 4[/b]: Energy Shield (Owner health less than 30%)
[b]Level 5[/b]: Healing spell (limited : 20 mood)
[b]Level 6[/b]: Summon spell (limited : 70 mood)
(skills : more chance and more power and more short cooldown in high mood)

[h1][b]Unique Ability[/b][/h1]

[h1]Kittykit[/h1]
[b]Cat's gift[/b] - Cat give a gift to owner if you feed him.
[b]Critical hit[/b] - Cat can critical attack (no-cost, increase damage per level, mood70)
[b]Fighter[/b] - Cat always can attack enemies with owner.
[b]Nimble finger[/b] - Cat can pick up items very faster than other pets.
[b]Fisher[/b] - Cat can fishing with owner.
[b]Cannery[/b] - Cats can make canned food with fish.

[h1]Vargling: Pure soul[/h1]
[b]Pure soul[/b] - When Hound enemy dies, a ghost pup will be summoned.(cooltime, mood40)
[b]Ice tooth[/b] - puppy can freeze attack (no-cost, increase freeze per level, mood70)
[b]Fighter[/b] - puppy always can attack a enemy with owner.
[b]Nimble finger[/b] - puppy can pick up items very faster than other pets.

[h1]Ewelet[/h1]
[b]Count sheep[/b] - Enemy will fall asleep. (around,cooltime, mood70, no target : giant)
[b]yawn[/b] - Enemy will fall asleep, if hit pets owner. (cooltime, mood40, no target : giant)
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]Giblet[/h1]

[b]Nimble toe[/b] - she can pick up items a little faster than other pets.
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]Broodling[/h1]
[b]Cooker[/b] - put any food into the container, food will be cooked. also logs turn into charcoal.
[b]Flame breath[/b] - Enchanting fire weapon. (adds 20 fire damage, mood70)
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]Glomglom[/h1]
[b]Firefly[/b] - glows at night.
[b]Frost moon[/b] - Enchanting freeze weapon. (freeze 55 ,adds 5damage, mood70)
[b]Fresh wind[/b] - If you feed 'ice cream' or 'watermelon icycle' to pets, the food will refresh in his container.
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]Lunarmoth[/h1]
[b]Frostwind[/b] - Freeze spell
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]eyeofterror[/h1]
[b]Lightning[/b] - Lightning spell
[b]Brave[/b] - Pet can attack a enemy itself if the owner's health less than 50%

[h1]Woby[/h1]
[b]Same as pupington(puppy)[/b]
[b]Big woby[/b] - taunt

[h1]Abandon[/h1]
*You can abandon your pet by right-clicking near the critter cave (very close)

[h1]Character[/h1]
- Pets will find something to eat on their own if they are hungry. But if they are feeling bad, the pets just steal some food and eating.
- Pet refuses food if their hunger is over than 95%.

[h1]Mod Option[/h1]
- Mood System  : On(Default) / Full mood(always)
- Level System  : On(Default) / Off / Full Level
- Unique Skill     : On(Default) / Off
- Collect stuff     : On(Default) / Off

[h1][Mod crash?!!][/h1]
[ plz check first ] : incompatible mods
=> remove all other mod => active only MyPet=> check your crash 
=> if you have a problem, show me your crash log in [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1275167632/1692659135910465270/]Bug report[/url][/b]

publishedfiledetails.title: Gawr Gura
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]HololiveEN: Gawr Gura[/h1]
	
	
[h1]What is this mod?[/h1]
	It adds HololiveEN Vtuber, Gawr Gura in DST.
	SHAAAAAAAARRRRRRRKKKKKK!

	[img] https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1665736384471740335/A0D8CCB29259086DB3F4F2AE41A4F80DDFB48B6A/ [/img]

[h1]Default Stats[/h1]

[img]https://imgur.com/Q24kQJH.png[/img]

[b]There is a huge config file enjoy it how you like it![/b]

[h1]A[/h1]

	Apex Predator.

	She gets hungry faster, but she will move faster on both land and water.
	She will also gain 20% more hunger when eating fish related food.

	Her base health is pretty small so you might want to be careful.

	She can also befriend Merms, but Pigs hates her.(Editable in the config!)
	Rabbits acts similar to normal characters towards her.

	Gura can craft Merm houses.

[h1]Hydrodynamic[/h1]

She can swim but only with a float. No one else can use them other than Gura.
She moves 20% faster on the water than on land because she is hydrodynamic.
Wetness also gives her sanity (If adjusted in the config). But getting wet will make food soggy.

[img]https://imgur.com/wC2ndMS.gif[/img]

[h1]Items[/h1]

	[b]Gura's Float[/b]
	[img]https://imgur.com/G3srTwS.png[/img]

	[b]Recipe[/b]
	[img]https://imgur.com/ZoTI0AF.png[/img] x 6

-----------------------------------------------------------

	[b] Trident [/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/ufriXEE.png [/img]

	[b]Recipe[/b]
    Multiple version that can be chosen in the config
[list]
    [*]Cheap
	[img]https://imgur.com/aMOj7kP.png[/img] x 3 [img]https://imgur.com/KpheKoT.png[/img] x 4 [img]https://imgur.com/zS5LX1c.png[/img] x 1

	[*]Regular (The default recipe)
	[img]https://imgur.com/WABsS4R.png[/img] x 3 [img]https://imgur.com/KpheKoT.png[/img] x 4 [img]https://imgur.com/zS5LX1c.png[/img] x 1
	
	[*]Expensive
	[img]https://imgur.com/0AxtGAA.png[/img] x 1 [img]https://imgur.com/WABsS4R.png[/img] x 1 [img]https://imgur.com/zS5LX1c.png[/img] x 1
[/list]

(Almost everything is editable in the config)
[b][Strengths][/b]
Durability is a lot longer than a strident.
Spell damage is double of your normal hit's damage.
Possible to hit a single target multiple times with 1 spell.
Its damage is double when the user is on water.
Can be both Range and Melee.
Does splash damage which can hit multiple targets with 1 spell.
Doesn't damage followers as long as they are yours.

[b][Weakness][/b]
Kinda hard to aim and has a high chance of missing due to the slow animation.
Might enjoy using too much and break it. The durability isn't unlimited unless set in the config.
The casting animation is kinda slow. You might get killed if you don't distance yourself.
Normal hit damage is only as strong as a spear on land.
Other characters can't use it.

[b][Sample of the Trident's Spell][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/QdOGeAM.gif[/img]


[h1]Controller support[/h1]
[b][Trident won't damage gura's "chumbuds" (Except for normal attack)][/b]
[b]NOTE: It will work only if they are tamed or else they will get damaged!!![/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/7hLC37U.gif[/img]

NOTE: Possible problem
Older item infos that are outdated don't support tridents including a Strident Trident.
I've changed how it sets damage now so other item info should work,
 but if they don't I would suggest using Ryuu's Item info instead.

The item info might not update the damage value of the trident when on water, 
but I can assure you that it will do twice the damage on water regardless of what item info says.
Link:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=836583293


[h1] Jinx [/h1]
There is a random chance that she would jinx herself when near a hostile mob except for bosses and shadow creatures!
Basically an RNG taunt. Be careful!

[img]https://imgur.com/tt27M9I.png[/img]


[h1] Bloop [/h1]
[img]https://imgur.com/cf2K56B.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/Op60P54.gif[/img]
The Emergency Ration. 

Bloop is just a pet with bonus perks.
If Gura starves (0 hunger) bloop will die and become [img]https://imgur.com/vwlP2T5.png[/img].
Bloop also emits a small positive sanity aura.
[spoiler]In the future update bloop can be freed...[/spoiler]

[b]Recipe[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/uM5NOPj.png[/img] x 1 [img]https://imgur.com/EeMbnJY.png[/img] x 4

[h1] Possible Problem [/h1]
Since the swimming mechanic is kinda tricky and is something I'm still experimenting on.
If you find any bug please do tell me in the bug report section.


[h1]To-do[/h1]
[olist]
	[*][strike]Wetness when on water and prevent wet items from draining sanity.[/strike]
    [*][strike]Add Bloop.[/strike]
	[*]Add Bloop's freedom.
    [*]Other Hololive Members.
[/olist]
	

Join the Chumbuds/Shrimps
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoSrY_IQQVpmIRZ9Xf-y93g

Any bug or weird stuff please tell me! I might be busy, but I'll see what I can do!
There is a bug report discussions tab just report it there. I don't read comments often so I might miss it.

ZeroRyuk
