publishedfiledetails.title: Rin Kaenbyou | Touhou Project
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][i]Rin Kaenbyou[/i][/h1]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Rin is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Rin is a feline demon with an energetic and positive personality. Her main occupation is carrying away the dead into The Underworld where she tosses them into the Hell of Blazing Fires to rekindle it and make it's power stronger.

One night, she was driving away vengeful spirits from the underground until she discovered a strange field, filled with corpses. As she was about to collect those unfortunate souls, a massive explosion occured at the site.

She has gone missing ever since... [/i]

[i]- Base Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]300[/b]
Hunger: [b]150[/b]
Sanity: [b]150[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Servant of The Underworld][/b]

Your cat senses activate at Night, becoming nearly immune to The Darkness.
You are also slightly more resistant to Sanity draining effects.
You get slightly increased damage against most enemies.

Your night vision is very poor.
Becoming hungry will negatively affect your powers.

[b][Quick Reflexes][/b]

You walk and run around slightly faster.
You are slightly more resistant to slow and cold effects.

The effect becomes weaker the hungrier you are.

[b][Fishy Love][/b]

Eating fish restores a moderate amount of every stat.
Each fish will also permanently increase your Maximum Health by 1.
Cooked fish restores all stats for twice the amount.

After you hit the Maximum HP cap, the effect no longer works.
You get hungry a lot faster.
The effectivness of your other perks is based on how hungry you are.

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Eye Bone[/b]
[b]Crow Feather[/b]
[b]Nightmare Fuel[/b]

[i]-Weakneses-[/i]

[b]The positive effects of your perks will turn into negative effects if you are hungry.[/b]

[b]Perks provide very small stat boosts and they are only relevant in the early stages of the game.[/b]

[b]While the Darkness no longer instantly kills you, you still can't see anything at night.
Don't abuse it, you are competely exposed and vulnerable when the lights go out.[/b]

[b]You have to rely on fishing as a primary tool for survival.
You get hungry often so you have to make a choice between eating to restore only Hunger right away or keep the fish for a long time for possible enemy encounters.[/b]

[b]It will take a lot of time and effort to get enough additional health for it to start making a difference.
There's a limit to how much you can increase your Maximum Health and after you hit it, the fish no longer gives any additional benefits.[/b]

[i]- Changelog -[/i]

(Last Update: 28.12.2016 - Version 1.3.8)

Version 1.0.0 - Uploaded to Steam Workshop.
Version 1.0.1 - Cleaned up mod files.
Version 1.1.0 - Updated for newer versions of the game.
Version 1.1.1 - Various tweaks and fixes.
Version 1.2.0 - Fixed the stats being higher than intended.
Version 1.2.1 - Small tweaks.
Version 1.3.0 - Actually nerfed this time.
Version 1.3.1 - Fixed Maximum Health resetting after dying and disconnecting.
Version 1.3.6 - Removed some leftover code from older builds.
Version 1.3.8 - Minor tweaks for better compatibility with the "A New Reign" update.

[i]- Frequently Asked Questions -[/i]

[b][Bug?][/b] This custom character is slightly taller than the default Don't Starve characters, so if you change out the clothes for the body, the head may appear as floating in the air. It's not really a bug, the game doesn't properly support larger character models, it's not easily fixable by me. I'm sorry, but just deal with it and stick to the default torso.

[i][b]Cheers, Good Luck and Have Fun! ;)[/b][/i]

publishedfiledetails.title: Loot Pump
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Catches items from the ground and throw them in containers. (Autoloot)

Recipe: 1 Gears, 1 Whirly Fan and 2 Electrical Doodads.

The Loot Pump always priorise to launch the items on containers that already has that item inside.

There are two placement rings, the inner ring defines the looting region and the outer ring defines the container region.
NOTE: If the option "Two Zones" is activated, containers in the inner ring will not be considered by the Loot Pump.

If any empty container is found in the range, the Loot Pump will throw the loots in a random container in the range, which causes the item falls on ground. This can be intentionally used to make transport lines from multiple Loot Pumps.

The range, looting speed and the sound effects can be configured.

#Changelog:


v1.10:
-- Added an option to items being looted go through walls.

v1.09:
-- Added extra verification steps

v1.08:
-- Removed Pumpkin Lantern removed from the "look for items" list.
-- Targets with the tag "birds", "trap", "canbetrapped" and "smallcreature" will not be looted anymore.
-- Now the Loot Pump double-check the item "existence". This should reduce the incompatibility with mod that combine stacks.

v1.07:
-- Removed Life Giving Amulet from the "look for items" list. (Thanks for the suggestion @greeking13)
-- Added the option "Loot Equipment" (default: "Yes") on the mod configuration menu.
-- -- If this option is set to "No" the Loot Pump will not loot equipable items.

v1.06:
-- Removed Celestial Orb from the "look for items" list.

v1.05:
-- Removed Tooth Trap, Bee Mine and Bramble Trap from the "look for items" list.

v1.04:
-- Removed Thermal Stone, Glommer's Flower, Trap, Bird Trap, Tallbird Egg and Red Lantern from the "look for items" list.

v1.03:
-- Improved the container priority for the looting:
-- -- Now the priority is: Has a similar item > Will reduce the perish rate > Not full > Random;
-- Removed Woby, Chester and Hutch from the "look for containers" list;
-- Removed Lantern, Eyebone and Star-Sky from the "look for items" list.

publishedfiledetails.title: Shiro | No Game No Life
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][i]Shiro[/i][/h1]

[b][Disclosure] I was commisioned to make this mod, thanks to the person who made this happen![/b]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Shiro is one of the main characters from the anime: "No Game, No Life".

[i]One day, Shiro and her brother Sora were playing videogames, until a mysterious being claiming to be a god transported them into a fantasy world.
There they were faced with many challenges along the way, but nothing was a match for the legendary gamer duo, which eventually allowed them to rule over an entire kingdom.
The new queen of games Shiro suddenly stumbled upon a dark portal, curious to see what's beyond it, so she entered it alone.
Now she finds herself trapped in Don't Starve Together, while for others this grim world is quite unpleasant, for Shiro it's just another game. [/i]

[i]- Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]120[/b]
Hunger: [b]90[/b]
Sanity: [b]75[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Level Up!][/b]

[i]You become stronger with each enemy you defeat.[/i]

Killing an enemy grants you a permanent boost of +1 to all base stats.
You can only double your starting stats.

[b][Genius][/b]

[i]Your knowledge has no limits, if you're in the mood.[/i]

You gain a bonus to crafting items, based on your current Sanity.
The more Sanity you have, the more things you remember how to craft.
The less Sanity you have, the more things you forget how to craft.

[b][Cuteness Overload][/b]

[i]You are so adorable, enemies feel bad for hitting you.[/i]
[i]Unfortunately, if they do decide to hit you, you get tired much faster.[/i]

You take less damage, if you are unarmed.
You take more damage if you have a weapon equipped.
Every time you take a hit from an enemy, it also drains your Hunger.

[b][Hidden Perk][/b]

You always carry a hidden plushie of your brother, which grants you a passive bonus: 

+10% Hunger Resistance
+10% Sanity Drain Resistance
+3% Cold Resistance
+3% Movement Speed

[spoiler]You can type in /bonesaw to play with your brother (Works only if you have no custom gloves on)[/spoiler]

[i]- Weakneses -[/i]

[b]Low starting stats.[/b]
[b]Can't take to many hits at once, or else you will be hungry very fast.[/b]
[b]Relies on killing mobs early on to acquire a decent amount of strength.[/b]
[b]Doesn't have her brother around.[/b]

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Golden Axe[/b]
[b]Golden Shovel[/b]
[b]Golden Pickaxe[/b]
[b]Gears[/b]

[i]- Changelog -[/i]

(Last Update: 14.01.2017 - Version 1.0.7)

Version 0.8.8 - Allowed Shiro to play with her brother.
Version 0.9.0 - Made the character model mostly compatible with custom clothes, mostly.
Version 0.9.5 - Fixed that fancy hair color effect not changing based on lighting.
Version 1.0.0 - Steam Workshop Official Release.
Version 1.0.1 - Minor tweaks for better compatibility with other mods.
Version 1.0.2 - Removed some placeholder stuff and cleaned up mod files.
Version 1.0.3 - Fixed a bug where upgraded stats won't update properly.
Version 1.0.4 - Applied a solution to force changes to character stats to update more aggressively.
Version 1.0.5 - Character perk effects now reapply when you reload the game or go in and out of the Caves.
Version 1.0.6 - Fixed the game crashing while preloading character attributes.
Version 1.0.7 - Fixed Level Up! perk giving way too many stats.

[b][BUG?][/b]Due to the way stuff is coded, there appears to be a sort of a built-in delay on applying character stat changes, so what happens is when you kill an enemy your stat upgrade will not be displayed right away.
I have no idea what is causing this weird interaction, this might be just the way the game works, or it's just a update delay from other mods that show more info about your stats.
Don't worry, the upgrade perk does actually work and saves your new stats, but what you need to do is make it so that there is a change in your current stats, so for example: 
After you kill some monsters, if you eat something that heals you, or you take any damage - your new maximum Health with be updated and displayed correctly, if you get hungrier or lose sanity - it will show you your new stats.
Thankfully, this issue is mostly visual only and fixes itself during gameplay.
I highly recommend you to download any mod that gives you more info about your stats (like [b]Combined Status[/b], for example) and keep an eye on your maximum stats.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience this might have caused and thank you for playing with my mods and reporting bugs!

Also, check out my DST Touhou Characters: 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701414094

[i][b]Cheers, Good Luck and Have Fun! ;)[/b][/i]

publishedfiledetails.title: [OUTDATED] Complete Your Map
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
THIS MOD IS (sadly) OUTDATED. For working version, go to this one : 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=672584952

Displays additional info on the map

Currently displaying :

- Rabbit holes and mole burrows
- Beefalos (yound and adults)
- Lightning goats
- Ewecus
- Animal tracks
- Koalefant and Warg
- Giants (Rog, Treeguard, Spider Queen, Minautor and Rock Lobster)
- Hounds and Hound Mounds
- Mushrooms
- Mandrakes
- Planted carrots
- Light Flower
- Fireflies
- Pig heads
- Spiky bushes
- Totally normal trees
- Pighouses
- Chester's eyebone
- The Codex Umbra
- All bones and skeletons, including dead players
- Flints
- Walls
- All "things"
- Ancient pseudoscience stations
-Many Mobs

If you want or need something to be displayed on the map that I could have forgotten, don't hesitate to ask, I'd be happy to help. 

Note that this mod won't crash when used along with other mods like Where's My Beefalo or Gold Boulder Map Icon, but the map will be more confused, as the mods add their own icons each time. So you can have the two, just make sure to disable in one mod what you enable on the other to guarantee the map's readability.

More screens coming soon !

In the end, I'd like to make my mod communicating with other clients to add a shared map discovery.

Thanks to Mikchael and his More Map Icons mod

publishedfiledetails.title: Admin Scoreboard+
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Client-side mod that adds command buttons to the scoreboard (TAB key by default) for server admins. You [b]must[/b] be an admin on the server and have the ability to execute remote console commands for this mod to work.

If the target player is on a different shard (surface/caves) than the admin sending the command, then the command [b]will not[/b] be executed and the admin will be teleported to the nearest cave entrance/exit.

[h1][b]Commands:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Goto[/b]: Teleports your player to the target player.
[*][b]Go Back[/b]: Shown instead of Goto button for yourself. It will teleport your player to a previous location where you executed a command that moved your player. Stores up to 3 positions for each surface and caves and saves the data to your player session for that world.
[*][b]Drop[/b]: Drops all items of the target player. As well, the target player cannot pick up any items on ground for 8 seconds by default (configurable).
[*][b]Kill/Revive[/b]: Kill/revives target player based on if they are a ghost or not. On revive, the target player's stats are set to full.
[*][b]Extinguish[/b]: Extinguishes all fires in a 10 tile radius around the target player.
[*][b]Toggle Godmode[/b]: Toggles godmode for the target player.
[*][b]Toggle Creative Mode[/b]: Toggles creative mode (all recipes) for the target player.
[*][b]Repair Nearby Burnt[/b]: Rebuilds nearby burnt structures from the target player. If the structure was skinned, the target player must own the skin or the default prefab will spawn.
[*][b]Reroll[/b]: Drops the items and then rerolls the target player, functioning the same as offering a Moon Rock Idol to the Celestial Portal (keep recipes, day count, map exploration, and critter). The target player must be on surface.
[*][b]Toggle Visibility[/b]: Hides your character; hides your character's shadow, indicator, and minimap icon; mutes your character's sounds and examine quotes; removes your character's collision box; makes your character not targetable; and turns on godmode. Limitations: Must be alive to toggle, ingame teleportation shows your character and cancels godmode, and light from equipped items (or WX-78 overcharge) will still show. Button available for yourself only.
[/list]
[h1][b]Additional Commands:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Gather[/b]: Teleports the target player to your player (Right click of Goto button, default is disabled).
[*][b]Super God Mode[/b]: Enables godmode of the target player and sets their stats to full (Right click of Toggle God Mode Button, default is disabled).
[*][b]Despawn[/b]: Drops the items and then despawns the target player (Right click of Reroll, always enabled).
[/list]

All commands are announced to the server (except Goto, Go Back, Gather, and Visibility commands) and are color-coded based on the admin that sent the command; the announcements can be disabled from the configuration options.

The drop, kill/revive, godmode, creative mode, repair nearby burnt, and despawn commands all have a confirm dialog box appear before executing the command; these confirm boxes can be disabled from the configuration options.

After you press the ban button, the target player will drop all items if they are on the same shard.

Hovering over the player names in the scoreboard will display their Klei ID.

Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url] mod.
Controller compatible.

[h1][b]Configuration Options:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Scoreboard Key Is Toggle[/b]: The scoreboard key will function like a toggle instead of a hold (Default: off).
[*][b]Enable Gather[/b]: Adds the Gather command as a right click action for the Goto button (Default: off).
[*][b]Enable Super God Mode[/b]: Adds the Super God Mode command as a right click action for the God Mode button (Default: off).
[*][b]Pickup Cooldown[/b]: After sending a drop command, how long (in seconds) is the target player unable to pickup any items (Default: 8 seconds).
[*][b]All Confirm Dialog Boxes[/b]: Confirm dialog boxes (for commands that use them) can be enabled/disabled.
[*][b]All Announcements[/b]: The announcement after a command is executed (for commands that are announced) can be enabled/disabled.
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/1290774114]Changelog[/url]

Special thanks:
[list]
[*] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198042467469]Artemiy[/url] for letting his admins test my mod on his dedicated servers ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/dstst]Strictly Unprofessional[/url]).
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198101670962/]Mr. Tarunio[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198032277590/]eXiGe[/url] for helping me test and debug the mod.
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Pickle's First Person Mod
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
See the world in true First-Person! Move the camera with the mouse and navigate inventory with the scroll wheel.
-Switch back to normal camera view at any time from the pause menu, or with Ctrl-Q!
 
Play Don't Starve the way it was never really meant to be played!
Take a look at the mod trailer above!  https://youtu.be/BuQFj8Xn9rg


[h1]CONTROLS[/h1]
While in first person, your cursor is replaced with a white selection reticle in front of you.
-Hold [Q] to temporarily unlock the mouse and move it normally, for crafting and inventory management.

-Use the scroll wheel to scroll though inventory slots, and the (E) and (R) keys to use/select inventory items.
-[E] will "use" whatever item is in the highlighted inventory slot (eat-food, equip-tools, examine-anything else)
-[R] will "select" the item in the highlighted inventory slot, holding it.
     ---with an item selected, you can then- click on a campfire to cook it, 
     ---click on the ground to drop it, 
     ---click on a chest to store it, ect.
     ---press R again to place that selected item back into the highlighted inventory slot.

-With ranged weapons equipped, your white circle will switch to a red one, and the range increases the more you tilt your view upwards.
-When taking damage, red directional indicators show which direction the damage came from.
	
A new button "switch camera" button is added to the pause menu, which will switch your view between first-person and regular top-down view. 
Ctrl-Q will also switch between normal and first-person view.


[b]-IMPORTANT NOTE FOR HOSTS-[/b]
------------------------------------------------------
(This mod is client-side, and enables first person view for only yourself for all server types, whether you're joining or hosting.

BUT, if you plan on hosting your own server WITHOUT caves enabled, you'll want to disable "simulate darkness" in the mod settings, otherwise you will be invisible to other players while in first-person.
-------------------------------------------------------


[b]MOUSE SENSITIVITY (and other things) CAN BE CHANGED IN THE "CONFIGURE MOD" MENU[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4SPbdU4.png[/img]
(And many other options available from the actual menu, including FOV and camera height)
- available for the singleplayer version as well!



[b](Quick-Guide): HOW TO COOK FOOD IN FIRST PERSON:[/b]
-use the mouse wheel to scroll to the food in your inventory
-press [R] to select it
-click on a campfire to cook it (keep clicking if you want to cook multiple things)
-press [R] again to place it back in your inventory


--MOD RUNNING SLOW?--
For older laptops that might struggle with this mod enabled, try raising the "shading refresh rate" setting in the mod config settings menu. If it's still too slow, disabling "simulate darkness" will speed everything up, but make night look... weird, to say the least.

HOTKEYS:
CTRL-Q: Switch between first/third person view
TAB: (default) opens controller crafting menu
Q:  Close any open chests

Thank you to LucaS for providing code for the shader to improve how sprite angles are displayed in first person!

If the mod breaks due to an update, let me know so I can fix it! I'm more likely to see comments on the youtube trailer than on steam.

publishedfiledetails.title: [DST] CookDiary
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Author: [i]Jerry[/i]; Version: 3.1.6; Workshop: 2893991859;
Search [b]CookDiary[/b] to subscribe to this mod!
[hr][/hr]
[b]Thanks to everyone who played, provided suggestions, and reported bugs![/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Open the cooking book and see what to eat today! Let the Cookbook help you magically AutoCook![/h1]

[list]
[*][b]1. Automatically read ingredients from the inventory and surrounding containers, calculate the currently available dishes and all recipes. [/b]
[/list]
[quote=Jerry][i]"Do you know which dish has the most cooking methods? [spoiler] [b]Meatball[/b]! 5229 ways to make it! [/spoiler]"[/i][/quote]
[list]
[*][b]2. Modified the detailed cooking information page on the right, adding practical information such as cooking pots and recipes. Compatiable with mod foods! [/b]
[/list]
[quote=Jerry][i]"The recipe for making [b]Fig-Stuffed Trunk[/b] is [b] (roasted/winter/summer) elephant trunks>0 (roasted) fig>0 [/b]..."[/i][/quote]
[list]
[*][b]3. The "What To Cook " page has been designed with a brand new sorting and filtering UI, which helps you find what is most suitable for cooking quickly. [/b]
[/list]
[quote=Jerry][i]"After exploring the ancient cave, my SANITY is empty and HEALTH is not much. Let me take a look at the Cookbook
... [b]Veggie Burger[/b] +30 HEALTH +33 SANITY. That's it! Delicious!"[/i][/quote]
[list]
[*][b]4. Select ingredients and cooker on the "Help Me Cook" page to automatically cook. [/b]
[/list]
[quote=Jerry][i]"Step 1, Choose Ingredients, Step 2, Choose Cookpot, Step 3, Confirm Result...
... Close the book, right-click, FLY!!"[/i][/quote]
[list]
[*][b]5. In the original recipe page, missing ingredients will be highlighted in red. [/b]
[/list]
[quote=Jerry][i]"Winter is coming. I'm freezing cold! I want to eat [b]Hot Dragon Chili Salad[/b] to warm up! Take a look at the cookbook!
I don't have any [b]dragon fruit[/b] at home! I can't eat anymore (╥_╥)!" [/i][/quote]

[h1] Guide of Autocook: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] On the "Help Me Cook" page of the Cookbook, select 4 ingredients you want to use
[*] On the "Help Me Cook" page of the Cookbook, select the cooker you want to use
[*] Close and equip the Cookbook, right-click on the blank space on the ground, and the circle indicator will appear
[*] Use the circle indicator to cover the cookers you want to use, then left click
[*] The 4 kinds of ingredients in your inventory and surrounding containers will fly towards the selected pots and automatically start cooking
[*] If the message "I don't have enough ingredients!" is displayed, it means that the ingredients (in the inventory and surrounding containers) are not enough to cook one dish
[*] If the message "No valid Cooker!" is displayed, it means that there are no available pots in the circle indicator
[/olist]

[h1]Special thanks:[/h1]
[*]Thanks to everyone who played, provided suggestions, and reported bugs!

[h1] Change log: [/h1]
[b] Version: 3.1.6 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Support wanyuan_cookpot from Hua Xian Zi.
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.5 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Support sakura rosepot from Xiaoying World
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.4 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issue where items like monstermeat and barnacles couldn't be cooked due to automatic stacking when launching them
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.3 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issue where the cookbook crashes when using it after using it in the ground and underground
[*] Fixed issue when the recipe image resource does not exist (improve compatibility)
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.2 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Add filter "Possessed Only"
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.1 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issue where ingredients are picked back by Lazy Forager amulet during flying
[*] Fixed issue where the magician's chest cannot be recognized
[*] Support the 2 types of cooking pots from Jingxi Home
[/olist]
[b] Version: 3.1.0 [/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed crash issue in original cookbook page when dishes have no base attributes
[*] Fixed ingredient count statistics
[*] Added support for Wilson's beard container
[*] Optimized collision effect when ingredients fly towards the cooker
[*] Optimized test function calling logic to prevent errors caused by non-standard mods
[*] Fixed issue where ingredients might be placed in the same slot in the cooker
[*] Added ingredient validity check to avoid mod conflicts
[*] Added cooker locking mechanism for autocooking
[*] Added actual completed cooking count display
[*] Fixed conflict with Wortox's soul jump action when equipping the Cookbook
[/olist]

[u] [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/change/2893991859] Historical changes [/url] [/u]

[h1] Suggestions for mods adding foods: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] The texture called by the Cookbook is [i]255 * 255[/i]. If this size of texture is not provided, the texture will appear blurry in the Cookbook.
[*] It is recommended to write the [i]test[/i] function for cooking in a more standardized way, otherwise [i]Craftpot[/i] and [i]CookDiary[/i] will not be able to recognize it (displayed as "unknown" in the "Recipe").
(1) Do not use [b]custom functions[/b] to determine [b]the quantity of ingredients[/b] (using [b]custom functions[/b] to judge seasons and holidays is ok);
(2) Only compare [i]name[/i] and [i]tag[/i] with numbers. DO NOT compare two [i]name[/i] ([i]tag[/i]) with each other, such as [i]tags. monster > tags.egg[/i].
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]
“I'm [b]Jerry[/b], who enjoys cooking various delicious dishes in DST.”

publishedfiledetails.title: Tools Are Fuels
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Get rid of all those axes and football helmets with 6% left.

This mod turns almost EVERY item with a durability amount into valid fire pit fuel, so that you can easily get rid of useless, mostly-broken tools. The burntime depends on the components of an item; most of the time, it will burn half as long as its component parts, more or less. There are a few exceptions, of course. For example, the only item with a durability that has NOT been turned into fuel is Scale Mail, for fairly obvious reasons.

If you encounter any tools which are not fuels (aside from aforementioned Scale Mail), please make a comment.

Check out my other mods!
http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=617951461

UPDATE v1.1: Removed a couple of print statements, nothing actually changed.
UPDATE v1.2: Turned appropriate items from A New Reign into fuels. They're all too expensive to want to burn them though, unless someone makes a bunch of saddlehorns or something for no reason.

publishedfiledetails.title: [API] Modded Skins
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
A new revamped version of the Modded Skins API comes to you. Bringing the ability for other mods to add their own skins for their custom characters and custom items! Even bringing along its own custom skin unlockable system for these modded skins.

[u]For your average user:[/u] 
This mod essentially does nothing on its own and will need the use of another mod that adds skins for full effect.
This mod does come with it's own unique glasses clothing slot with 3 pre-packaged glasses, but that is the only piece of content you will be getting from enabling this alone. This is an API, an Application Programming Interface, a piece of software that is meant to be used by other softwares/applications for full function, and has little to no function on it's own.

[u]For modders:[/u] 
If you're interested in seeing how to add your own skin, see the tutorial I've provided on the Klei forums here!
https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/140482-modded-skins-api-tutorial-creating-custom-skins-for-mods/

[b]Developers/Contributors:[/b]
-Fidooop: For creating the main foundation and base of the mod
-Cunning Fox: For creating the mechanics responsible for skinning modded items
-Hornet: For creating the custom skin unlockable system for modded skins and bringing the mod to release
-Erik: For providing nearly all of the art assets used for the mod.
-Willow: For providing the pre-packaged glasses skin assets.
-Crushcircuit: For providing two swap icon arts, thank you!

-Bombobbit: Spanish Translation

publishedfiledetails.title: Wormhole Icons (Fixed as of Sept 2023)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The wormhole map icons have been completely reworked. The old/new wormhole art is no longer used, and now each wormhole pairs' colors can be customized (Default rainbow). 

This is a client-side mod to mark corresponding wormholes. The original version was created by Ryuu, then a fixed version was added by eXiGe.

The colors that were previously "New" are labeled Exige, and the colors that were previously "Old" are labeled Ryuu. The "Skip" color will tell the mod to ignore that entry (go to the next color). Fully customizable RGB colors will perhaps be a feature in a future update.

If there are more wormhole pairs than set colors, the colors will cycle back to the beginning.

This version's changes:
- *NEW* Completely reworked the wormhole map icons, and colors can be customized now.
- *NEW* Fixed a crash that happens when the mod tries to show more than 10 pairs of wormholes
- Fixed a crash from the map zoom changes in the Curse of Moon Quay update (Code by  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/LatteMatcha]Matcha[/url])
- Fixed wormholes from older worlds not disappearing when you join a new one
- Added a size option for the icons on the map
- Fixed the color mismatch for the old style icons in the map vs world
- Fixed icons in the wrong spot after changing screen resolution
- Fixed a compatibility issue with Global Positions

If you want to reset the wormhole icons for a world, enter c_removeallwormholeicons() in the console and rejoin.

[u][b]If your game crashes or has other issues with this mod, please leave a comment with as many details as you can (which mods you're running, what settings you use, monitor/screen info if relevant).

The icon rendering on Minimap HUD is experimental. It works for my game but I have not tested everything. If this + Minimap HUD crashes your game, you can turn off this part of the mod with the bottommost option.

If there are a ton of problems and I can't fix them right away, I uploaded the previous version of this mod here that you can use meanwhile: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2883746194]BACKUP VERSION[/url][/b][/u]

------------------

Credits (Check the descriptions from Ryuu's and eXiGe's versions for more information about the functions of this mod):

publishedfiledetails.title: Slots Tweak & UI optimizer
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
(Original  Extra Equip Slots Plus)
[h1][b]The mod has now more functions![/b][/h1]

[h1]Slot Tweaks[/h1]
    - Add fully OPTIONAL backpack, amulet and compass slot to the game.
    - You can now change the number of inventory slots to whatever you want (down to 1, and better no more than 40 for UI issues)
    - Now overflow items will automatically to the opened container if you have more than one container equipped for some mods.
    - Move the snurtle shell, one man band and heavy items to back slot as they seems belong there.

[h1]Charater render optimization[/h1]
    - Backpacks will now always be rendered together with clothes when equipped
    - Either armor/clothes or amulet will be renderer, you can choose which to render in options
    - The compass will be rendered together with hand equipments when the compass slot is on. (some tools like lanterns may cover the compass because of the animation)

[h1]UI optimization[/h1]
    - The inventory bar will now automatically fit the slots number and the HUD scale setting
    - The craft bar will automatically resizing depending on the tabs number. (May go out of the screen if the HUD scale is too large)
    - The recipe popup will automatically resizing for mod recipes which have more than 3 ingredients.

This MOD is based on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=908528377]Extra Equip Slots API Edition[/url], with most of the code new or rewritten.

Q&A: 1.Why does this mod not compatible with 3rd party character or equipment mods?
Different mods has different implementation of render layers and textures. It is almost impossible to be compatible with those mods, as I need to write custom code or even override the code for each of them.

2. Not compatible with XX slots mod?
No need to enable those mods any more, as this mod already has that function.

publishedfiledetails.title: Health Regeneration
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod lets players regenerate their health when their hunger and sanity levels are above certain levels. As a trade-off they will lose hunger. With the default configuration, players whose  hunger levels are > 66 % and whose sanity levels are > 25 % will regenerate 15.5 health per in-game day (= 8 minutes) for a cost of 18.6 hunger. There is also a small arrow above the health indicator, showing when your health is currently regenerating.

This mod aims at making the game easier, especially for beginners. You can configure all the values – so it's up to you how fast the regeneration should happen, how much hunger it will drain, etc.

[b]You can find the singleplayer version of this mod [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=807680280]here[/url].[/b]

[h1]CONFIGURATION[/h1]
[b][u]Regeneration Rate:[/u][/b]
SLOW: ~ 0.6 HP/Minute
SLOWER: ~ 1 HP/Minute
NORMAL: ~ 2 HP/Minute
FASTER: ~ 4 HP/Minute
FAST: ~ 7.5 HP/Minute
REALLY FAST: ~ 15 HP/Minute

[b][u]Hunger Reduction Rate:[/u][/b]
(Formula: Actual Hunger Reduction = Reduction Rate x Regeneration Rate)
NONE: 0
SLOW: 0.8
SLOWER: 1
NORMAL: 1.2
FASTER: 1.6
FAST: 2

[b][u]Widget Enabled:[/u][/b]
This determines whether the regeneration indicator (= a small arrow above the health display) is shown.
YES: Widget is enabled
NO: Widget is disabled

[b][u]Required Hunger/Sanity:[/u][/b]
The hunger and sanity levels required for the regeneration to kick in.



[h1]BUGS & CRASHES[/h1]
If you encounter any bugs while playing with the mod, please report them in the comments/discussion section. I'll try to resolve the issues as soon as possible. If the mod crashes, [u]please post the [i]whole[/i] error log[/u] as well :)
On Windows, the error log is located at "C:\Users\<username>\Documents\Klei\DoNotStarveTogether"


[h1]LATEST CHANGES[/h1]
[b]1.4.6 (July 2020)[/b]
- Fixed a crash caused by Klei renaming some internal stuff
[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/457071756] Click here to see the full changelog[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: Raiden Shogun(雷电将军)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
这里是雷电将军的人物MOD，说起来这个MOD我应该很早就开始规划了，但是因为美术和特效的原因做了很久也没有做完...现在她总算是姑且算作完成了呢，可以和大家见面了
(如果喜欢的话能点个免费的赞吗，我会继续加油哒，谢谢)
(Could you please give a like to the MOD if you like it? I will carry on.Thanks!!!)

[h1] 此MOD必须包含“元素反应”和“Edited Anims”才可以运行[/h1]
[h1] The MOD dependent on "Element Reaction" and "Edited Anims"[/h1]

先还是介绍一下人物吧：
[h2]主要属性[/h2]
生命值上限130
精神上限150
饥饿上限250，但是她有1.5倍的饥饿速率

可以使用元素战技——“神变•恶曜开眼”，和元素爆发——“奥义•梦想真说”
[h2]神变•恶曜开眼[/h2]
雷电将军展开净土的一角，对周围的敌人造成雷元素伤害，为队伍中附近的所有角色授以「雷罚恶曜之眼」。
获授雷罚恶曜之眼的角色的攻击对敌人造成伤害时，雷罚恶曜之眼会进行协同攻击，在敌人的位置造成雷元素范围伤害。•获授雷罚恶曜之眼的角色在持续期间内，元素爆发造成的伤害获得提升，提升程度基于元素爆发的元素能量。每个队伍的雷罚恶曜之眼，每0.9秒至多进行一次协同攻击。由队伍中自己的角色以外的角色触发的协同攻击造成的伤害为原本的20%。
[h2]奥义•梦想真说[/h2]
汇聚万千真言，竭尽诸愿百眼之愿力，斩出粉碎一切诅咒的梦想一刀，造成雷元素范围伤害；并在接下来的一段时间内，使用「梦想一心」战斗。依据施放时消耗的诸愿百眼之轮的愿力层数，增加梦想一刀与梦想一心的攻击造成的伤害。在此状态下，雷电将军将使用刀进行攻击，并将普通攻击与重击造成的伤害转为无法被附魔覆盖的雷元素伤害，并在这些攻击命中敌人时，为队伍中附近的所有角色恢复元素能量。每1秒至多通过这种方式恢复一次元素能量，在持续期间内至多触发5次。梦想一心状态下，雷电将军的普通攻击与重击造成的伤害，视为元素爆发伤害。
[h2]诸愿百眼之轮[/h2]
队伍中附近的角色施放元素爆发时，会依据元素爆发的元素能量，为雷电将军的诸愿百眼之轮积攒愿力。至多积攒60层愿力。
[h2]万千的愿望[/h2]
队伍中附近的角色以非直接方式获得元素能量时，会为诸愿百眼之轮积攒2层愿力。该效果每3秒至多触发一次。
[h2]殊胜之御体[/h2]
基于元素充能效率超过100%的部分，每1%使雷电将军获 得下列效果：梦想一心状态提供的元素能量恢复提高0.6%；雷元素伤害加成提升0.4%。
[h2]天下名物狩[/h2]
制造单手剑和长柄武器时，返还50%的材料。（单手剑包括玻璃刀、影刀、铥矿棒；长柄武器包含长矛、战斗长矛、三叉戟、元素长矛、西风长枪、【渔获】、薙草之稻光）

人物命之座属性和原神中保持一致，更改的地方在于六命可以减少自己的元素爆发CD

[h2]武器[/h2]
三把可以制作的武器，分别是西风长枪，【渔获】和薙草之稻光。
前两把武器可以在科技二本制作，而薙草之稻光蓝图，则需要完美守护一次月台获取。
武器数值可以在游戏内查看，武器除了白字，特效和原神内保持一致。

接下来是无关战斗方面的：
[h2]天云草、天云草实和天云草实粉[/h2]
天云草是一种植物，生长在沼泽地区。
天云草实则是它的作物，可以用于天赋突破、制造武器。
天云草实粉则是天云草实磨成的粉末，用于给食品调味，但是只有新增的料理才可以使用天云草实粉调味。效果为：雷元素伤害暴击率提升10%，持续半天。

雷电将军不会做饭，使用火坑和锅的时候她会说出那句经典名言：
[h2]你不要让我做饭啦。我什么都能办到，但是真的不会做饭。[/h2]
不过也不是没有办法，在饥荒世界里她发现了几本神奇的书，是隔壁律者留给她的（标记为考哥）
[h2]异世界厨神的烤制教学[/h2]
使用这本书后一段时间，将会解锁在火坑上烤的能力，不过此时烤东西有几率将东西烤糊，也有可能烤不熟；继续阅读这本书，并在期间内不断地练习烤东西，会让她渐渐学会烤东西。
[h2]异世界厨神的炉灶教学[/h2]
使用这本书后一段时间，将会解锁使用锅的能力，不过此时做饭速度比常人慢，而且有一定概率会失败——做出“裁决之时”，甚至还有几率让锅直接爆炸；继续阅读这本书，并在期间内不断地练习做饭，会让她渐渐学会做饭。
[h2]异世界厨神的香料教学[/h2]
当上面两本书都学完了，阅读这本书，在此期间做饭或者烤东西，一段时间后，会解锁雷电将军使用香料的能力，并且获得“天云草实粉末”蓝图（此时的雷电将军依然不能使用研磨器）。

与做饭相关，还有本MOD自带的四个料理（真的能算四个吗）
团子牛奶、三彩团子、紫苑云霓和“裁决之时”
前三个料理没啥好说的，不过是甜食增加33%饱食度而已（
重点第四个：食用后立即扣除30点生命值，并在接下来2分钟内每5秒内扣除1点生命值，持续期间雷元素伤害暴击伤害提升30%。

也许还有我没有介绍到的，还请大家到游戏里体验，谢谢啦

[h1]This is the English ver:[/h1]
health 130   sanity 150   hunger 250 but hunger rate is 1.5

[h2] Combat [/h2]
Most of this part is similiar to Genshin Impact, modified things are as follows:
Raiden's C6 can decrease the CD of her own Elemental Burst
The stack of Chakra Desiderata can benefit from her own Elemental Burst
She will refund 50% of ingredients when crafting Polearms and Swords (Polearms: spear, wathgrithr spear, elemental spear, trident, favonius lance, the catch and engulfing ligtning; Swords: nightsword, glasscutter and ruins bat)

[h2] Weapons [/h2]
Favonius Lance, The Catch and Engulfing Lightning
The first two of them can be crafted in the SCIENCE_TWO tab.However the blueprint of Engulfing Lightning requires you to protect the moonbase perfectly to get.

[h2] Amakumo Grass and so on [/h2]
Amakumo Grass is spawned in the marsh.
Its fruit called Amakumo Fruit is an important ingredient of talents upgrade and crafting weapons.
You can use  Amakumo Fruit to craft amakumo spice, which can increase the CRIT Rate of Electro damage by 10% for half a day.

[h2] Cooking [/h2]
Raiden Shogun cannot cook at the first of beginning.However she can read books to learn how to cook.
The roasting book and cooking book can unlock the ability to use campfire and cookpot. And you will meet some questions as cook things raw, overcook or make dishes bad to "Adjudicate Time"....You can continue to read books to raise her cooking level and to avoid all these questions.
The spicing book is available after you learn all the base skills in those two books, after cooking in the duration of the spicing book she can finally obtain the ability to use spices(But she still cannot make spices except Amakumo Spice)

Four new dishes:
Dango Milk, Tricolor Dango, Rainbow Aster and Adjudicate Time.
The first three dishes has nothing special, just desserts and Raiden Shogun can benefit 33% more hunger from them.
Adjudicate Time: after using it. health is decreased by 30 and In a time of 2 min ,decrease 1 health every 5 sec.In this 2 min the CRIT Damage of Electro damage is increased by 30%.

publishedfiledetails.title: Womp, The Abyssal
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Adds a new character to play as in DST.

[b]Basic rundown:[/b]
HP: 120
Hunger: 200
Sanity: 100

*Benefits from moisture, suffers when dry
*Has a very good grip
*Is a monster

Womp includes a custom speech file, art, sound effects and unique perks.

[b]Here's a more detailed breakdown of some of the things Womp does:[/b]
(If you'd rather learn the character by playing him, don't read below.)

[b]Things to Note:[/b]
- Womp constantly generates wetness over time.
- Womp has a much higher drying threshold, so he will not dry normally unless he is too hot, near a fire, on fire, etc.
- Womp does not lose sanity for using wet equipment.

[b]The Pros:[/b]
- Moves faster when above 80 wetness. (Moves normally between 40 and 80 wetness.)
- Has a tiny sanity boost when above 80 wetness.
- While above 20 wetness, Womp has a chance to dodge attacks.
- Moves additionally faster and periodically heals while it is raining.
- Stays cooler in the summer, based on wetness.
- Takes less damage from fire when above 50 wetness (though taking fire damage dries Womp out VERY quickly).
- Tentacles are not hostile.
- Can spawn new tentacles using tentacle spots.
- Cannot be disarmed by moose/goose or Bearger, and wet tools do not slip.
- Does not lose sanity during dusk or night time.
- Can eat monster meat without penalty.
- Does not care about spoilage.

[b]The Cons:[/b]
- Loses wetness when hit by an attack, based on damage taken.
- Generates less wetness over time when below 25% hunger.
- Inventory items still get wet. Wet food spoils faster, wet fuel burns less.
- Moves slower when below 40 wetness.
- Greatly loses sanity over time while below 20 wetness.
- Periodically loses health while below 20 wetness.
- Loses sanity during the day (unless it's raining).
- Freezes faster in the winter, based on wetness.
- Takes more damage from fire when below 50 wetness.
- Pigmen, bunnymen, and catcoons are hostile.

--------------------
[b]Things I want to do eventually:[/b]
- Full custom animations (outside of scope currently).
- Better voice sound effects.
- Singleplayer version, including SW.

[b]Do not re-use or re-upload any art assets contained within this mod.[/b]
[b][u]Please report any bugs or crashes. Screenshots and log files are helpful.[/u][/b]

publishedfiledetails.title: Throwable Spears [broken]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Probably pretty broken/crashy now, I haven't found time to keep this updated. ninjor1 uploaded a fixed version that you can use: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2408298309.[/h1]

Allows you to throw spears with right-click. They do the same damage as normal spear attacks. By default, you will miss (and still lose durability) if you try to hit small creatures (bunnies, butterflies, birds, bees).

This was a mod that I did mainly because I was curious about how it would be done. I've seen people asking for throwable spears to be in the game before, so I figured I'd publish it. I don't think I'll use it myself, though. Any other modders who want to use the code, feel free (for example to make your own two-mode weapons).

[h1]Options:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Miss Small Creatures: Determines the chance to miss small creatures (default to 100%).
[*] # Uses on Large: Sets the amount of durability used by throwing a spear at a large target, in terms of the number of times you can use it before it breaks. Defaults to 75, which uses twice the durability of a normal attack.
[*] # Uses on Small: Same, but for small creatures, if you hit them. Defaults to 5.
[*] Check Range: Enabled by default. You can right-click near enemies you want to throw the spear at instead of having to click directly on them. This helps for small and fast-moving targets, but the range check is a bit expensive, so if it causes lag for you, I'd recommend turning it off.
[/list]

[h1]Probably incompatible with:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=394172225]Advanced Tooltips[/url]
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Global Positions -Remapped
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The concept of "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]" but made from the ground up to be a little easier on your computer. By default does not contain pings, for pings I recommend the "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808279156]Global Pings[/url]" mod.

Everything was done from scratch to use more modern methods and have some nice tweaks in there too.
The mod icon is the only thing taken from "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]".

[h1]Modes[/h1]
There are currently 3 modes to choose from in the config...

[b]Map Share[/b]
- A accurate recreation of some of the functionality of "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]".
- Other player's icons and names will be visible on the map from any distance.
- Speed at which the map updates is based on movement speed to prevent follower after-images. (Configurable)
- All players exploration contribute to your map.
- Not retroactive, area others explore while you are off the server or in a separate shard will not be mapped.
- Moderately light weight.

[b]Easy Cartography[/b]
- A new take on the idea of map sharing.
- Very light weight, use if other mode causes too much lag.
- Other players exploration does not contribute to your map.
- Cartographer's Desk can now be interacted with, when you do, your map will be saved to the desk and any maps saved to the desk will be added to your map.
- Retroactive, fresh players can interact with a Cartographer's Desk to fill out their map with everything that any player has explored (prior to said player interacting with the Desk themselves)
- Map scrolls can still be made for use in giving it to someone who is too busy to touch the desk themselves.

[b]Both[/b] (Default)
- Contains all the features of both the other modes.
- "Easy Cartography" mode's features can be used to overcome the issue of the "Map Share" mode not being retroactive.


[h1]Notes[/h1]
This mod contains client-side config options. These can only be accessed via the main menu's mods menu.

This mod does not add any features from "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]" that were not mentioned above. Missing features:

publishedfiledetails.title: Pickle It
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Pickle your foods to make them last longer!

[h1]Pickle Barrel:[/h1]
 - Allows pickling of food
 - Craftable on the Science Machine in the Food tab
 - Takes 1.5 days to fully pickle food
 - Currently pickles: beet, berries, cabbage, carrot, corn, cucumber, eggplant, egg, fish, mushroom, onion, pigs foot, pumpkin, radish, watermelon

[h1]New vegetables:[/h1]
 - Added: beet, cabbage, cucumber, onion, potato, radish
 - Grow on farms
 - Have a random chance of growing from generic seeds (except potato)
 - Can be fed to birds for veggie-specific seeds (except potato)
 - Potatoes are grown on farms by planting potatoes (not seeds). Harvesting potatoes from a farm will yield 1-3 potatoes.
 - Can be cooked on a fire for the cooked version of each veggie
 - Beets, onions, potatoes, and radishes grow wild in the world (Pickle It needs to be active at world gen)
 - Wild potatoes must be dug up with a Shovel

[h1]New items:[/h1]
 - Pigs feet: 1-2 dropped by pigs; can be cooked, dried, and pickled
 - Pickle sword: craftable on the Science Machine in the Fight tab

We aim to balance the Pickle Barrel so that it isn't overpowered. While it makes food last longer, there is a trade-off with the pickled versions of most foods.

If you have any feedback or ideas, please leave a comment!

[h1]Don't Starve version:[/h1]
You can also play Pickle It in the original Don't Starve!
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=196051302[/url]

[h1]Tips:[/h1]
- If anything is invisible after installing the mod, try restarting the game.
- If you are getting a lot of pickled mush, make sure the food you put in the pickle barrel is not about to rot. Also, make sure you are trying to pickle foods that are picklable. Anything that isn't picklable will result in pickled mush.

publishedfiledetails.title: 한글 입력기 v2.0.5
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
윈도우나 맥(MAC) 또는 리눅스에서 사용되는 한글입력기가 아닌 게임 내에 한글입력기를 내장한 모드입니다.

이 모드를 사용하면 한글 입력이 안되거나 한글 전환으로 인해 캐릭터 이동이 불가능한 문제를 해결할 수 있습니다.

모드에서 사용되는 한글 변환키로 한글로 전환하면 한글 채팅을 한 이후에 영문으로 전환을 하지 않아도 캐릭터 이동이 가능합니다.

[b]※ 키보드에 있는 한영키를 누루면 안됩니다. [u]모드에서 설정한 한영키[/u]를 누루세요.[/b]

[h2]# 주요 특징[/h2]
[list]
 [*] 한글 입력 이후에도 캐릭터 이동이 가능합니다.
 [*] 모드 전용 한글 전환키를 사용해야 됩니다.
 [*] Ctrl + Space 또는 Shift + Space 키로 한영을 전환할 수 있습니다. (옵션에서 선택 가능)
 [*] 윈도우 뿐만 아니라 맥이나 리눅스에서도 사용이 가능합니다.
[/list]

[h2]# 업데이트 내역[/h2]
[h3]v2.0.5[/h3]
[list]
 [*] 일부 코드를 개선하였습니다.
[/list]

[h3]v2.0.2[/h3]
[list]
 [*] 문자를 붙여넣기 할 때 한글로 변환되는 문제가 수정되었습니다.
 [*] 한영 전환 후 이전 문자가 입력되어 나오는 문제가 수정되었습니다.
 [*] 약간의 안정화 작업을 진행하였습니다.
[/list]

[h3]v2.0.1[/h3]
[list]
 [*] 버그를 수정하였습니다.
[/list]

[h3]v2.0.0[/h3]
[list]
 [*] 모드 로직이 전면 개편되었습니다.
 [*] 이제 글 삭제시 음절 단위로 지워집니다.
 [*] 한영 전환 키에 Ctrl과 Shift 조합 키가 추가되었습니다.
   Ctrl or Shift + Space 조합으로 한영 전환이 가능합니다.
   (OS설정에 따라 동작이 다르게 될 수 있음.)
[*] Mac(매킨토시) 에서도 정상 동작 확인.
[/list]

[h3]v1.1.0[/h3]
[list]
 [*] 한영 전환 문자를 색상으로 구분.(파란색은 한글, 빨간색은 영문)
 [*] 기본 시작 입력 언어를 한글로 설정(옵션에서 영문으로 설정 가능)
 [*] 기본 한영 전환키를 PageDown으로 변경.
 [*] 옵션 설정 간소화
 [*] 노트북 사용자를 위한 한영 전환키 추가('F10','F11')
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Upgradeable Chest
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
upgrade your chest with boards.

Larger content, same space.




Woddie and Lucy rate this 5 stars.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Q&A[/h1]

[h1]How Can I Upgrade?[/h1]
1. Put at least 1 upgrade material in all the outermost slots.
2. Close the container.

Degrade:
1. Clear your chest
2. Put 1 hammer into the chest
3. Close the container
4. It will consume 5 uses, trade for half of the upgrading material


[h1]How Large Can The Chest Be?[/h1]
Here is few options allow you to choose how many times it could update. How large? Check the last option! It is infinite!
[spoiler]in fact not but you may never reach the upper limit[spoiler]even you hit the limit, I can easily top up the limit. wanna give it a try?[/spoiler][/spoiler]


[h1]Do The Mod Break The Balance?[/h1]
Certainly not.
A normal chest has 9 slots and cost 3 boards. i.e. 3 slots for each boards

With this mod,
The 5x5 chest cost a total 11 boards with a total 25 slots, i.e. 25 / 11 = 2.2 slots per boards.
The 7x7 chest cost a total 27 boards with a total 49 slots, i.e. 49 / 27 = 1.8 slots per boards.

That means for each upgrade, you have to trade more boards for less slots.


[h1]Why there is no option under UI setting? [/h1]
It is not able to adjust UI setting in worldgen menu. You must visit mod screen in main menu for setting.
ie. Main Menu → Mods → Server Mods → Upgradable Chest

I hope UI setting could could be set by each client. All client should follow the setting from server host if I do not make it a client option. For example, if the server host turn the "Ice Box Leftward", all clients are forced on even they don't want to. That's why I make them a client option which each client follow their own setting than server's setting. Making it a client option will hide it from worldgen menu. You can only tune the options from main menu.


[h1]Why I cannot upgrade the chest?[/h1]
Test if it works with no other mods, and with default config. option of the mod. 
Here are some useful console commands for your test:
[table]
[tr]
[th]spawn a new chest[/th]
[th]c_spawn("treasurechest")[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]give you 10 boards[/th]
[th]c_give("boards", 10)[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]upgrade the nearest chest to 7x7[/th]
[th]c_selectnear("treasurechest") c_sel().components.chestupgrade:SetChestLv(7)[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

If it fails, comment below. Otherwise, check the following Q&A


[h1]Is the mod conflict with other mods? How do I know which mod it is?[/h1]
If you fail to upgrade the container, check to see if you install these mods.
Here are some kind of mods that may not compat with this mod:
1. ALL mods that enlarge chest storage
2. SOME of the mods that add new containers to the game
3. SOME mods that add a new items which can hold/ store/ trade/ delete things in one of its slots


[hr][/hr]
[h1]What is needed in other container?[/h1]
After version 4.0, you can upgrade 4 more containers, i.e. ice box, salt box, dragonfly chest, fish box.
Here are the materials needed:

[table]
[tr]
[th]Ice Box[/th]
[th]1 gears in each top-most slots, 1 cut stone in each other outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Salt Box[/th]
[th]1 salt crystal in each outermost slots, and 1 blue gem in the center-most slot[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Dragonfly Chest[/th]
[th]1 boards in each outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Fish Box[/th]
[th]1 rope in each outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Row/Column Upgrading Mode[/h1]
A new upgrading mode is added in version 7.0. Turn it on in [b]Other Functions: Upgrade Mode[/b]
Idea From: ♛ EmuLegs
[table]
[tr][th]Mode[/th][th]Detail[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]normal mode[/th][th]The mode what we are using. Refer to the above for more info.[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]expensive mode[/th][th]A more expensive and complicated mode. Put the upgrading items to all the right-most slots will extend horizontally. Put them to all the bottom-most slots will extend vertically. The items are listed below[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]complex mode[/th][th]Turn both of the above on.[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]OTHER NEW MODE[/th][th]Welcome to command below if you want your cool idea installed. I will implant them to the mode if I like the idea.[/th][/tr]
[/table]

[table]

[/tr]
[tr]

[/table]

[h1]Pageable Upgrade[/h1]
You may upgrade the chest to make it "pageable". The feature has yet finalized. Welcome to discuss below.
The idea is from mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=936440913]Pageable containers[/url] by Potter_Lee. 
*****Remind: This mod is supposed not compatible with his mod. You may test and tell me if they can work together.

After you have upgraded the container to the MAX levels. Put the upgrading items to ALL the slots in FIRST page. 
The upgrading items are the most-common-used upgrade item for its normal upgrade. ie. 1 cut stone for all slots in first page, NO gears is needed.

[h1]Backpack Upgrade[/h1]

publishedfiledetails.title: Automatic Health Adjust
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod automatically adjusts the health of mobs depending on the number of active players, everytime a player joins or leaves.

Default is DS values for 1 player, and DST values for 6 players. 
(for 2,3,4,5 players , health will be between those values of course)
And in case for some reason you have more than 6 players, it will be higher than DST values!

Has setting to set min/max value for the number of players the mod should calculate with:
So if you are playing with 4+ players, but want max health values for 3, then you can set max to 3.
Or if you play with 2+ players, but want at least health values for 4 players, you can set min to 4.
Or set it both to 6 if you always want to play with values for 6 players.
By default it is disabled.

Cave and Overworld are separated. 
So if one player is in cave and one in Overworld, both worlds will have health values for 1 player.

More Customization:
in the customsettings.lua you can define your own health function!

Special case for crabking(-claws):
If a player joins/leaves during a fight against crab king, his health wont change. If you want to update his health according to new number of players, you have to leave and activate him again.

[h1][i]Reisen Udongein Inaba[/i][/h1]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Reisen is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Reisen is one of the legendary moon rabbits who fled from the Moon to Earth as a refugee from a war between two worlds. She possesses extraordinary psychic abilities, capable of manipulating madness itself.

One day, Reisen's master sent her to a nearby village to sell medicine, however along the way she was  suddenly consumed by an overwhelming darkness and woke up in a unknown location. Now, she has to struggle with her own powers in order to survive. [/i]

[i]- Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]300[/b]
Hunger: [b]200[/b]
Sanity: [b]100[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Lunatic][/b]

The more you are insane, the more damage you deal to enemies and receive from them.
The less you are insane, the less damage you deal to enemies and receive from them.

If you go completely insane, you activate [b][Lunatic Red Eyes][/b].

[b][Insomniac][/b]

You can't go to sleep.
Your Sanity drains alot faster during the night, even more when facing enemies.

[b][Carrot Addict][/b]

Your Sanity is always slowly draining over time.
Eating Carrots will fully restore your Sanity.

[i]- Traits -[/i]

[b][Haste][/b] [i]Slightly Increased Base Movement Speed. [/i]
[b][Resilience][/b] [i] Slightly Increased Base Cold Resistance. [/i]
[b][Efficiency][/b] [i] Slightly Reduced Base Hunger drain. [/i]

[i]- Abilities -[/i]

[b][Lunatic Red Eyes][/b]

[i]While Active:[/i]

You deal even more damage to enemies and receive even more from them.
You run around even faster and are more resistant to slow effects.
You gain protection from The Darkness and a red vision aura to see in the dark.

All passive Sanity Regeneration effects become almost useless.
Restoring Sanity becomes even harder.

[i]- Weakneses -[/i]

[b]Your Sanity is a precious resource that is easy to lose and hard to restore.[/b]
[b]Your damage is very low at max Sanity, while having no Sanity makes you very fragile.[/b]
[b]You have to rely on Carrots if you don't want to get overwhelmed by enemies.[/b]

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Bunny Puff[/b]
[b]Carrot Seeds[/b]
[b]Healing Salve[/b]

[i]- Changelog -[/i]

Version 1.0.0 - Uploaded to Steam Workshop.

[i]- Frequently Asked Questions -[/i]

It's not really a bug, the game doesn't properly support larger character models, so it's not easily fixable by me. I'm sorry, but just deal with it and stick to the default torso.

publishedfiledetails.title: Scythe
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Add 2 harvest tools (scythe and golden scythe) to the game.
Harvest your crop easily.

Main feature:
-Harvest faster
-Allow area harvest
-Allow area damage

Other feature:
-seasoning buffable
-immune to thorns

Extra function:(set in config options)
-low chance to get an extra drop from harvest
-increase number of harvest of transplanted plant before wither
-plants harvested with scythe get a small growth boost

Most languages are translated by google

This mod is inspired by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=537902048][DST]-Scythes[/url] created by Captain_M

If you want to add your language to the mod, post your translation below. I will put them into the mod [strike]one day[/strike].

[hr][/hr]
[h1]How to use the mod in dedicated server?[/h1]
Open the "mods" folder. You will see a "dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua". Double click and open it using notepad. 
Start a new line, type: 
ServerModSetup("2328604820")
where workshop-2328604820 is this mod's file name. (no need to input "workshop-". [b]number only[/b])
for mod (workshop-xxxxxxxx), you may type ServerModSetup("xxxxxxxx") in each new line.

Or if you get a mods collection, you may type this instead:
ServerModCollectionSetup("#######")
where ####### is the collection id. You may right click any empty space in the collection page and copy the page link. The collection id would be the number string after " /?id= ". All mods in the collection will be automatically downloaded.

[hr]Detailed data[/hr]
[list]
[*]Plant that can be area pick by scythe:
[table]
[tr]
[th]non-configable[/th]
[th]grass, sapling, bush berry, reeds, cactus, stone fruit bush, light bulb, banana tree, etc
any farm plants,
any modded plants, as well as any modded farm plants[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Configable,
defaulted on[/th]
[th]lureplant, kelp under water, fig, lichen[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Configable,
defaulted off[/th]
[th]mushroom, mushroom farm, barnacle, drying rack, bee box[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

Other details:
[*]Feature:
Honey seasoning buff: double the harvesting radius
Oversized Protection buff: you will get a temporary buff allow you passing through the oversized crops after you harvest them
Extra damage to plant: deal 1.5 times damage to "plant" (eg: eye plant; "Harvest" eye plant with one hit)(This option is not compatible with some info mod. You may turn the option off.)
Mightiness: Gain 1 mightiness for each 5 plants harvested

[*]Pick Mode:
"Single Species": only same species will be picked in 1 harvest
"All Pickable": all nearby plant will be picked
"Combine": hold spacebar to pick all species, single click to harvest 1 species

[*]Extra function: (won't activate unless you turn it on)
Extra item chance: 10%
No. of pick before withered: doubled
Growth boost: 10%

[*]More about extra item:
If the target is farm plant, it will drop seed but not product.
If your farm plant has highest pressure level, it won't drop any extra seed.
If your farm plant is oversized, it drop 1 non-oversized product.
*I want the extra functions be an icing on the main feature so I set their effect to be relatively lower.
**You may refer to these functions and add your own custom function. You may ask other modders you know, or me [strike]never[/strike] for help.

[*]Some console command: (affect current game only, not until next play)
[list]
[*]Allow item(tools on the ground) under cursor can do area pick action:
c_select():AddComponent("areapicker")
[*]Change the harvest radius of the item(tools on the ground) under cursor to 10(number can changeable):
c_select().components.areapicker:SetRadius(10)
[*]Set growth boost to 1(100%)(number changeable)(0.1 for 10%, 1.1 for 110%, etc.):
TUNING.SCYTHE.GROWTH_MULTIPIER = 1
[*]Set no. of harvest (before wither) multiply by 10(number changeable):
TUNING.SCYTHE.EXTRAPICK_MULTIPIER = 10
[*]Set chance of getting extra item to 2(200%)(number changeable)(0.1 for 10%, 1.1 for 110%, etc.):
TUNING.SCYTHE.EXTRAITEM_CHANCE = 2
[/list][/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]170623 Update[/h1]
New config: Mightiness. Gain mightiness after harvest
New config: Shadow Reaper*
[list]
[*]*Modded(default). Shadow Reaper do area harvest as modded scythe
[*]*Unchange. Not making change on shadow reaper's harvest action
[*]*Official. Modded scythe do harvest action like shadow reaper
[/list]

Scythe will do harvest action like shadow reaper if it failed to preform its harvest action

Holding spacebar no longer walk towards plants that are too far from the player**
[list]
[*]**this change is for keeping the code independent from offical code update
[*]**also make the code cleaner
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: ReForged
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The Forge event has been ReForged! ReForged is the successor to Forged Forge; optimized for new content and modding support. This mod comes up with a bunch of new features that are not included in the Forge event or Forged Forge. To see all of the new features check out our patch notes. Some of the core new features include:

[h1]Voting[/h1]
Players can now vote in the lobby! This means you can now vote to kick any idlers in your lobby! You can start a vote by hitting the button for the desired vote. Votes include:
[list]
[*]Kicking
[*]Change Game Settings
[*]Force Start
[*]Cancel Force Start
[*]Levels
[/list]
Players can now earn experience when completing games. Players have an account level and character levels. The account level is the players cumulative experience of all games, while the character level is the experience gained when playing that specific character. This is purely cosmetic and does not unlock any items, but as your level increases you will notice that your player badge will change!

[h1]Game Settings Panel[/h1]
A new panel has been created which allows users to change the settings of the current game either through voting or using your admin to force change the settings. With this comes a bunch of interchangeable settings:
[b][u]Modes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Forge S01: Mobs behave as they did in the first Forge event. This currently does not affect item drops.
[*]Forge S02: Mobs behaves as they did in the second Forge event. For instance, Boarilla gains the ability to roll. This also currently does not affect item drops.
[*]ReForged: This is our own version of the Forge where we attempt to balance the game by changing mob behaviors, weapons, character perks, and anything else to enhance the experience. For example, Abigail gains a new ability in the mode! This will be continuously updated based on community feedback.
[/list]
[u][b]Difficulties[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Normal
[*]Hard: Changes mob behaviours and adds balance changes to make a Forger's life more difficult. Good Luck! (Art assets are still being developed for this)
[/list]
[b][u]Gametypes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Forge
[*]Classic Red Light/Green Light: RL/GL returns from Forged Forge. Be sure not to move on Red Light!
[*]Red Light/Green Light: A new version of RL/GL that has more lights to make things more difficult.
[/list]
[u][b]Wavesets[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Classic: The original waveset from the first Forge event.
[*]Twin Boarillas
[*]Rhinocebros
[*]Swineclops
[*]Double Trouble Classic: Mob spawns are doubled for the Classic waveset.
[*]Double Trouble: Mob spawns are doubled for the Swineclops waveset.
[*]Half the Wrath: Less mobs and they are all weaker.
[*]Sandbox: No waves, just play around using the admin menu. Needs to be turned on in the settings and at least one player will want to be admin.
[/list]
[b][u]Mutators[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Mob Stats: Adjust the damage, defense, health, and speeds of all mobs.
[*]Battlestandard Efficiency: Adjust the multiplier of banners.
[*]No Sleep: Heal Auras no longer put mobs to sleep.
[*]No Revives
[*]No HUD
[*]Friendly Fire
[/list]

[b][u]Maps[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Lava Arena
[/list]

[h1]History[/h1]
Another new tab has been created to display all of the runs you have completed in ReForged. This has been ported over from the Forge Detailed Summary mod and updated to include all of the new settings this mod has. It will only display runs from this mod. Do not worry, your runs from Forged Forge and the Forge event are untouched and unharmed by us and we may include them later on.

[h1]Modding[/h1]
Every feature seen above and much more are fully mod compatible. This means that modders can easily create new modes, difficulties, gametypes, characters, pets, and anything else using our helper functions. If you need help with creating content for this mod then stop by our discord and post in our modding channel. We will gladly help you out. Here is a list of guides and API to help you with your modding:
More coming soon.
[url=https://discord.gg/wSZD2hFyuV][img]https://i.imgur.com/psVYTBu.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Special Thanks[/h1]
Thank you for all you Forgers for “patiently” waiting for this transition to occur and thanks to everyone who helped test and gather information.

Also, thank you to all translators for translating the giant string file:
Alice! - Chinese
동각자 - Korean
More coming soon

Copyright 2019 Reforged Team. This item is not authorized for posting on Steam, except under the Steam accounts listed as authors/contributors to the right.

(Something happened to the description, we'll be rewriting soon. If you've been credit'd before and have not shown up in the new description please contact us, some information maybe outdated)

[繁花幻术]: 能够使用花瓣制作成蝴蝶(活生生的蝴蝶哦).

[扎根]: 按下Z键后芮塔会变为食人花形态同时在身边生成大量对应季节的眼球草（再次按Z键关闭）,在食人花形态下芮塔会缓慢恢复生命值并且4倍消耗饥饿值.(芮塔在食人花形态下饥饿值过低时会自动进食,被吞噬的多余小动物会被直接转换成养分)

[植物信息素]: 食人花不再相互敌对，并且芮塔自身不会受到食人花的攻击，此外芮塔可以手动收获附近其它食人花体内的物资.

_______________________________________________
 
[火龙草]:释放出扇形火焰对范围内目标造成伤害与点燃效果，自身具有一定微光.
 
[冰锤草]:短暂延迟后从地面凸起冰锥，对定点目标造成伤害和霜冻效果.
 
[毒囊草]:喷射出毒雾，对周围敌人造成持续毒素伤害.
 
[岩棘草]:高防御力，受到伤害时对攻击者造成反伤.

[黑蚀草]:暗影阵营生物，有位面伤害与位面实体抵抗，攻击能够召唤群聚恐惧协同攻击。

[月神草]:月亮阵营虚影生物，无法被攻击，不会被索敌。能持续释放一阵能够扰乱生物心智的月能波动，并召唤天体水晶进行轰炸
_______________________________________________

[世界之花]

芮塔能够使用40朵花瓣建造世界花种子，种植后变为世界花，并且可以在世界花附近制作专属物品.（摧毁后掉落5块叶肉）

世界花拥有等级系统，给予世界花种子可以升级，无上限，升级后增加每日凌晨的掉落物数量。

世界花能够吸引来大量蝴蝶.(偶尔会吸引来萤火虫)
 
世界花每天早晨会自动吸收掉附近的腐烂食物和新鲜度过低的食物.

世界花每天早晨会掉落3个随机物品：
50%概率掉落花瓣
40%概率掉落黄金花粉
10%概率掉落黄金花籽
(有极小的概率掉落一种十分罕见的特殊食物——伊甸果)

[金日玫]
使用黄金花籽直接种植，1天生长期，采摘可获得1颗黄金花粉，并有小概率掉落花瓣.（摧毁后掉落1块叶肉）

[黄金花粉]
食用后能够恢复20点饥饿值和10点生命值，60分钟保质期.

[食人花]
（在世界花旁）可以使用1个黄金花籽+10个黄金花粉制作食人花花苞.

[眼球草花环]
（在世界花旁）可以使用30朵花瓣和一个食人花花苞制作眼球草花环，无限耐久，任何玩家佩戴后都会持续恢复精神值（恢复效果比普通花环高一些）并且不会被食人花攻击.

[四季眼球草花环]
（在世界花旁）制作，拥有普通眼球草花环的所有功能，且芮塔佩戴后扎根可以反季节长出花环对应种类的眼球草。

[黑蚀草花环]
（在世界花旁）制作，拥有普通眼球草花环的所有功能。
属于暗影装备，提供等同于骨盔的暗影等级和掉san光环。
装备后不会受到影怪的主动仇恨，扎根时生长的眼球草变为黑蚀草。

[月神草花环]
（在世界花旁）制作，拥有普通眼球草花环的所有功能。
提供等同于启迪之冠的理智光环与光照效果。
装备后不会受到月灵的主动攻击，扎根时生长的眼球草变为高悬头顶的月神草。

[黄金地皮]
(在世界花旁）制作，自然地皮，芮塔扎根可以生长眼球草。
芮塔在黄金地皮上有30%移速加成，在黄金地皮扎根时生命回复量大幅增加。

[黄金花手杖]
（在世界花旁）制作，提供移速加成，可以快速采集作物且免疫带刺植物的反伤。
右键施法可以将范围内的地形临时转变为被特殊黄金地皮覆盖的陆地。
 
[完整的花]
(在世界花旁)可以使用10朵花瓣制作1朵完整的花,可以用于烹饪，食用后恢复10点生命值.

<自然精华>
芮塔可用10只蝴蝶制作，是自然系魔法能量的结晶。

[彩虹伊甸果]
(在世界花旁）制作，食用后获得90%的减伤，持续30秒；食用后获得纳米糖豆的生命回复buff，与纳米糖豆不叠加。
 
[花束]
(在世界花旁)可以使用9朵完整的花和1个自然精华制作特殊武器花束，攻击力1点，无限耐久，手持时会召唤5只杀人蝶协助攻击附近的敌对生物.

[恐惧花束]
(在世界花旁)制作，攻击力1点，无限耐久，属于暗影装备，提供等同于镰刀的暗影等级和掉san光环。手持时会召唤五只暗影杀人蝶。暗影杀人蝶拥有15点物理伤害和5点位面伤害，对月亮阵营增伤50%，会根据主人的暗影等级造成额外伤害。

[辉煌花束]
(在世界花旁)制作，攻击力1点，无限耐久，手持发出微弱的光芒。手持时会召唤五只月亮杀人蝶。月亮杀人蝶拥有15点物理伤害和5点位面伤害，对暗影阵营增伤50%，可以攻击影怪。

[繁花炮]
(在世界花旁)可以使用5朵完整的花、3个自然精华和5个火药制作特殊武器繁花炮，无限耐久，可以放入黄金花粉、黄金花籽、自然精华、伊甸果和彩虹伊甸果作为弹药，伤害与弹药种类有关，炮弹命中敌人后会发生爆炸造成aoe的二次伤害.
繁花炮右键种植在地面上后可变为繁花炮手，当有弹药时会自动攻击敌对目标。繁花炮手可以打开添加或更换弹药，使用铲子挖起可以将其重新变回繁花炮。
（爆炸特效来自mod不死鸟传说，感谢01的授权）

PS：在设置中开启眼球草花环与花束有耐久度的功能后，可以使用（完整的花）来修复耐久度。
PS：繁花炮的位面伤害只结算一次，即碰撞伤害中不包含位面伤害。


_______________________________________________
 
[食谱]
 
黄金蜜蝶卷(黄金花粉+完整的花+蝴蝶翅膀+蜂蜜)：恢复50饥饿值，恢复35生命值，恢复20精神值。
 
花瓣沙拉(完整的花+完整的花+完整的花+完整的花)：恢复25饥饿值，恢复50生命值。获得吸引蝴蝶buff持续2分钟。
 
花蜜汉堡(黄金花粉+完整的花+任意肉+任意肉)：恢复112.5饥饿值，恢复15生命值，恢复5精神值。
 
黄金蛋糕(黄金花粉+黄金花粉+黄金花粉+黄金花粉)：恢复85饥饿值，恢复40生命值，恢复5精神值。
 
纳米糖豆(蝴蝶翅膀+蜂王浆+黄金花粉+蜂蜜/蜂王浆/黄金花粉)：恢复2点饥饿值，每0.5秒恢复1点生命值，持续3分钟。(不会腐坏)

publishedfiledetails.title: Devon, the Hunter
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Finally here and now with custom sounds!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=195729043]Original/RoG version can be found here.[/url]

[b]ABOUT-[/b]
Devon is really just a character from a personal project that I like to make for most games. He's a fast and nimble, but he can't take a hit worth a damn. He's also fairly insane as it is, suffering from hallucinations of a near-death experience, so he fit pretty well into Don't Starve.

[b]DEVON -[/b]
Health=50
Hunger=100 (drains slowly)
Sanity=50 (drains quickly at night)

Of the Lake People bonuses (v1.3): 
- Minor weakness to cold
- No sanity loss in rain. (Special thanks to Ionic for offering code to get this working again!)
- No sanity loss from wetness

Death-Touched addition (v2.4): 
- Panic Attacks: randomly (between a few hours to a few days)

Other things: 
- Full custom art and dialogue! 
- Devon is now voiced by a rough banjo! 

Devon is a greedy bastard and very specially trained as a thief and hunter - it's pretty much all he can do. He's extremely quick and lightfooted, but he's very weak and, honestly, stupid. During a robbery, he was near-fatally injured by a trap, which triggered a near-death experience involving an enormous endless, centipedal boar that crushed him in it's worm-like prehensile hairs. Since then, he has been plagued by hallucinations and paranoia of the memory. Funfact: Devon is HIGHLY misanthropic, which makes him basically stuck in a puddle of self loathing. Wholly convinced that his birth species is worthless, he tries to hide it with concealing clothing, a specially implanted beard, and, during a drunken dispair, by gouging out some distinctive markings. Despite his attempts, he can't eascape both the psychological and physiological aspects of his species.

[b]BIRDY-[/b]
Devon's specially trained pet that helps him steal sh*t and keeps him company. She is his best friend and he keeps her from any danger for fear of losing her. He never goes anywhere without his Birdy.

She can be worn as a hat for a significant sanity boost. She also offers an even higher sanity boost when placed on the ground and stood near, but the radius is very small, so you need to cuddle up close. This most recent version has added a tiny warmth bonus from her fluffy bird butt when worn.

[b]Other art and comics and poop I have related to Devon:[/b]
[url=http://devonspillowbook.tumblr.com/]Devon's Pillow Book[/url] (A.K.A.: being exceptionally nerdy with Morrowind)
[url=http://cowboypunkcolt.tumblr.com/search/waystray]My Art blog[/url]

If you dig my mods (or comics or art in general) and would like to see more of them or see them improved, consider donating to my [url=http://www.patreon.com/LorneColt]Patreon[/url] to help me create more for you to play with!

___________________________________________________________________________

[u][b]BUGS, ISSUES AND TROUBLESHOOTING YOUR MOD: [/b][/u]
If you're having problems with your mod, refer to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/274854296/604941528490054589/]this discussion[/url] to make sure the basics are working, if that doesn't help, feel free to leave a comment or send me a message so I can fix it.


Since it apparently needs some clarification: no, you may not upload this mod elsewhere without my permission. If you find a copy of Devon uploaded by someone else, this is copyright infringement and I would appreciate if you would inform me!

publishedfiledetails.title: Steampunk DST
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Mod adds Steampunk to DST, many items, creature and two, new pets[/h1]

Here you can find [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=271800759]Steampunk[/url] for DS :)

[h1]DESCRIPTION[/h1]
I made this mod as a tribute to the steampunk style. I love this style and also, in my opinion it fits really good into Don't Starve world, so why not ? Special thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/strelka/myworkshopfiles/]Star[/url] for great help in making DST version of the mod :)

At that moment, mod adds 8 new craftable items, 2 gear pet's, 1 creature and loot! You can find them (new items and pets of course) in the Custom "Gears" tab. All this items have funny spark animation while equippingand more. All items have custom strings for each character in standard game and RoG. Also all off them have their own map icons as well as gears, so you can't lose them! .. i hope so..


[h1]Gear Axe[/h1]
- Works as an axe
- 35 dmg and 300 uses
- Loses durability 30% slower while chopping
- Needs Science machine. 


[h1]Gear Mace[/h1]
- Works as an hammer
- 40 dmg and 130 uses 
- Needs Alchemy engine. 
- Gives 2-3 gears when it's broken


[h1]Gear Stove[/h1]
- Gives light depending on fuel level
- Gives warm when fueled. Can be fueled with burnable objects.
- Lowers speed by 20%
- Needs Alchemy engine. 


[h1]Gear Mask[/h1]
- Gives medium health regeneration
- Causes a gradual loss of sanity
- Needs Alchemy engine. 


[h1]Gear Hat[/h1]
- Gives large sanity regeneration
- Durability is 30% better than in tophat
- Needs Alchemy engine.


[h1]Gear Helmet[/h1]
- Gives 50% protection to fire
- Lowers speed by 10%
- 85% dmg absorbtion and durability of armor wood
- Gives a tiny sanity (like garland)
- Needs Alchemy engine.


[h1]Gear Wings[/h1]
- They increase speed by 15%
- 12 days durability
- Needs Alchemy engine


[h1]Gear Torch[/h1]
- Gives light when equiped, and on the ground
- Can be turned on or off, but can't be fueled
- Has 3 days durability 
- Drops 2 twigs when durability drops to 0%


[h1]WS-01[/h1]
- 150hp, 40dmg
- Has little regen to all WS (~0.3hp per sec). Regen works only if no rain and no moisture.
- He fights for you
- No need for sleep or eat
- Can be healed using some items. Items that can be given to ws-01: lighter, wires, transistor, robot, rocket, gears.
- Needs Alchemy engine 
- Friend of Webber's spiders


[h1]WS-03[/h1]
- 500hp,  120dmg
- Has little regen to all WS (~0.3hp per sec). Regen works only if no rain and no moisture.
- He fights for you 
- Can chop trees with you!
- No need for sleep or eat 
-  Can spawn 1 gear per 1,5 day!
- Can be healed using some items. Items that can be given to ws-03: lighter, wires, transistor, robot, rocket, gears.
- After death, drops 3-4 gears, and spawn 5-6 WS-01 for master!
- Needs Alchemy engine
- Friend of Webber's spiders
- Works as Lightning Rod.


[h1]Bulber[/h1] Bulbers are a little moving bulbs. They give a small radius of light.. if you are not so close. You can find them in treess, under the stones and in some structures. So you need to chop, pick or hammer to find them. There is a small chance, that bulber will spawn. Also a small chance that he will drop lightbulb after death... but.. I hope you don't want to kill him?!


[h1][b]BUGS?[/b][/h1]
Did you encountered a bug, crash or glitch? If you want to make sure that I can fix it, please report it in comments with your log file (C:/users/documents/Klei/DoNotStarve/log) attached (pastebin for example).

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Original address: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973&searchtext=Global+Positions

Original Description:
Features
Show other players on the map (and hover over them to see who they are).
Show player indicators (the bubble things on the side of the screen) when they're far away.
Light signal fires that show up as indicators and on the map.
Ping the map by alt+clicking, creating markers that show other players points of interest. Note that muting a player hides their pings. Controller users can ping by clicking in the right stick.
Opt-out of sharing your location with a button on the scoreboard.
Share your map discovery with other players automatically

Wilderness Mode
By default, if you play in Wilderness Mode, it will ignore most of the config options. If you want to override that, set the Wilderness Mode Override to Enabled. Otherwise, it will hide player positions, but always show campfires.

Configuration Options
On the mods screen, with this mod selected, you can change a lot of the settings with the "Configure" button.

[h1] 🌍模组介绍 [/h1]

“HUD大小”【让您可以独立于游戏的HUD比例调整轮盘图标大小。】【官方解释（HUD大小：自定义抬头显示的大小）】“1”
“轮盘图标”“图片+文字”
“中心轮”“已开启”
“鼠标固定”【如果轮盘在屏幕中心，在选择表情之前和之后要将鼠标移动到哪里？】“中心位置”[spoiler]
中心位置：呼出手势轮盘时，鼠标强制移动到轮盘中心。选择后鼠标归位。
记忆位置：鼠标移动到上一次使用轮盘时的位置，忽略选择一个表情而进行的移动。选择后鼠标归位。
轮盘位置：呼出手势轮盘时，鼠标强制移动到轮盘中心，选择后鼠标位置不变。
关闭[推荐]：永远不会移动鼠标。一个表情可能已经根据鼠标之前所在的位置被选中了。 [/spoiler]
“手柄设置”【在轮盘上选择表情时使用哪个控制器模拟摇杆。】“左侧”
“表情限制”【将轮盘限制为 8 个表情，由下面选项中的选择来确定。请注意，/深蹲 之后的选项需要通过表情物品来解锁。】“已关闭”
“正右方 表情”【这将直接显示在右边。】“挥手/wave”
“右上方 表情”【这将对角地右上显示。】“跳舞/dance”
“正上方 表情”【这将直接向上显示。】“开心/happy”
“左上方 表情”【这将对角地左上显示。】“搓澡/bonesaw”
“正左方 表情”【这将直接显示在左边。】“无视/rude”
“左下方 表情”【这将对角地向左下显示。】“捂脸/facepalm”
“正下方 表情”【这将直接向下显示。】“伤心/sad”
