耸肩/shrug
缓慢鼓掌/slowclap
颂歌表情/carol [/spoiler]
[code] 为emotes添加了一个轮子选择界面，使emote更容易。
默认情况下，热键设置为g（但您可以在mod config选项中进行配置）。按住G键将打开笔势轮，然后将鼠标移动到特定方向将选择笔势。当你释放G时，你的角色会做这个手势。
在控制器上，按下左边的模拟按钮可激活控制盘，通过移动左边的模拟按钮来进行选择，此时模拟按钮仍被按下（然后松开以进行选择）。它在技术上绑定到菜单misc 3，我相信您可以在控制菜单中重新绑定。
我包含了几个您可能想要更改的选项：
选择权
描述
肘节按钮
默认为g，但可以将其设置为任何字母键。希望当mods获得合适的控制选项时，这将更好地用于：）
中心轮
确定控制盘是在鼠标周围还是在屏幕中央出现。
恢复光标位置
如果禁用了中心轮，则此设置不起任何作用，除非设置为绝对。否则：
相对，默认设置，将其移回原来的位置，添加您为手势所做的额外移动。
绝对设置回原来的位置，不增加额外的移动。
当鼠标向上移动时，Center会将鼠标设置在滚轮的中间，但之后不会移动。
关不动鼠标。
控制器杆
左边（默认）使用左边的模拟棒来选择emotes，右边使用右边的棒。如果你想重新绑定需要点击的木棒，在游戏的控制器控制菜单中重新绑定菜单“Misc”（你很可能想用记分板按钮交换它）。
极限值为8
关闭（默认设置）使用所有的emotes，但是控制盘变得非常拥挤（当前为12个emotes），因此，打开时将控制盘限制为8个emotes，这些emotes由其余选项（右emote、左下emote等）选择。
感谢 小呆毛 翻译！ [/code]

Kill monster and eat food to gain experience.
Level up and gain attribute points to upgrade health, sanity, hunger, etc.
For details, click open the UI on the top left corner.

레벨포인트나 도전과제 포인트를 사용하여 체력,정신력,허기 등을 증가시킬 수 있습니다.
자세한 내용을 보려면 왼쪽상단 모서리의 UI를 클릭하세요
또한 마우스 오른쪽 클릭으로 UI를 끌어 이동시킬 수 있습니다

publishedfiledetails.title: Polish WIKI - Language Pack
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Spolszczenie do Don't Starve Together, bazujące na polskiej WIKI
( http://pl.dontstarve.wikia.com/wiki/Don%27t_Starve_Wiki ).

Zawiera działające POLSKIE ZNAKI!

Paczka językowa jest w pełni zgodna i sprzężona z polską Wiki - napisałem skrypt, który skanuje Wiki w poszukiwaniu tłumaczenia nazw przedmiotów oraz cytatów postaci, po czym z tak zdobytej bazy danych mój program uzupełnia plik językowy. Niestety ponieważ na polskiej Wiki nie ma zamieszczonych wszystkich fraz, a część jest nieaktualna ze względu na naturalną ewolucję tekstów w grze - sporą część musiałem tłumaczyć własnoręcznie. Na chwilę obecną oceniam, że około 1/3 przetłumaczonych tekstów ściągnąłem z Wiki (skryptem), pozostałe 2/3 sam przetłumaczyłem.

Od siebie przełożyłem również menu.

Znalazłeś jakiś bulwersujący błąd? Jakiś cytat jest na Wiki, a mój skrypt go nie znalazł i nie umieścił w tym modzie? Chcesz wspomóc tłumaczenie fraz wypowiadanych przez postacie? Zamieść je na polskiej Wiki w odpowiedniej zakładce przedmiotu lub postaci (a resztę zrobi mój skrypt pobierający dane), albo napisz do mnie maila na marecik16@vp.pl.

P.S. Ten mod nie jest kontynuacją istniejącej już polskiej paczki językowej, jest niezależną nową wersją.
P.S. P.S. Poszukuję ludzi do współpracy przy dalszym tłumaczeniu cytatów. Bez tego paczka językowa będzie stała w miejscu. W tym miejscu specjalne podziękowania dla eMPi, Majkelson98, piro987, |TheZGamer| - jako jedyni sensownie mi pomogli.
P.S. P.S. P.S. Gorąco polecam również spolszczenie do DS (SW) :
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1378752425

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Cooking
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
GitHub Repo (check out README if you wanna make supports for modded cookwares): https://github.com/Legend-Master/AutoCooking

[h1]Usage[/h1]
To start auto cooking:
[olist]
[*]Choose an Integrated Key in the mod settings
[*]Put the materials in to a cookware (cookpot, seasoning station, ...)
[*]Press the Integrated Key
[/olist]
If you have cooked something before, press the Integrated Key will start to repeat that recipe, and if you don't have enough materials for it, it will go in to "endless harvest mode" which will harvest all cookpots/seasoning stations near you endlessly

To stop, simply move or click on something or press the Integrated Key again

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]It will remember the cooking material and fill the cookpot/seasoning station by using materials from any of opened containers
[*]It will select just enough cookpots for cooking to avoid using too many cookpots (Just because that looks so stupid, e.g. You want to cook some icecreams, and you got 20 cookpots, it will eventually only use the last 4 cookpots...)
[*]It will try to go back to the first cookpot to wait for it to finish
[*]If you're realy laggy, try to use "Laggy Mode", but it still has chance to open and close the cookpot over and over again
[*]Hold control when starting auto cooking to disable harvesting
[*]You can turn on Ultra Fast mode in the settings to make it fill in all the materials at once
[/list]

[h1]Deprecated[/h1]
Note: Although they're deprecated, they're on by default to not break the expectation of early users
[list]
[*]Press start button to start auto cooking by using 2/4 slots of items from cookpot/seasoning station/backpack/inventory
[*]Pressing start button when don't have enough items, it will go in to "endless harvest mode" which will harvest all cookpots/seasoning stations near you endlessly
[*]Press "Lastest Recipe Key" to cook lastest recipe you ever did
[/list]

[h1]Configable Options[/h1]
[list]
[*]Language: Auto / English / Simplified Chinese
[*]Action Key: Key to start the cooking (Default: F5) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Action Key 2: this key + click on cookware to start (Default: Off) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Lastest Recipe Key: Key to start the cooking lastest recipe (Default: Home) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Integrated Key: Start cooking items from opened cookware or lastest cooking recipe / endless harvest mode (Default: Off)
[*]Ultra Fast Mode: Put in all the materials in the blink of an eye (Default: Off)
[*]Num of Cookpots: Amount of cookpots compare to cooking time to use, hold shift when starting auto cooking to select infinite
[*]Laggy mode: Off / On / In-game button (Default: Off)
[*]Laggy Mode Toggle Key: If you choose "In-game button" from "Laggy Mode", you can give it a key to toggle laggy mode in game (Default: Right Shift)
[/list]

[h1]Tips[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can enable [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2111412487]Lazy Controls[/url] to change the keybind UI in the mod configuration from a spinner to a more ergonomic keybind UI
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]When you hold something on you mouse, it will pause the cooking, and I have no idea how to fix it since you can't do a rummage action when you have the activeitem (& It wouldn't start cooking when something is on you mouse)
[/list]

Special Thanks: 秋一(Civi) for testing and suggesting those amazing ideas

publishedfiledetails.title: Drops Reset Countdown
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This is a simple mod that adds a collapsible Countdown Timer modal box to the Main Screen (and optionally to the Gameplay HUD).  The timer will countdown to when Daily & Weekly Skin Drops reset.  All times are automatically adjusted to your local timezone.  

The mod has language support for English, Russian (Русский), Simplified Chinese (简体中文), Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), Brazilian Portuguese (Português do Brasil), Korean (한국어), and Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).

[b]Latest Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]Language support for Vietnamese
[*]Weekly Skin Drops History (Note: Uses data from the Weekly Drops Counter)
[*]Language support for Brazilian Portuguese and Korean
[*]Skin Information Panel (Hover over a skin in the Curio Cabinet Skins List to view)
[*]Optional Auto-open Gift Box feature (disabled by default)
[*]Skin Statistics (Hover over the Total Skins or Total Spools count to view)
[*]Scalable Modal (Up to 150% of its default size)
[*]Support for Vertical, Ultra-Wide (21:9), and Super Ultra-Wide (32:9) Displays
[*]Total Spools & Total Skins indicator in the All Skins List modal and exported JSON file
[*]Weekly Drops Counter (Note: Only counts drops that happen while the mod is enabled)
[/list]

[b]Daily Drop[/b]:
[list]
[*]Green Text = Drop Available (Need to Re-login or Restart Game to Obtain Drop)
[*]Yellow Text = Already Received Drop for the Day
[*]Red Text = Drop Not Yet Available
[/list]

[b]Weekly Drops[/b]:
[list]
[*]The active week of drops (i.e. the start and end date) will always be shown in Green Text
[/list]

[b]Weekly Drops Counter[/b]:  
[list]
[*]The counter only keeps track of drops you obtain while the mod is enabled. 
[*]The count updates when you get a weekly drop (i.e. when a gift icon appears in the top left) 
[*]Data is stored locally on each computer (file path: "<DST Directory>/data/unsafedata/dropsdata_<KUID>.json") and is not synced online. 
[*][b]Note[/b]: If you change computers, delete the save file, or get a drop while the mod isn't enabled, the count that is displayed will be inaccurate
[/list]

[b]Weekly Skin Drops History[/b]:
[list]
[*]The history only displays weekly skins that dropped while the mod was enabled
[*]Skins are sorted by weekly cycle and listed in the following order: 
[olist]
[*]Skins still in your Curio Cabinet (sorted by opening time) [normal appearance]
[*]The skin in an unopened gift box [faded appearance with red corner]
[*]Skins no longer in your Curio Cabinet (sorted by rarity) [faded appearance]
[/olist]
[*]Listed skins will correspond to the Weekly Drops Counter for that weekly cycle (uses the same save file as above)
[*][b]Note[/b]: If you change computers, delete the save file, or get a drop while the mod isn't enabled, then the history will be incomplete
[/list]

[b]Curio Cabinet Skins List (Optional)[/b]:
[list]
[*]Up to 12 recently obtained skins can be shown in the modal (see configuration options)
[*]A timestamp of when each skin was acquired is shown in each row
[*]A full list of all skins in your Curio Cabinet can be viewed by clicking the "Show All" button
[*]Details of a skin (name, rarity, image, and description) are shown by hovering the mouse over the name of a skin in the full list
[*]Skin Statistics (a breakdown of the number of skins owned per rarity) can be viewed by hovering the mouse over the Total Skins or Total Spools count
[*]Skins that have been sold, spooled, traded, or trade inn-ed will disappear from both lists
[*]Skin data can be exported to a file via the Export button.  The JSON file will be generated to the "steamapps/common/Don't Starve Together/data/unsafedata" folder under the Steam Directory
[/list]

[b]Auto-Open Gift Boxes (Optional; Disabled by Default)[/b]
[list]
[*]Gift boxes that drop during gameplay will be automatically opened
[*]Enabling this feature disables the overlay with the gift box opening animation
[*]A clickable text notification is shown in the chat history when a gift box is auto-opened
[/list]

[b]Configurable Options[/b]:
[list]
[*]Display your Current System Time: [Show / Hide]
[*]Display the exact time of when Daily and Weekly Drops reset: [Show / Hide]
[*]Clock Format: [12 Hour / 24 Hour]
[*]Newest Skins List: [Show / Hide]
[*]Number of Newest Skins to Show: [3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 12]
[*]Initial Modal Box State: [Collapsed / Expanded]
[*]Modal Size in Main Menu: [Default / 105%-150%]
[*]Add Modal Box to Gameplay HUD: [Yes / No]
[*]Modal Size in Gameplay HUD: [Default / 105%-150%]
[*]Auto-Open Gift Boxes: [Yes / No]
[*]Language: [English (US/UK) / Русский / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / Português do Brasil / 한국어 / Tiếng Việt]
[/list]

[b]Credits[/b]:
[list]
[*]Mod Author: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/instant-noodles/]Instant Noodles[/url]
[*]Mod Testing: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/sealedpenumbra]sealedpenumbra[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/shmoot/]Shmoot[/url]
[*]Russian Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/sealedpenumbra]sealedpenumbra[/url]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/maryniamiccayla]Marynia Miccayla[/url]
[*]Korean Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/afscorpltd]AFS Co. Ltd.[/url]
[*]Vietnamese Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/zConnorI22/]zConnor.i22[/url]
[/list]

[b]Notice[/b]:
[list]
[*]All resources contained within this mod (including code and translations) may not be copied, altered, or reproduced in any way without the explicit and prior permission of the author and contributors listed on this workshop page.
[*]Copyright ©2019-2026 Instant Noodles. All rights reserved.
[/list]

--

Daily skins (1 per day) are given for logging in each day and weekly skins (8 per week) are given for playing the game.  A total of 15 skins can be obtained every week.  However, Family Sharing accounts are not eligible for Daily drops.

Please note that this mod does not enable you to get more than your allotted 1 daily drop per day or 8 weekly drops per week.  Drop times are merely adjusted to your local timezone for convenience.

2026/05/18 Ecology, decoration, and ocean content update: added Endless Lotus and lotus seeds, which players can obtain from frogs and plant on the ocean surface; once grown, they can harvest flowers, dig up lotus leaves and lotus roots, and unlock lotus-themed dishes including Lotus Leaf Porridge, Lotus Leaf Sticky Rice Chicken, Lotus Root Pork Rib Soup, Hot and Sour Lotus Root Slices, and Fried Stuffed Lotus Root; added the lantern and lantern stand mounting system, allowing placeable lantern stands to hang multiple lanterns, improve lighting based on the number of lanterns, and support toggling and recharging; added decorations such as the Cozy Nest and Grandfather Clock, with multiple visual styles, skin switching, and resting interactions for companions including Chester, Hutch, and Glommer; added the Ocean Tear as a world drop, which can switch between wet and dried states to affect the carrier’s wetness; improved crop quality drop rules so hammered giant crops preserve their quality and upgrade the quality of dropped seeds accordingly.
2026/05/02 Crop Quality System Update: crops, seeds, cooked crops, oversized crops, and farm plants can now appear with different quality levels. High-quality ingredients provide better eating effects and reduce their original negative effects. Quality now carries naturally through planting, harvesting, cooking, birdcage seed exchange, and nectar brewing, making high-quality crops a more valuable cultivation goal.
2026/02/25 Added Recipes: Blood Bread, Hoover Stew; Added World Drops: Doomsday Clock, Moon Phase Pocket Watch, Phoenix Feather; Added capture support for the small creature Phantom, with the corresponding special skill Bright Egg Killer; Added capture support for the small creatures Snail and Jelly Snail, with the corresponding special skill Armor Breaker; Added capture support for the small creatures Monkey, Gunpowder Monkey and Crew Monkey, with the corresponding special skill Theft; Eternal Well now supports filling the canteen; Horse Head now grants 0.1 Luck; Fixed the occasional crash issue after capturing the small creature Lobster; Fixed the issue where the spawn mechanics of Mud Crab conflicted with stack mods, causing a pile of dung to be replaced with a Mud Crab; Fixed the crash issue when using Mystic Staff [Moon Energy] on some immovable creatures.
2025/09/24 Fix compitable issue that shadowthrall centipede attack-back player will crash
2025/05/28 Added a new necklace, Ankang Egg. It restores a small amount of sanity when paired and can also be eaten. Happy Dragon Boat Festival! Added a new adventure, Wither Skeleton, which will drop 1~3 coal blocks when smashed; coal blocks can be burned, or used with explosives to make random gems; added a new adventure, Star Fragments, which has a chance to drop star fragments for decoration at night, and will disappear by themselves during the day if not picked up, and can be changed by Magic Broom; added a new adventure, Fish Rain in the Sea, which has a chance to drop fish when it rains at sea; added a new adventure, Shallow Buried Mounds, which has a chance to obtain meat related to the Ancient God or 22 pounds of fish; added a new adventure, Wind Sweeping Fallen Leaves, and nearby evergreen trees have a chance to drop Leaf Notes; Added a new weapon, Rich Man, to the adventure, with random blueprints and infinite durability, and accumulated kill health will be exchanged for gold nuggets; Well of Eternity can now add water to kettles; try to fix the conflict between the nectar brewing barrel and the Heaps of Foods mod; fix the problem that the head statue cannot go back when the player quickly leaves the loading range of the Defiled Statue; fix the problem that the sea totem of the Fire Challenge occasionally cannot be generated;
2025/04/26 Currently, there is a chance to obtain Stone Gourds when mining goldstone. After refining, they can randomly transform into: Aged Gourd, Competitive Red Gourd, Five Ghosts Gourd, Treasure Lotus Jade Gourd, or Qingtian Gourd, each with unique effects. The display cabinet now has an additional lotus form, which can replenish the durability of gourds.  New recipe added: Teleport Scroll, allowing travel to any previously explored location.  New world drop: Flying Shoes, functioning similarly to the Teleport Scroll but with unlimited uses (with just a minor cost).  New encounter: Will-o'-the-Wisp. Capturing it unlocks the ability to craft decorative will-o'-the-wisps.  Now, if a Giant Matchstick is placed on the ground without being lit, it can be picked up again.  The maximum number of lightning-generated particles that can exist simultaneously is now capped at 9.  Aztec Coins can now be exchanged for a gold bar once per day.  Fixed an issue where the "Behemoth" skill for small animals was not working.  Fixed an occasional crash related to crafting Nectar.
2025/03/11 Now, there's a small chance to encounter catchable will-o'-the-wisps in the cemetery at night; Fixed some mod weapon conflicts.



View more update please check [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/1085586145]here[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: 45 Inventory Slots [Fixed + EquipSlot UI expand] 整合版
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h2][b]This update includes:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]*20240506 v1.1.5.2b[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added:[/b] ENABLEINTERSEP. When off, all slots have equal horizontal spacing.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Backpack Merge Mode: After selecting this mode, the backpack now defaults to it after manual operation. Activating merge mode automatically adjusts the inventory bar  to three rows.
    ⚠️[i][u]NOTICE If the backpack is too large, a warning will be displayed. Excess slots may extend beyond the intended display range, which cannot be directly resolved at present.[/u][/i]
[*][b]Compatibility:[/b] Multivariate Certificate of Functional Medal mod now automatically adjust to the correct position.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
This version with 45 inventory slots is based on the code from two other mods, with 99.99% of the code coming from the following two sources:
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2801880191]45 Inventory Slots [Fixed][/url] — The implementation of the main functionalities is mostly derived from this version.
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url] — UI-related code and compatibility issues related to the display of the six-item equipment slot.
This hybrid inherits the advantages of both mods and is designed to be compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url], addressing issues that arise when both mods are activated simultaneously, such as the single-line display problem , and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2798599672]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3[/url] The mod has been hidden and cannot be subscribed to anymore.  You can use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2950481491]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3 (Tell me what you want)[/url] as a replacement for the this mod. 

[h3]Key improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Basically fixed some strange bug affecting 45 slots, such as lightning issue , rollback causes duplication of cow, Wilson's beard crashes, misalignment of sea fishing rods, and equip something abnormal inside chests.
[*]the UI has been enlarged to accommodate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2950481491]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3 (Tell me what you want)[/url] , [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1909182187]能力勋章 Functional Medal[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url], compatibility. Fixed issues causing single-line display problems when both are enabled have been fixed.
[*] Supported to set the top row as the first row, prioritizing item filling.
[*] Fixed for display issues with Functional Medal's Multivariate Certificate.
[*] Support for backpack merge mode.
[/list]

[h3]Credit goes to the original authors. If there is any infringement, it will be promptly addressed and deleted.[/h3]

Below is the info file content for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2801880191]45 Inventory Slots [Fixed][/url] version 1.1.5:
[quote=Antaeogo]
45 Inventory Slots mod updated to work with the lastest updates,
such as the WX and Maxwell Reworks.

Credits to Sanggiyan and the previous authors.

v1.1.4 Changes:
 - Crash fix attempt (beard sack)
 
 （v1.1.5
- Craft with ingredients from open containers）
[/quote]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url] version 1.2:
[quote=logan] 
Expand the UI of the 45-slot inventory to accommodate various mods that add equipment slots, preventing the UI from being obscured.
When used with the Functional Medal mod, please open the Functional Medal mod settings interface and disable "Automatically stick the medal bar to the edge" to ensure that the merged medal can be opened normally.
[/quote]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Revision Modification update log:[/h2]
[h3][b]*2023-10-24 Modification:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added "priority = 0.01" to the info file to address compatibility issues with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url] and resolve the single-line display problem.
[*]Based on insights from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url], fixed UI display issues related to the ability medals (1909182187). Compatibility with the six-item equipment slot was improved, and relevant UI components were transferred to this mod to prevent overlap issues in the original mod.
[/list]
[h3][b]*2023-11-07 FIXED Version (Mod Update 1.1.5):[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Revisited and made further modifications to address any issues and improve the overall functionality of the mod.
[/list]
[h3][b]*2023-11-29 Version 1.1.5.1[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the positioning logic of grid placement to ensure equal sizes on the left and right sides of the HUB.
[*]Revised the logic for the appearance of grid separation gaps to prevent misalignment and irregularities caused by mismatched gap positions between the upper and lower rows of grids.
[*]Introduced a new First slot setting option: determine which slot in the inventory serves as the first slot. Picked-up items will start from this slot and be stored in corresponding slots from left to right. Once a row is filled, the items will be stored in the next row in the same sequence. By default, you can use shortcut keys 1-9, 0 to quickly use items in the corresponding slots.
    This mod provides two options: the top-left slot and the bottom-left slot, with the default considering the bottom-left slot as the first slot (consistent with other 45-slot mods).
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
*If you encounter an extended startup delay when using this mod for the first time, follow these steps for troubleshooting:*

1. *Check if you have any other mods enabled that involve the six-item equipment slot or similar features. If so, try the following:*
   - *Disable the equipment slot mod.*
   - *Simultaneously, adjust the "Enable extra equipment slots" option in this mod to "Backpack & Amulets."*

2. *Launch the game and wait for it to start up normally. After a successful launch, exit the game.*

3. *Adjust the “Enable extra equipment slots” option in this mod to “None” and enable the equipment slot mod again.*

publishedfiledetails.title: Horo the Wise Wolf
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
============================================================================
Update Alert:
For all current and future subscriber please beware this mod is made with the intention of having interaction with a mod called : Lawrence. 

For the sake of interaction and balance, this character is balanced with accordance with that mod! (This may make this character appear slightly over/under power depending on what patch it is on.) 

Also please read patch notes for information about each added patch.

**Highlight you can use Advanced Tool Tip with this mod again! 
============================================================================
Horo the Wise Wolf enters the world of Don't Starve.

With her cunning wisdom and natural predatorial instincts, Horo the Wise Wolf is a formidable presence when the time is right. Horo takes a human form but she is still a wise wolf by heart. (This character is not meant to be played like a traditional DS character. Manage your stats and resources well. [b]Think like a wise wolf.[/b]) 

Health: 30 (wait what? Yes this is intentional)
Hunger: 250
Sanity: 150

[h1]Abilities:[/h1]
Horo is a natural born hunter who thrives at night and lazes around during the day.
            -during the day Horo moves around slower, has a very small chance to fall asleep and deals less damage
            -during dusk Horo moves much quicker allowing her to search for prey
            -during night Horo moves quicker and hits much harder
                                 Horo gives off a soft light allowing her to freely move around during the night time

Horo is the goddess of harvest, natural resources such as grass and sapling around her grows 2-3x faster than usual.

Horo's fluffy tail provides small insulation against the cold. (Same as wearing rabbit earmuffs)

Horo is truly wise. She starts with Tier 1 science.

[h1]Current Active abilities[/h1]
[b]Bulldoze[/b]
To use this skill simply press the "R" key when not in-game chat.  Horo will then proceed to say: "I will you show my true strength!" If this is prompt walking into and through an entity will demolish it.  [Strike]hint hint[/Strike] Try this on [spoiler] *rocks* *shiny rocks* *pig head totems* *trees*[/spoiler]

costs
-5 hunger (it can be tiring)
-1 health (you are slamming into things)
(30 sec cool down) 

[b]Prowl[/b]
By pressing "H" the player will send Horo into hunting status. This lowers her movement speed by a tiny fraction and allows her to sneak up to preys such as Rabbits, Birds and Turkeys. (She's really good at this you know)

Prowl consumes 5 sanity upon successful activation.  (Being quiet takes a toll you know). 
Prowl lasts for 15 second and has a cool down of 1/4 of a day. (Use this wisely)

**Please note Prowl allows you to sneak up to preys. You will still need to force attack if you wish to engage in combat against the prey.

[b]Wheat Pouch[/b] (You must wear the pouch for these to work)
Wearing the wheat pouch allows Horo to dig for free. (Who needs a shovel when you got paws)
Being close to the wheat, Horo will very slowly regenerate health and sanity. 
Gain 120 Maxhp: effectively giving her 150 maxhp.
Take reduce damage.

**Wheatpouch is a classified precious item. Upon dropping, it is (blown away) aka destroyed after 20 sec. During the 20 sec grace period a player can retrieve the pouch by holding spacebar over the last known position.


A new wheatpouch can be crafted under the survival tab. The current recipe is 1 rope, 20 grass, 10 petals.


[h1]Weakness:[/h1]
Horo is a prideful wolf. She will not eat stale or spoiled food. (She can eat monster related food)
Horo must carry around her wheat or she will perish. [b]Remember to wear it!![/b] 
Horo cannot use human gathering tools [she can still shave Lawrence though]

[h1]FAQ:[/h1]
Q: Why is Horo isn't it Holo?
A: I read the original book and it was written as ホロ so I've known it as Horo. It does not make this any less "Holo". Because it's ingrain in my head as Horo I have written everything as Horo and will continue writing my code as such for sake of convenience. Changing this to Holo will take considerable amount of time. I will amend this to Holo went I am done dealing with other more critical issues. Please bare with me until then.   

Q: Does the mod have any known incompatibilities?
A: Advanced Farming DST is the only mod to be incompatible with this one. I'm not quite sure what causes it for the advance farming. They just don't seem to agree with each other. 

Q: Why is this still in alpha?
A: Because all the fun aspect are taking me a while to implement correctly. However the core functions of the character is here.

Q: How do I hunt if everything is back at home when i'm strong?
A: "A wise wolf thinks outside of the box."

Q: Will there be more things to come?
A: Yes of course. Now that I have released the characters I wanted to make, I can focus on working in the really fun mechanics!

Q: I need to contact you stat! Where do I find you friend!? 
A: www.twitch.tv/hyaciao I literally cast as I code/animate/draw whatever. If you got comments, suggestions, request or even if you just need to throw a pillow at someone you can find me there.

[h1]Special Thanks[/h1]
DarkXero on Klei Forums for well.. pretty much every interesting related to fun mechanics!
& other posters who indirectly helped me by asking questions on the forums!

And of course to all the players who hurl their feedbacks at me relentlessly. Please keep them coming!

publishedfiledetails.title: Item Scroller

click the icon or enter /itemscroller in chatbox in game to open the config page
and for DS here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2973070136] Item Scroller [/url]

Original modname :MouseWheel Adjust StackSize(it's a bad name so i renamed it)

[h2]it's a SERVER MOD !!! Why?[/h2]
you can't take one item to cursor from the itemslot in original game, so it's no choice i have to make it server mod

[h2]How To Use:[/h2]
1.Focus on the item in container or inventory
2.Mouse Wheel Up to increase stacksize, get ten of them with holding ctrl(the keybind of Force Stack)
3.Mouse Wheel Down to decrease stacksize, lose ten with holding ctrl
4.Press MouseMid when cursor focusing in container HUD, the item in active slot will auto transfer

[h2]KNOWN ISSUE:[/h2]
the update of item‘s amount may exist a delay once you do a continuous scrolling. I guess it's caused by time cost of data sync between client and server. So i recommend you to use this mod in a solo game. especially the world with no-cave or enabled [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2657513551] don't starve alone [/url]mod .

publishedfiledetails.title: Kagerou Imaizumi | Touhou Project
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][i]Kagerou Imaizumi[/i][/h1]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Kagerou is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Kagerou, the Shadow of the Bamboo Forest, one night went outside of her usual territory in search of food and for mysterious reasons ended up in this weird place.

Unlike most werewolves, she isn't aggresive at all, and tries to live her life in peace, hiding her true nature. She seriously dislikes going out during a full moon, since she gets all hairy.[/i]

[i]- Base Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]150[/b]
Hunger: [b]150[/b]
Sanity: [b]300[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Very Calm][/b]

Facing enemies and witnessing strange events makes less impact on your sanity.
Your sanity drains slower while in the dark, however the effect is weakened during the day.

[b][Fluffy Ears and Tail][/b]

You possess a natural resistance to cold temperatures.
Depending on the time of day, the effect will increase or decrease.

[b][Night Huntress][/b]

Awaken some of your true power at night, moving very fast and dealing more damage to enemies.
As you become stronger, your appetite will also increase.

[i]- Weakneses -[/i]

[b]Perks are very weak during the day and provide only a small benefit during the Dusk.[/b]
[b]Sanity drain is very low, however it is more difficult to restore it back to normal.[/b]
[b]Hunger drain at night is very high and you need to have vision to make use of your increased attributes.[/b]
[b]If you die or reconnect, you lose all of your perks and bonus stats until the next day.[/b]

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Hound's Tooth[/b]
[b]Fur Roll[/b]
[b]Sewing Kit[/b]

[i]-Changelog -[/i]

Changelog (Last Update: 28.12.2016 - Version 1.3.8)

Version 0.7.5 - Fixed the disappearing body parts glitch.
Version 0.9.1 - Slightly tweaked the Ears and Tail.
Version 0.9.3 - Slightly polished Facial Animations.
Version 0.9.6 - Added Map Icons, Avatars, Name Logos, Save Slot and Select Screen Portraits.
Version 1.0.0 - Uploaded to Steam Workshop.
Version 1.0.1 - Cleaned up mod files and fixed a few bugs.
Version 1.1.0 - Replaced Perks with one's that work.
Version 1.1.1 - Fixed mod files not updating properly.
Version 1.2.0 - Slightly tweaked the perks.
Version 1.2.1 - Added some starting items.
Version 1.2.2 - Fixed some rare minor bugs.
Version 1.2.5 - Fixed the Character Select Screen.
Version 1.3.0 - Completely reworked how Perk bonus stat scaling works.
Version 1.3.1 - Added a notification when certain perk effects trigger.
Version 1.3.2 - Minor tweaks and fixes.
Version 1.3.6 - Updated for the newer versions of the game.
Version 1.3.8 - Minor tweaks for better compatibility with the "A New Reign" update.

[i]- Frequently Asked Questions -[/i]

[b][Bug?][/b] This custom character is slightly taller than the default Don't Starve characters, so if you change out the clothes for the body, the head may appear as floating in the air. It's not really a bug, the game doesn't properly support larger character models, so it's not easily fixable by me. I'm sorry, but just deal with it and stick to the default torso.

[i][b]Cheers, Good Luck and Have Fun! ;)[/b][/i]

publishedfiledetails.title: Help Me Up!
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
## Help Me UP

When you die, you will become a corpse instead of a ghost. Just like *The Forge*, others can help you up.
After a certain delay, the corpse becomes a ghost. The delay time is 1 minutes by default and can be customized.
You can enter /rip to become a ghost immediately.
By default, you won`t become a corpse if you were killed by starvation.

For woodie in were-forms, he will become a ghost directly.
It also works in wilderness mode.

publishedfiledetails.title: Advanced World Generation
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]END OF DEVELOPMENT AND GOODBYE[/b][/h1]
I have stopped the development of this and future mods. 
More information can be found on the link below. 
[url=data.ewul.net/dlc/Game/DST/goodbye.html]Goodbye[/url].

[h1][b]MAIN FEATURES:[/b][/h1]
Introduces "Infuse Worlds" feature which brings Cave content above ground mixed with normal biomes. By default there will be no darkness in such a world (except in the night time of course). If you want darkness, you can combine "Infuse Worlds" with "Day" World Generation option by setting it to "Only Night". When using it with "Only Night" game option make sure to enable the "Lights Out Mod Starting Items" so that the player spawns in with a Lantern and a bit of fuel for it to get the adventure started.
When the option is enabled, then there is no need to create a separate cave world server instance.
(Due to game limitations, the "labyrinth" biome is not found when using Infused Worlds feature, because that results the biome textures to become invisible)

Introduces existing and not yet included Set Pieces into the game world. Each Set Piece can also be enabled or disabled and the amount placed in the world is configurable. (Don't be suprised if not all your Set Pieces get added to the world which you configured previously. This is due to the problem of the world generation itself and sometimes the world can't find a free spot for the Set Piece)

You can set multiple Giants spawn locations which means multiple Giants can spawn into the world.

Enables the world size to go beyond normal limits, in other words, colossal sizes. (Be aware that huge map sizes require powerful servers and map generation might require multiple tries in order for the World Generation algorithm not to hit the "Infinite Edge" which causes the map generation to fail)

Can add Nightmare Phase to Overworld.

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b][/h1]
The mod must be enabled during the start of a new world generation step. When enabled on an already created world, the mod does nothing.
When the mod gets bigger updates then the world reset is ONLY required if you want to have the new updates in your world, otherwise the world is just fine and players can keep playing in it normally without problems.
When generating a new world: 

1) Dedicated Server: Place "worldgenoverride.lua" in Servers Data Store location. This is the path where all the world and player data is stored. There are also files like "server_chat_log.txt", "server_log.txt" and "server.ini" in that location. This is the directory which you can set yourself via the command line parameter so it's different on different machines and setups, but the default should be located at ".\My Documents\Klei\DoNotStarveTogether\". Although do note that this is also the same location where the files can be found on server hosted from inside the game, so make sure if you have set the location yourself or use the default location.
You can get a documented copy of said file from here [url=data.ewul.net/dlc/game/dst/lua/worldgenoverride.lua.txt]WorldGenOverride[/url]
You can replace "default" values with any valid values provided inside the sample "worldgenoverride.lua" file.
Simply copy the content from the link to a file placed in the correct location and named "worldgenoverride.lua", then change the default values to your liking or leave them default.
After all that is done, simply run your dedicated server, wait for a bit and everything should be working fine. Please note that this only works when the world is freshly generated, applying this method to already generated world does nothing to the server.
If you want to enable the Infused World option, you have to change the "preset" value to "INFUSED" and "task_set" value to "infused" in worldgenoverride.

2) Server Hosted from inside the game: You can change any values you want from the "World" settings. 
If you want to enable the Infused World option then first enable the mod and then go to "World" tab and change the Forest Presets to "Infused".

[i]If you are using "modoverrides.lua", here is an example configuration which you can simply copy/paste to yours and change values if needed so you don't have to manually write all the settings parameters yourself: 
(If you use other mods as well, simply add this part into the existing "modoverrides.lua" you have)
[url=data.ewul.net/dlc/game/dst/lua/modoverrides_advanced_world_generation_and_cave_content.lua.txt]Modoverrides for Advanced World Generation[/url] 
Please note that the example "modoverrides.lua" uses default values of the mod. If you want to change something, go under mods install directory, open up "modinfo.lua" and check the correct configuration number values from there and then apply them to your "modoverrides.lua".[/i]

This mod is incompatible with the following mods: "The Order Is Given" (The mod has not been updated a long time), "Tungsten Mod" (Causes invisible walls).
The world size should be set to "Huge" when encountering errors when generating worlds according to few user reports who used this method and it helped. (There was and still might be a bug from Klei which messes with mods and world generation on certain world sizes, so just use "Huge" to be safe)

[h1][b]SIDE NOTES:[/b][/h1]
Some features are planned for the future as well, these I will implement when i have more time.
If you have recommendations to the mod, leave a comment down below.

Recommended mods to use together with this mod:
[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=597417408]Less Lags[/url] - Mod that makes all the servers capable of running infinite number of days without getting laggy from all the prefabs that get generated in long running servers. When the mod is configured correctly it periodically deletes some or all prefabs (items, monsters, animals etc) from the entire world and keeps it lag free.

[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=758921911]Increase Animals[/url] - Mod which adds in even more Set Pieces and you can tweak the number of animals/monsters in the world.

[h1][b]BUG REPORTING:[/b][/h1]
Add all your bug reports under "Discussions" > "Bug Reports". (To avoid Comment section cluttering)
Also a great help is if you can upload your crash log "log.txt" to [url=pastebin.com/]PasteBin[/url] and link me the crash log that way in the bug section with a description what did you do before the crash occured.

[h1][b]LIVE CHAT:[/b][/h1]
If you wish to talk to Me or other players or users of this Mod, you can join us on Live chat where we can discuss problems, ask questions or simply chat about random things.
Join here and proceed to "Gaming" room: [url=im.ewul.net/public/]EWUL Public Chat[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: 【明日方舟】归溟幽灵鲨
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
人物属性：
生命值：150（+34.5）
san值：200
饱食度：150
攻击系数：1.5
防御系数：0

人物物品
初始根据皮肤不同带有皮肤不同的帽子与武器。
1.帽子：
头部装备，无耐久
初始40%减伤，给予木甲/影甲/铥矿护甲分别可以使减伤提升至50%/60%/70%
给予巨鹿眼球可获得100%防水
+20%移速
穿戴时可以在水上行走，且每秒增加一点潮湿度。
穿戴该帽子时，即使潮湿度过高工具也不会脱手。
2.唱片：
手部装备，无耐久，攻击速度略慢
攻击力：51/59.5/68/100（可在模组配置界面修改）
攻击距离：1
不会因为潮湿而脱手。
可通过给予武器不同的宝石解锁不同的技能。（旧版本特性，现版本不需要了）
技能详见技能介绍。
3.唱片收藏箱：
护符，最高可升级至三级。
配方：4绝望石+2电子元件+8金块/一级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+3红宝石+10金块/二级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+4彩虹宝石+12金块
属性：
生命值上限+50/65/90（不受人物特性的加成）
攻击系数+0.2/0.3/0.5
防御系数：0/20%/50%
特效：
替身基础伤害提升至23/34.5/46
减速效果提升至40%/50%/60%
4.未竟之美：
护符，最高可升级至三级。
配方：4绝望石+2大理石+8金块/一级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+3红宝石+10金块/二级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+4彩虹宝石+12金块
属性：
san值上限+100/200/300
攻击系数+0.1/0.2/0.35
防御系数：15%/35%/70%
特效：
san值吸收伤害比例提升至60%/67%/75%
替身移动速度提升至：4/5/6
5.唱片：
武器，无耐久，较慢的攻速但是较高的伤害（可配置）
6.新建帽子：无耐久，初始40%减伤，可使用木甲/影甲/铥矿甲升级至50%/60%/70%减伤，并且可以给予其一颗巨鹿眼球来获得100%防水

技能树：
详见游戏内
月光阵营：（对暗影加伤10%）
来自月光的抚慰让你更加强壮
受到的伤害降低，降低的比例随月相变化，满月时达到最低0%，新月时达到最高30%（目前减伤因为未知原因没生效）
暗影阵营：（对月光加伤10%）
来自暗影的抚慰让你更加清醒
San值过低时不会变身也不会恢复生命值与理智值，而是只获得替身形态的伤害光环（伤害与替身光环一致）
且替身光环的伤害提升，提升的比例随月相变化，新月时达到最高30%，满月时达到最低0%

生活质量更新（2024/03/15）
1.技能UI可拖动，缩放，mod配置界面可以设置是否禁用快捷键释放（默认禁用）
2.技能UI显示持续时显示持续时间，冷却时显示冷却时间，处于可用状态时高亮，不可用时暗淡
3.替身形态不打墙，有UI显示伤害范围，替身范围修改为6
4.二技能锁血时间+1秒（不然可能没来及变身就暴毙）；另外三技能期间，唱片的攻击动画替换回默认攻击动画而不是栅栏击剑的攻击动画
5.幽灵鲨的所有专属物品都不再会进入潮湿状态，帽子使用巨鹿眼球升级后增加防雷
6.身上即使拥有被诅咒的饰品也不会变成猴子
诅咒饰品不会主动附身
身上的被诅咒的饰品可以同普通物品一样被丢弃
7.现在雕像在单独的制作栏中
8.添加喜爱的食物：海鲜杂烩
9.不可以装备骨盔和紫护符，除非加入暗影阵营
变身时的音效替换
技能语音替换，使用技能时随机从所有语音中选择一个播放，并可在mod设置内选择语言版本

未来的更新计划：包括且不限于
增加新的专属物品
增加一个可爱的跟宠
一个喋喋不休但是会竭尽全力帮助你的神奇热水壶（咕咕咕）

前往安戈洛冒险
取消模组的防御属性，替换为位面防御》（2024/03/16做的饼）

2024/03/16 希望不要炸档

[h1][i]Toyosatomimi no Miko[/i][/h1]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Miko is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Miko was once an almighty ruler of these lands, some even considered her a saint, as she always came to help humans in need, displaying incredible supernatural abilities.

She enjoyed her simple and carefree life, however her travels across the country eventually brought her to a very bizzarre place... [/i]

Health: [b]200[/b]
Hunger: [b]200[/b]
Sanity: [b]200[/b]

You require very little sustenance to survive.
When it's not day time, the effect becomes weaker.

[b][Child of Light][/b]

During the day you are faster, deal more damage and receive less.
Night is a very dangerous time for you to be outside.

[b][Blessing of the Seven Stars][/b]

You possess an aura of light that protects you against the darkness.
Provides some vision around you during the night.

[b]During the night you are very slow, deal lower damage and take extra damage.[/b]

publishedfiledetails.title: No Extinction
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Prevent Beefalo, Volt Goat, Spider Den, Hollow Stump, Knight, Bee Hive, Rock Lobster and Slurtle Mound from extinction.

Checking the current number of Beefalo, Volt Goat, Spider Den, Hollow Stump and Bee Hive upon the death of them, if the current number is less than the least num that was set, it will spawn them near the death spot or randomly, so that prevents the extinction of them.

[h1]Configuration for Dedicated Server[/h1]

[code]
  ["workshop-1974725370"]={
    configuration_options={
      leastnum_beefalo=2,
      leastnum_catcoonden=2,
      leastnum_lightninggoat=2,
      leastnum_spiderden=2,
      leastnum_beehive=2,
      leastnum_knight=2,
      leastnum_rocky=2,
      leastnum_slurtlehole=2,
    },
    enabled=true 
  },
[/code]

Everyone thank [b]Zarklord[/b] for the amazing fix, that's been long overdue (I myself haven't touched the mod for almost 3 years now)

Since a lot of people don't know Tungsten: Tungsten, also known as Wolfram is the hardest elemental metal. Chemical Symbol is W. -> [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tungsten]Wikilink[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: [ArkNights] Mudrock
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod cease updating because i have to prepare for an exam.New contents will probably be added in 2024(summer?)

Before you stands,
The Sarkaz mercenary,
The former friends of the fertile earth and the rock,
And our youthful and beautiful Sarkaz big girl - Mudrock!
---------------------------------------------


[h1]Basic Attributes[/h1]
---------------------------------------------
Health 300 (she is a reliable shield!)
Hunger 150
Sanity 200

Hunger rate 1.5 (high stamina drain due to prolonged use of Originium Arts to maintain her shield)
Movement speed 0.9

Mudrock has her own elite level.
As the elite level increases, new skills are unlocked and existing skills are enhanced.
Mudrock's highly Oripathy Infected body is not suitable for the The Constant.
As a result, similar to the Arknights, she is unable to gain health from any food, ointment, even unable to get risistance from armor. (jellybeans are still in effect)
Mudrock is the master of rocks, and half of the rock consumption will be returned when making items containing rocks in the recipe.
---------------------------------------------

[h1]Traits and Skills[/h1]
---------------------------------------------
[h1][Ward of the Fertile Soil][/h1]
Unlocked when elite 0/Passive Skill
Mudrock gains a shield every once in a while, up to several layers can be stacked at the same time.
Each layer of shield can fully resist one damage and restore a large amount of health when the shield breaks.

[h1][DEF Up γ][/h1]
Unlocked when Elite 0/Passive Skill
Mudrock's damage from enemies is reduced by a fixed amount.(10/15/20)

[h1][Crag Splitter][/h1]
Unlocked when Elite 1/Defensive Recovery/Auto Trigger/
press j(default) to enable or disable the skill
Mudrock's next attack turns to a higher damage AOE attack and restores a certain amount of health.
It has a 33% chance to interrupt and stun the enemy for a while.

[h1][Unshakable Solidarity][/h1]
Unlocked when elite 2
Mudrock takes 30% less damage from "Krampus", "Klaus" and "Rocky".
They are also Sarkaz.
(PS This is actually an Easter Egg skill of little value XD)

[h1][Bloodline of Desecrated Earth][/h1]
Unlocked when elite 2/Auto Recovery/Manual Trigger/
press k(default) to perform the skill
Mudrock enters a ten-second sleep, during which she cannot be selected and is invincible, and continues to slow down surrounding enemies.
After this state ends, it stuns surrounding enemies immediately,
Mudrock attack speed increases, the attack turns to a higher damage AOE attack, and gain a certain absorption.
---------------------------------------------

[h1]Some additional items[/h1]
---------------------------------------------
[h1]"Sarkaz Hammer":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096239111343/26F395F83ACBED113ECAB1D99E3D02207D2E697E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
TECH.Science ONE. Hammer*1, transistor*2, rocks*12
Can be crafted from Mudrock only,.
It can be used as a hammer and weapon;
Attack 89. Mudrock restores 0.5 points of [Crag Splitterr] and [Bloodline of Desecrated Earth] skill sp per attack when equipped.And it won't be off your hand.
No duration, but will lengthen equipper's min attack period by 2 times.
[h1]"Ordinary Mud Statue":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096239211111/98072EF1C40515DF547471E9C2BF2B59C0ADA2AB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
TECH.none. Rocks*4, Ice*1, Nightmare Fuel*1
Can be crafted by Mudrock only.
It can be put down on the ground to talk to.
After the dialogue the mud statue disappears and the interlocutor's movement speed and working efficiency are increased to 1.2 times for the next 240 seconds;
During this time, the total sanity points decreases slowly by 24 points in total.
If interlocutor is Mudrock, it goes up by 24 points instead.
[h1]"Horrible Mud Statue":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096239221728/77DC6FA9D01235E4F03EE838809AC7A219643191/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
TECH.Magic One. Ordinary Mud statue*1, Rocks*6, Health*170
Can only be made by Mudrock .
It can instantly transport the user to a specified point on the screen. (similar to Wortox's soul)
Costs the user 50 sanity points.
When the user is Mudrock , it does not consume Sanity and summon a Mudrock Colossus at the location before teleportation.

[h1]"Mudrock Colossus":[/h1]
Summoned by Mudrock when using Horrible Mud statue.
Attack 250, attack speed is slow; Health 15,000, loses 250 health per second.
During its existence,it continuously taunt surrounding mobs,and 85% of the damage to Mudrock will transfer to Mudstone Colossus.
[h1]"Elite 1 Book":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096238992037/CC4EB8167335F0908793FE8FB72E5A7C98251E58/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
TECH.Magic One. Gold*3, Demon Petal*4, Rock*24
Can only be crafted by Mudrock to raise Mudrock's elite level to elite 1.
[h1]"Elite 2 Book":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096239008039/97DA672075B3C7DEE3C2170F66922EFC91EEED5D/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
TECH.Magic Two. Gold*180, Moonlight Glass*16, Crushed Snail Shell*20
Can only be crafted by Mudrock to raise Mudrock's elite level to elite 2
[h1]"Mudrock Cake":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096238971124/1C1D9FF7E34DDAC421C8861C7056CF47CDAC9023/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096238942308/FB5B9C18D06CC281FB1F3F12E182E08A403261FF/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
Contains dairy,sweetener and one rock ,no meat to cook (this mod adds rocks to the pot)
All characters can cook it in the pot, stacks 4 a time, use hammer to smash it open before eating it.
Restore 120 points of hunger, 10 points of health, 20 points of sanity.
Eaters hunger consumption rate is 40% and gain 40% damage reduction for one day.
[h1]"Juggernaut Defender Prune Sparkling Juice":[/h1][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2068884096239294217/14C33452B5E439EEC44550F352F97CD17E0EAEC0/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
Contains pomegranate, one fruit, one rock,no meat to cook.
All characters can cook it in the pot.
Restores 25 hunger, 10 life, 20 spirit points.
If the eater is Mudrock, the hunger rate is doubled for the next 60 seconds, but benefits from eating any food is *1.5.
If the eater is other character, it gains an additional shield of [Ward of the Fertile Soil] that lasts for up to 60 seconds and can resistant damage once.
Before the shield is broken,hunger rate is doubled, the benefits from eating and food*1.5; and restores 1 point of health every two seconds.
Restores 20% of maximum health immediately when the shield disapears because of attack.

-------------------------------------
*The Original Character is from Arknights
*qq: 605419759
*More content is still in production, the current presumed content has mudrock armor, boss mudrock as well as mudrock module.
*mod just online bugs maybe more, welcome feedback 
*I can see the feedback on steam,but usually not able to respond because of"discussion is not available in your area"ww
*Translator used,sorry if it is weird.

publishedfiledetails.title: 自动整理箱子/Auto Chest Sorting [Updated]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]111111订阅达成！感谢大家的支持！[/h1]
[h1]Thanks for 111111 subscription! [/h1]

[h1]介绍[/h1]
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

不允许搬运至WeGame！

关上箱子时，自动合并堆叠、整理顺序，支持新更新的大箱子。
可以选择是否整理冰箱和盐盒。

理论上兼容[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686644079]修改箱子容量[/url]、[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3210646292]修改堆叠数量[/url]之类的模组。

特别为 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=382177939]地窖/Storm Cellar[/url] 和 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=623749604]储藏室/Storeroom[/url] 添加了支持。
还有其它[b]模组容器[/b]支持，包括但不限于棱镜、勋章、海洋传说、怠惰科技等，详见改动日志。
[b]*别忘了在配置选项中打开“模组支持”功能！[/b]

------

Automatically sorts loot in chests on closing, with new tall chests supported.

Works well with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686644079]Chest Size Tweak[/url]、[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3210646292]Stack Size Tweak[/url].

Added support for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=382177939]Storm Cellar[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=623749604]Storeroom[/url]. 
And more Mod containers are supported! See change log for detail. 
[b]*Don't forget to turn "Add Mod Support" on in mod settings! [/b]

[h2]关于模组容器整理[/h2]

如果内置的模组容器支持没有覆盖到你正在使用的模组，你可以按以下方法手动添加：
在 modmain.lua 的末尾，第 130 行附近，我预留了模组物品的清单。
如果你想让支持更多模组容器，只需要在这里写入容器预制件的名称即可。
[b]别忘了打开设置里的“模组支持”选项！[/b]
[code]
local mod_prefab_list = 
{
	"storeroom",			--储藏室
	"cellar",			--地窖
	"medal_livingroot_chest",	--勋章的树根宝箱
	"bearger_chest",		--勋章的熊皮宝箱
	-- （篇幅原因 此处省略部分内置列表）
	----- 在下面添加模组容器预制件名称，注意使用英文引号与逗号 -----



	----- 在上面添加模组容器预制件名称，注意使用英文引号与逗号 -----
}
[/code]
[h3]注意：模组的更新会导致手动写入的内容被覆盖，请自行备份[/h3]
[h3]也可以分享到 Steam 创意工坊讨论区，或者发 GitHub PR，让作者写进模组[/h3]


[quote]
修改自 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2321974509]Automatic Chest Sorting[/url]，修复了一些问题，并添加了中文翻译与指南。
原作者：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198141846200]buzite26[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198287605330]Efrem4ik[/url]
代码与图标资源托管于GitHub：CharlesHim/DST_Auto-Chest-Sorting
[/quote]

此mod可以让你在玩其他人物的时候，使用阿比盖尔之花，虽然主要是为了让其他角色也能使用阿比，但关闭①，②选项后，也可以单纯作为玩温蒂时，使用阿比盖尔的加强使用。
同时可和原版的药剂与姐妹骨灰坛搭配。

①让阿比盖尔之花给其他角色绑定使用(可关闭)
②其他角色开局初始物品增加阿比盖尔之花(可关闭)
③血量提升︰100>300，300>600，600>1000，另有阿比无法被攻击的选项(默认关闭)。
④阿比盖尔每秒回血(1~30)
⑤攻击力提升，可调整范围为25%~500%
⑥攻击范围提升增强(可调整)。
⑦阿比盖尔可以攻击理智怪兽。
⑧夏天制冷帮忙降温(建议20~40)。

⭐此外对于温蒂和阿比盖尔之间也有一些修改
①"温蒂"召唤阿比盖尔免去扣除理智
②阿比盖尔存在时，温蒂能够持续回复理智(可调1~50)。
(姐妹两的羁绊就是最棒的！)

适用情况:
萌新入坑，许多怪物都很可怕，理智狂掉被影怪揍？
饥荒有很多有趣的mod，有些还有些特殊的人物包含在里面，不玩可惜，但是打怪技术又不好？
又或者你的朋友，卡的要死要死毫无游戏体验？
这种情况就可以下载本mod，让阿比盖尔姐姐来保护你，让我们一起来做姐姐的小fw！


我讨厌夏天，太阳对我进行烧烤的画面和声音，因此我让姐姐也可以在夏天制冷陪伴我，毕竟姐姐是幽灵，凉凉的很合理吧？(所以冬天没有制暖是正常的)
可与饥荒原版阿比盖尔灵药搭配使用。


⚠以下翻译來自討論區"Diako"友情提供:

This mod was a custom commission that I paid for—I'm not a mod maker myself, but I thought maybe others would find it useful too, so I'm sharing it for everyone to enjoy!
If it helps you out, please give it a like and add it to your favorites—it makes me happy to see that! 😄

With this mod, you can use Abigail’s Flower while playing other characters. While it was mainly made so non-Wendy characters can also use Abigail, if you turn off options ① and ②, it can simply serve as a powerful upgrade when playing as Wendy.

Main Features:

Description of the new version 'Hatter's hat store' is now in the 'version changes'.

Dear players, if you are still enjoying this mod, Seele and you could read English instead of Chinese, please let me know you. If there's still quite amount of players who are quite in need of English translations, it's essential for me to offer you English service.
Since it has been several months since I last see someone talking under this mod using English, I didn't write the English announcement for the latest new versions, which still contains several new equipment and new functions.
If you need English description, tell me and I'd like to tell you then.

You can change the language into English in the options.

Warning: Do not play this character alone, unless you are as lonely as me. If you have to, please get familiar with Seele first. 

It could be quite interesting if Seele meets Bronya.

Art designer：魔法少女唐间竹子（咕噜猫）
Programmer：eatmew（半条咸鱼）
Lord of pigeons：鸽子（乃木鸽子）
Thanks to：宵征大佬，希儿量子态的漂浮动作使用了他编写的函数。并且使用了板鸭的动画素材。

The swimsuit is in the wardrobe now! Enjoy the sea!


[b]Remember to press “R” to examine the UI[/b]
[b]This is quite a complex character. If you don’t want to read so many instructions, just learn how the state changes. Then you can enjoy the character.[/b]

The introductions are in the discussion.
The introductions are in the discussion.
The introductions are in the discussion.



Seele Vollerei

From mobile game [guns girlZ]

She’s a girl from orphanage, who loves fairy tales and her sister Bronya.
A scary experiment quantized her, and drive her away from the world. 
Then ,she came to the world of don’t starve together. She has to live on.



About the character:
Seele can get experience by killing monsters, reading books and killing boss.
Raising her level would increase her hunger, health ,sanity and attack.
When her level is higher than 10,  reading books wouldn’t give her experience.
When her level is higher than 20,  killing monsters wouldn’t give her experience.
Her highest level is 30.


Seele has three states, but she’s blocked in [normal Seele] state in the first two days.

Quantum Seele:
Seele become mysterious, which means she could neither attack other creatures nor use tools. She couldn’t even make anything by herself.
However, in this state, Seele could move quite fast and could see at night. She could also read books.

Normal Seele:
This is how Seele really should be. She loves the world, she would make everyone around her increase sanity.  She hate killing small animals. She loves reading books.

Killer Seele:
This is her other personality. She’s cruel, she’s powerful and swift, but being her would spend quite a lot of hunger and sanity. She hates fairy tales, so she could no longer benefit from the books.

How to change the state:
Seele is usually in the quantun state. When being chased by an enemy, or accompanied by a friend (including other player or pigmen) ,she’ll become normal state. Reading fairy tales also keep her away from quantum state for a while. I have to tell you, the last book [ball lightening] written by Liu cixin isn’t a fairy tale.
Without those help, she’ll become quantum state soon.

When seele is badly hurt (lost her health into 1/3), she’ll become the killer state. When she is will healed (her health become more than 4/5), she’ll turn back to the normal state. If she has little hunger or sanity left (less than 1/10), she ‘ll also turn back to the normal state.



When you get level 10, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s will (press Z to turn on/off)
After turning on , you’ll get a layer of ‘will’ per second. Each layer will increase your attack and decrease the damage you suffer. However, it’ll also spend you more hunger.
Each time you are hurt, the layer would be divided by half.
If you get more than 20 layers, you won’t lost sanity for fear of the night or the monsters.


When you get level 15, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s harmony (press X to turn on/off)
After turning on, you’ll spend other weapon instead of itself when you use your reaper or you magic box. Be careful, do not waste your precious weapons (including your books) by this skill.
The skill has another usage: when you fix your weapons or clothes by the abyssal crystal or tears, your attack will increase for a will. Tears would make this last longer.


When you get level 20, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s banquet
When you are beaten by a fatal attack ,you’ll evade it, but keep losing more health in 10 seconds. During this time, you’ll get stronger and each one you killed would heal you.
This CD would cool down for a whole day after being triggered.

publishedfiledetails.title: Too Many Items 更新汉化
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
饥荒弃坑了一年多
很怀念以前和安然逗比们一起建家打怪的日子
现在版本跟新变化很大，作为回归礼物，更新以前自己用的一款主机测试MOD供大家使用
原MOD地址 http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=551338671

自由生成物品。 搜索你想要的物品和控制服务器。 7 种不同的物品标签方便使用。

使用方法：
普通：
按 T 键显示菜单。（可以在选项中更改）
CTRL + 点击菜单中生命、精神、饥饿、湿度、温度 和 伍迪的木头值按钮 将得到相反的结果。
搜索步骤：点击 "搜索你要的物品！" -> 输入搜索内容 -> Enter 键。
选择生效玩家步骤：点击调试菜单中的 "人物" 指示按钮 -> 输入玩家的序号或昵称 -> 确认。

物品生成：
单击生成 1 个物品。（可以在选项中更改）
右击生成 10 个物品。（可以在选项中更改）
SHIFT + 单击或右击得到和物品生成数量份数的制作材料。
CTRL + 点击加入或移除自定义物品列表。
自动 在你的物品栏中 或 人物旁边 生成。

搜索时的按键：
Enter 键或点击任意位置：搜索输入的内容。
UP 键：上个输入内容。
DOWN 键：下个输入内容或清空输入的内容。
ESC 键：退出输入。

说明：
客户端MOD。
无需服务器开启，开了也没用。
只有在检测到拥有主机或管理员权限时，MOD 的菜单才会出现。

物品列表： All 所有, Foods 食物, Resources 资源, Weapons 武器, Tools 工具, Clothes 穿戴, Gifts 礼物, Livings 生物, buildings 建筑和 Others 其他。
其他当前未添加入列表物品 和 MOD 物品在 Others 其他物品列表中。
仅支持在当前使用的物品列表里搜索。
搜索功能会记录搜索过的内容。（最大记录数量可以在选项中设置）

其他功能：上帝模式 || 创造模式 || 一击必杀模式 || 改变生命、精神、饥饿、湿度、温度 和 伍迪的木头刻度 || 改变 季节、时间、速度 和 天气 || 杀人 || 复活 || 清空背包 || 返回选人界面 || 召集队友 || 重启 || 换图 || 回滚 || 储存 || 地图控制 || 传送点记录读取 || 删除、施肥、催熟、收获、拾取、冻结 周围目标 || 驯化牛 || 随从控制 || 关掉服务器

可以选择命令对哪个玩家生效。（仅和你在同一个世界有效）

本 MOD 的数据是可存储的。（可以在选项中关闭）
不同的世界的传送功能数据会分开存储。（放心的存储你的位置吧！）
不支持手柄或控制器。

注意：
没有这个 MOD 你也可以用命令达到相同的作用。它只是一个图形化界面。
使用这个将会降低游戏乐趣，请不要肆意使用。
其他物品列表里的东西有可能会导致游戏崩溃。(小心使用 )


如何添加管理员：
adminlist.txt：

请你的朋友加入你的游戏。
在路径：文档/klei/don't starve together/client_save(主机 ) 或 cluster.ini 同目录(服务器 ) 下建立 adminlist.txt 并打开。
请你的朋友在游戏中按 Y 或 U 键说句话。
在文本文档文件：文档/klei/don't starve together/client_chat_log.txt 中查找玩家的 ID。（示例：KU_********(在线) / OU_12345678901234567(离线)）
复制 ID 到 adminlist.txt 并保存。(每行一个 ID)
重启服务器，就会发现添加了 ID 的朋友已是管理员。


Steam 组：

使用 Steam 组来管理服务器及管理员。 [forums.kleientertainment.com]
设置 steam_group_admins = true，并且在 steam 组中设置玩家为官员（按两次星，星变成黄金色）。
重启服务器，就会发现设置了官员的朋友已是管理员。


命令列表 [dont-starve-game.wikia.com]
中文維基 [zh.dontstarve.wikia.com]
搭建服务器教程(英文) [forums.kleientertainment.com]

鸣谢：
原作者 C.J.B.
GaRAnTuLA 修复了 BUG。
SKULL  UI 的重写，bug 的修复，增加：搜索功能、不同物品列表、丰富的其他指令。

publishedfiledetails.title: Cluster Plant. Reborn!
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Plant things, in clusters!

What it does:

Adds recipes to the refine tab to allow for planting grass, saplings, pinecones, and berrybushes in clusters.

How to use:

After installing and launching the game, configure the Cluster Plant mod in the mods menu. Choose the grid size and secondary resource scale, hit apply and play!

In the game, hover over the recipes in the refine tab. Meet the requirements and plant away!

Note: On the secondary resource scale, the base number is the grid size (so 3x3 would be 9, 5x5 would be 25) the scale is multiplied by the base number. So a 3x3 with a 100% scale will be 1*(3*3) = 9. The result is the number of secondary resources required to craft the recipe in game.

Why this was made:

I was tired of misclicking things while planting fields of things. Also, I wanted to learn how to modify things for fun.

Special thanks:

Klei Entertainment - for making a fantastically modular game.

rezecib - for answering all my silly questions on the forums

publishedfiledetails.title: Wormholes and Sinkholes Icons For Server
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
I really liked the Wormhole Icons mod, but it was quite annoying to try to communicate with other persons if you wanted to talk about a specific wormhole. That's why I created this mod to combat this problem!

[h1]Overview[/h1]

This mod gives Wormhole Icons to every person on the server, but as it's a server mod, everyone has the same numbers!
This makes it much easier to communicate with each other!
I added an option to rename wormholes to what you want. You can choose in the mod options if everyone can change it or only admins. These changes will propagate to each person, so everybody will see your chosen name.
If you have "Wormhole Icons [Fixed]" activated, but don't want to deactivate it each time you want to use this mod, you can set their mod option "Wormhole marks disables" to Yes and the mod will be deactivated automatically.
This version also supports up to 300 wormholes, so no more crashes if you have more than 10.

Now the mod also gives Sinkholes icons and lets them be renamed. The Sinkholes will have the same color on the surface and the caves! They work the same as the wormhole icons, they can also be deactivated in the config options.

Happy Travelling!

[h1]Notes[/h1]
You can use [code]wis_reset_wormholes()[/code] to reset wormholes and [code]wis_reset_sinkholes()[/code] to reset sinholes.

publishedfiledetails.title: 花样风滚草 Interesting Tumbleweed
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
花样风滚草，也可以叫作“四次元风滚草”，为风滚草增加了更多的可能性。

推荐玩法：少资源模式，除了风滚草外，将其他资源均调成无，一切资源均靠风滚草，考验人品的时候到啦~

-----新增属性-----
幸运值：
1.每个人在加入世界时都会获得50点初始幸运值，幸运值将决定你从风滚草中开出好东西或者坏东西的概率。
2.幸运值的上限为100，下限为0。幸运值越高，开出好东西的几率越大；幸运值越低，开出怪物的几率越大。
3.默认情况下，每开一个风滚草，幸运值会下降一点，当然也可以通过mod设置界面设置游戏难度来控制下降点数，具体分级如下：
简单：开风滚草不降幸运值
普通(默认)：开风滚草扣除1点幸运值
稍难：开风滚草扣除2点幸运值
困难：开风滚草扣除5点幸运值
地狱：开风滚草扣除10点幸运值
4.幸运值可通过使用幸运道具来提升。

-----新增物品-----
符纸：用于制作各种符~
配方：木头*1+草*2（合成栏，二本）

红色羽毛笔：用来绘制转运符
配方：红雀羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

蓝色羽毛笔：用来绘制保运符
配方：雪雀羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

金色羽毛笔：用来绘制改命符
配方：金色羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

祈运符：使用后增加15点幸运值，减少10精神值
配方：符纸*2+羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作，一次性制作两张）

转运符：使用后可将自己的幸运值变化为0~100的随机数，减少10点精神值
配方：符纸*1+红色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

保运符：使用后幸运值重置到50，减少10点精神值
配方：符纸*1+蓝色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

改命符：使用后增加(100-当前幸运值)点幸运值，并扣除与增加的幸运值等量的精神值
配方：符纸*1+金色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

幸运宝石：合成幸运装备的材料
配方：幸运粉尘*5+紫色宝石*1（魔法一本，合成栏）

保运护符：佩戴时开风滚草不减少幸运值，耐久为100，可用幸运粉尘修复
配方：幸运宝石*1+噩梦燃料*3+金子*5（魔法二本，魔法栏）

幸运粉尘：合成幸运道具的基本材料，放在地面上会被风吹走
获得方式：开风滚草、燃烧各种符、幸运果汁过期产物、圣光祝福、幸运之星熄灭产物

幸运法杖：使用后可召唤出一颗幸运之星，消耗33精神，耐久为5次
配方：幸运宝石*1+噩梦燃料*3+活木*2（魔法二本，魔法栏）

幸运之星：会发光、冬暖夏凉，站在旁边会缓慢提升幸运值，拥有圣光祝福的能力，将幸运果实放上去会变成幸运粉尘，持续半天时间，熄灭后随机产生幸运道具

幸运帽：佩戴时+6幸运值/分钟、+6精神值/分钟，120秒保暖效果，耐久5天，可用幸运粉尘修复
配方：幸运宝石*1+海象帽*1+金子*5（蓝图解锁，服装栏）

幸运种子：4.7饥饿，保质期40天，可种出幸运果实，可从风滚草开出

幸运果实：9.4饥饿、-5精神、+5血量、+15幸运值，保质期10天，通过幸运之星的祝福会变成幸运粉尘

幸运果汁：+75饥饿、+15精神、+5血、+40幸运值，保质期2天，过期后会变成幸运粉尘
幸运果汁食谱：幸运果实*2+冰*1+蜂蜜*1

---新增事件---
1.**小海象有几率掉落幸运帽蓝图。
2.第一次开风滚草百分百开出：幸运护符*1+幸运宝石*1+祈运符*1

-----按钮介绍-----
资源再生：默认关闭，关闭时世界资源不再生，防止再生资源影响少资源世界的清静。
难度选择：默认为普通，可调整游戏难度，具体体现为开风滚草扣除的幸运值多少。游戏难度也会影响幸运道具的爆率。
基础资源：一些生存所需的基础资源。
高级资源：一些需要通过打怪、合成或其他方式得到的高级资源。
稀有资源：各种BOSS掉落物、宝石。

「電の本気を見るのです！」

IJN Destroyer Inazuma, from Kantai Collection, or Kancolle.
(My mods are not skin compatible, aka they can't use alternate clothing besides gloves, pants/skirts, and shoes, because of the body proportions being different/taller from the default player proportions. It's not something I can fix.)

(Please update to the latest version before giving feedback, thank you!)

[Stats]
Health: 150
Hunger: 150
Sanity: 150 

[Traits/Perks]
Serious Side: Enters combat mode when struck by lightning. 
Truly an Angel: Gives sanity regen to nearby players. 
Reluctant Fighter: While not in combat mode, Inazuma deals 25% less damage, but has a 10% chance to dodge attacks.

[Serious Side]
When struck by lightning, Inazuma loses 50 sanity and transforms into her Plasma mode. In this mode, Inazuma moves faster, gains an extra 10% chance to dodge for a total of 20%, and both deal and receive 1.5x damage. Her sanity regen aura turns into a sanity drain aura, and she periodically loses sanity unless it's raining. Subsequent lightning strikes decrease her sanity by 20. When her sanity goes above 100, she turns back into normal.

Additionally, if she consumes an eggplant while in this state, she loses 20 sanity and returns to normal. In normal mode, she will lose 10 sanity instead.

Just like Hibiki, all her perks are toggleable in the configurations.

My second Kancolle mod, the cute and clumsy fourth ship of the Akatsuki-class Destroyers, Inazuma. Trying to upload this was a nightmare because the uploader was broken for some reason. I'll eventually do the rest of the Sixth Destroyer Division, but for now I'm probably gonna polish these two.

publishedfiledetails.title: Ice Maker 3000
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Don't have enough Ice to make Ice Cream? Don't worry, the [b]Ice Maker 3000[/b] is here.

Converts Fuel into Ice!

The Ice Maker is a Science structure that can be built in the Shipwrecked DLC. It runs on fuel items. When fueled, it produces one Ice every 30 seconds. If the machine runs out of fuel before 30 seconds have passed since the last Ice was produced, it will shut down and stop producing more until it is refueled, wasting any remaining fuel in the process. It can hold up to 90 seconds of fuel, and each fuel item added increases its duration according to its burn time in a Campfire.

Players cannot turn off the machine while it is running. When examined, some characters have different quotes depending on how much fuel remains in the machine; this is the only way to check its fuel level.

Craft Recipe:
  1x Thermal Stone
  5x Logs
  2x Electrical Doodad
  > Alchemy Engine

Note: The crafting recipe requires the Alchemy Engine (tier 2). You need to be at least next to a Science Machine for it to appear in the crafting menu.

publishedfiledetails.title: Heap of Foods
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sKqdqP2.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This mod is purely about grinding and cooking food! With tons of new content about it, you will surely lose your mind when it comes to using the Crock Pot! 

[*]Featuring foods from [b]Shipwrecked[/b], [b]Hamlet[/b], [b]The Gorge[/b], [b]Unimplemented Foods[/b] and even [b]Exclusive Foods[/b] made only for this mod!

[*]Learn how to cook every recipe using the Mod's website: [url=https://heap-of-foods.com/]Visit it here![/url]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DzIvPEs.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Over 200 New Crock Pot Dishes:[/b] Uncover them and fill your Cookbook to the brim!

[*][b]Over 100 New Ingredients:[/b] Tons of new items to be used in the local cuisine.

[*][b]Over 10 New Plants:[/b] Farm Crops and many bountiful Bushes and Pickables to expand your repertoire of cooking ingredients.

[*][b]New Warly Spices:[/b] Feeling tired about the usual spices? Try the new ones, from setting your enemies ablaze to increasing food stats or even no spoilage penalties!

[*][b]Whole New Places:[/b] The Serenity Archipelago and the Seaside Island, where you will find tons of new content and mobs to assist you in your culinary journey.

[*][b]Reworked Monster Foods:[/b] Characters that can eat this type of food will gain the full benefits with no drawbacks anymore!

[*][b]The Gorge Cookware:[/b] Cooking foods will never be the same again! Each Cookware Station has an unique ability tied to them, from doubling your cooking yields to fully restoring the spoilage time of your food.

[*][b]A New Category of Foods:[/b] The Artisan Goods. Brew and produce an array of new beverages using the Wooden Keg and the Preserves Jar!

[*][b]The Fish Registry:[/b] Your compendium of Fish and roes! Research to know everything about them and their preferences for the Fish Hatchery.

[*][b]Daily Recipes:[/b] Daily Recipes are featured dishes selected everyday from the recipe pool. 
All players share the same recipe regardless of the world. Eating the daily recipe grants bonuses for Health, Hunger and Sanity. It also increases your Luck!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CIYS7m4.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Artisan Products can be produced using the [b]Wooden Keg[/b] and the [b]Preserves Jar[/b]. They can be crafted near an Alchemy Engine under the Cooking Filter. 

[*]They take several days to brew. Some of them have special effects and they do not count towards the Cookbook, instead, they can be viewed at the [b]Brewbook[/b], which is an exclusive book for this new category of foods. 

[*]Wooden Kegs and Preserves Jars only accept specific ingredients such as Vegetables, Fruits, etc. Producing an invalid product will result in Sludge.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aE3pUIp.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Seaside Island[/b] welcomes a new [b]Merchant[/b]! Assisted by a familiar survivor, he has opened a one-of-a-kind trading post, specializing in rare items and ingredients that are otherwise incredibly difficult to acquire and even some you won't find anywhere else.

[*]Make sure to check his wares every now and then to see what he has to offer. As his inventory is always changing, each day, each season, each occasion!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QWOcwnU.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Cast your line, set your sail, and dive into the ocean! A wave of new aquatic creatures awaits, whether you're a seasoned angler or just an apprentice, there's always something to catch! The seas are teeming with new life, but not everything that swims is friendly.

[*]Build yourself a [b]Fish Hatchery[/b] to raise your own fish in the comfort of your base, explore the ocean in search of elusive creatures, take part in [b]Ocean Hunts[/b], trade and deal with the mysterious [b]Ocean Merchant[/b] and find a friendly [b]New Companion[/b].

[*]Research [b]Fish[/b] and [b]Roe[/b] to have their information unlocked at your Fish Registry.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OS4iCbb.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Q: What does this mod do?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This mod adds over 200 new Crock Pot dishes and Ingredients to cook, as well as new plants and creatures. Some content of the game has been tweaked to match the new content in the mod. Already existing mechanics and items may have extra effects and abilities. New places can be found throughout the seas.

[*][b]Q: Recipes of the Wooden Keg / Preserves Jar don't appear on the Cookbook.[/b]
[b]A:[/b] These recipes are special and do not appear in the Cookbook. Instead they have their own book called [b]Brewbook[/b]. You can find it on the Cooking Filter of the Crafting Menu.

[*][b]Q: The inventory icons are bugged / Inventory icons are displaying wrong images.[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This is a common issue whenever the mod gets a new update. To solve this, simply restart the game (Not the world). If this issue continues to happen, please contact me.

[*][b]Q: Is this mod compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727774324&searchtext=craft+pot]Craft Pot Mod[/url]?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. It is! Craft Pot Mod should be able to tell you every recipe this mod has.

[*][b]Q: Does this mod work with other mods?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] I can't confirm that, sorry. If you're playing this mod along with other mods and have issues, please consider disabling them first and try again to see what is causing the problem. You can post your problem in the commentary section below.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixxzslb.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This Mod currently has no official guide, but our community of fans has done an incredible job making their own guides! I'm sure this will help you with the basics!

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2918508191]Guide in English (US)[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2798074275]Guide in Português-Brasileiro (PT-BR)[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2496932990]Guide in Русский (RU)[/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/2334209327]Click Here[/url] To see the Mod Changelogs.
[*][url=https://heap-of-foods.com/]Click Here[/url] to access the Heap of Foods website!

[*]Alternatively you can see them through Steam discussion pages below:
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2334209327/3387282978265043563/]Click Here[/url] to see the Food Recipe List.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2334209327/3383914261422033674/]Click Here[/url] to see the Artisan Goods Recipe List.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2334209327/690868131878456544/]Click Here[/url] to see the Fish Hatchery List.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VkSOFv8.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The mod has support for multiple languages! If you want to contribute with your localization, please join our Discord and follow the steps there.

[*]To change the mod language, head over to the mod configurations while starting your server and select the one you desire.

Current supported localizations:
[*]🇧🇷 [b]Português Brasileiro[/b]
[*]🇨🇳 [b]简体中文[/b] | Author: 糖豆罐里好多颜色
[*]🇵🇱 [b]Polski[/b] | Author: Dr_Brzeszczot
[/list]
[list]
[*]Need Help? Found a bug? Issues with the mod? Suggestions? Head to our Discord and have a chat with us! Our Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/jjNr4Vvutn] Click Here to join![/url]

[*]Want to support my work? My[url=https://ko-fi.com/kynoox] Ko-fi Page[/url][b]Tips not needed, always appreciated[/b].
[/list]
